I took a picture it you really can't see anything so then I ran inside to call my family to come see it and it was gone. What a bummer they thought I was joking. I don't really know how long it was there, but when i seen it and drove home must have been at least a minute. I wasn't keeping track of the time. 
I was just amazed on what I was seeing. Sorry I don't have a great story but at least I can share this with people who will take me seriously. 
Also, I live next to an airport and this object had no sound, no lights, and definitely was not flying by fast like the airplanes around here.

She then realized that it was not a bird in that it was much too large, much too high and did not have wings. She called my attention to the object just as it passed the tree and flew north to south in an open area towards the horizon.

By this time, the object had moved and was presently just south of I-94 by about a quarter to a half mile, hovering about 1000 feet above the ground. As we got closer, we were able to get a better view of it as it hovered above the area just east of Stare Fair Park.
There were no discernible wings and it wasn't a helicopter. There were at least 3 bright white lights and a hale-domed shaped blinking red light which appeared to be in the center. 2250 nothing further

As a light would begin to glow it would gradually increase in intensity and after a second or so, begin to decrease in intensity as another light in close proximity to it would then begin to increase in intensity.

summary: A low flying blue orb perfecly maintaining altitude and speed silently zooming acorss the sky.

I was in my back yard at about 8:15 PM est. when I saw it zip across the sky from North to south in an arching path. It didn’t fade away, it continued across the sky extremely quickly until it was out of view. There were low spotty clouds that may have covered it from view but I saw it perfectly through them. They didn’t affect my view of it. The object couldn’t have been more than 1000 or so feet above the ground (still some clouds lower than it). After I brought it up to a trusted relative, he said he had seen the same type of craft in north Jersey only green This was like nothing I had seen before and I hope others saw it as well.

The first thing that came to mind was “This isn’t completely normal. I should take a picture”. So I rolled down the window and held my phone out the window to take the picture. When we were at the stoplight the lights passed directly above us and when I looked up I noticed they were in a triangular formation and in between the lights that formed the points of the triangle was a dark mass.

There was no way to tell the size or speed, because I couldn’t really tell what I was looking at, there was absolutely no sound at all. I can only approximate what I saw.
I would estimate that it was traveling above Interstate 5 in a Southern direction at an altitude of approximately 2,000 feet above the ground and at a speed of roughly 700 mph. I would approximate the aircraft to be about 75’ wide, no idea of length…very dark sky.

The lights were about 5 times the size of Venus in the night sky and were not emitting the star burst glare of a plane headlight but were more self contained and laser precision. From seeing videos of the Phoenix Lights incident from the 1990's these lights turned on in progression similar to those. summary: Intense bright white light that turned into cigar-shaped object seen in daylight outside of Austin, TX

I was at the end of our driveway, so I walked back to my husband and jokingly asked “is that a UFO?” By the time I turned around, the object had turned west and changed to a cigar shaped object that we could not identify. 
My husband went in the house for his binoculars. The object made no sound, was moving fairly slowly, and was too high up to be a helicopter. An airplane was also in the sky to the east and south of, and higher in the sky than, the object, moving west. 
When my husband looked at the object with his binoculars, he said it was like an elongated oval, with a thinner elongated oval above it but not seeming to be attached to it. He did not see any lights on it, and said the color was off-white. 
Then all of a sudden it disappeared. 
The longitude/latitude of the sighting was 30°15’05.04”N / 98°03’47.86”W and the object was probably 2000 ft. high or more.

At this moment I could see the sphericalness to it and the colors of green, blue, and orange swirling around. Can’t tell if the object itself was rotating. It appeared solid and metallic. There were no landing lights. I estimate the object was the size of a mid-sized car.
The locals wanted to locate it after it got below the ridgeline and we got in our car to look for it but there was nothing to see.

We stopped for a moment to watch the plane in its traffic pattern, and then my mother pointed out a point of bright white light, definitely higher than 40 thousand feet and moving at a very high rate of speed. It was faster than a commercial or private jet, and not as high as a satellite in orbit. The three of us all had our eyes fixed on it as it moved south/southwest in the dark night sky. Suddenly, its rate of speed dramatically increased, and then it spectacularly appeared to ascend its altitude, upward, until it became invisible to the naked eye. There was no sound from the object.
There were very few stars visible. The night sky over Sherman Oaks and Los Angeles is extremely polluted with light as you very well know. Aircraft is easily visible, satellites can be made out with a trained eye…but this white light was so bright and clearly visible…it was an amazing sight.
We all three…

The night was bright enough to easily see that these lights (as big as beach balls would look sitting in a chair next to you) were steady and connected by a black triangular structure.
I noticed no other lights and no noise of any kind beyond normal traffic and ground noises. I checked again to make sure I wasn't mistaking it for a plane, and there it sat, exactly the same way that bricks don't, in place in the air, maybe four to 5 stories off the ground if the surrounding buildings went up that high. No other lights or markings or sound.
It wasn't doing anything, just sitting there and not moving and not making a sound.
Swung by about 6 minutes later, and it was gone. On way home we saw some aircraft seeming to be searching the area and you could hear them miles off.. which helped confirm for me that there was no way that black triangle was a plane or a helicopter.. summary: Convoy of lights moving northbound across the PA sky.

As one light left the northern horizon, a new light appeared in the south - there appeared to be even spacing. Some of the lights in the line had "companion lights" located at 90 degrees from the line of trajectory. These companions moved at the same speed, keeping the same distance at all times.
The lights themselves were red/orange. They were brighter and larger than the appearance of venus. The altitude appeared to be similar to a single engine plane. There was no noise and they lights appeared blurry through binoculars.
The entire procession lasted at least 20 minutes, though it could have started earlier.

First, I would like to say that I am a professional meteorologist with 17 years of forecasting experience and aviation knowledge. 
On Saturday evening, November 30, 2013, between 8:10pm and 8:17pm, I witnessed an event that I cannot explain professionally. 
My wife and I were driving around our subdivision looking at Christmas lights and were heading back home when I noticed (4) unique red orbs in the sky to the north-northwest. I pulled over and we watched the orbs and noticed they appeared to very slowly drift in an direction towards the east.
Then, gradually one of the orbs furthest to the east seemed to simply disappear. Then I noticed yet another orb lift what appeared upwards and fade away leaving two orbs. Then to the west-southwest of the western most orb an new red orb appeared brightly and gradually drifted eastward. The orb in front of it appeared to dip downward and fade while one of the other orbs lifted upward and faded. This continued for about 7 minutes with the orbs disappearing and a new one appearing to keep the number constant between 3 and 4. Finally, one by one, they all faded away and were…

summary: Observed (4) red orbs that were at different heights and moved very oddly then disappeared.
description:
Tonight is a Christmas Light looking occasion that I will never forget.
While driving down a back road in our Lake St. Louis neighborhood my husband and I were shocked to see 4 DARK RED objects in the sky. These objects came and went and were bright RED lights that did NOT blink but yet were consistent in color.
They objects would fly in and out of sight within the 5-10 minutes that we parked watching/videoing them.
Please note that all 4 of these bright red objects were at different heights in the sky. 
After getting full video, we did lose sight of these objects.
Thanks,

summary: Fireball like object flying in a inconsistent line completely disappears from sight.
description: Witnessed "fireball" like object floating high on horizon (higher than commercial airline) moving West to East. Did not have a straight trajectory, more scattered. Object was flickering but had a consistent bright center. Object started to fade over ten second span then completely disappeared from sight. There was no sound from object unlike commercial airline or military jet.

summary: Unusual Lights Above Catalina Mountains in Tucson
description:
At approximately 8pm in the northern Tucson area of Sabino Canyon, while observing the night sky, a friend of mine and I witnessed a dull whitish light moving in a southerly direction towards the city of Tucson. At the time of the sighting, it was located almost directly over the mid section of the Catalina Mountains north of Tucson.
The light did not have the characteristics of a 'beam' with a ray emanating forward, but rather that of a glowing effect that was constant in luminescence. Estimating height would put it at several miles up however there was insufficient evidence to make more than a guess. It moved very slowly relative to what one might see from an airliner or even that of a small plane. There were no strobe lights seen during this sighting and no other color was present than the dull white glow. No sound could be heard either.
As we watched its flight path, it moved towards, and eventually into, a small cloud. Fully expecting to see it emerge on the other side of this small cloud I was surprised to see nothing emerge. When the cloud moved on, there was no light anywhere in the area.
A short time later, we again witnessed what appeared to be another light in the same…

summary: A set of blinking lights simply turned around- not in the way an Airplane or Helicopter makes a u-turn.
description: While traveling on I-95 S., passing through Jupiter, FL. There were a pair of blinking lights in the black sky heading N. It would've passed for an airplane except when it turned the opposite direction, the lights (both)just turned; no U-turn...just turned around and there was no sound being emitted from craft/object. Possible Drone?

summary: Bright orange light seen traveling NW to SE by 2 civilians in NE Iowa.
description:
My wife and I were driving northeast of Arlington, IA, at 8 PM on November 30, 2013, when we noticed an orange light in the northwest sky heading southeast. We both thought it might be a meteorite entering the atmosphere. But the light did not diminish and disappear. Instead the light got brighter and continued to travel southeast at a continuous rate of speed.
The light did not flicker and traveled across our view southeast for at least 1 and a ½ minutes, then it disappeared as suddenly as it had appeared.
We parked the car on the shoulder of the road and shut off the engine. There was no sound as the orange light traveled. We thought about the space station, since we have seen it travel across the sky, but the light was too bright and it was orange. Like a flaming pumpkin orange.
We called local TV stations, but there had been no other calls that evening
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

I have a feeling it is not a plane or a star because this light tends to move a lot. It brights up so bright, that looks like it could be the northern star. Then all of a sudden the lights get really dim then seconds later it gets really bright, sometimes it turns blue other people have seen this. It kind of looks like if it has lights on it turning around in circles. I really have to idea what it could be and I am determined to find out what the bright moving light really is. 
About 4 days ago approximately around 8:00 pm , above a tall tree there was this big ball of light that looked like it was falling from the sky but it looked so close. My boyfriend was with me and as soon as I saw it I told him to look because I wanted to make sure I wasn't seeing anything. When it appeared it looked as if it was a huge shooting star but couldn't have been because after I seen the big bright light that it flashed it disappeared that's when I told my boyfriend and when he looked up he saw it brighten up again right when it…

summary: Bright Amber lights hovering over Arbor Place Mall and Highway I20
description:
My family and I were driving down I-20 Highway and looked up and saw a very bright shining object over Arbor Place Mall. 
One branched off and flew to the West and one flew straight up in the sky. 
Then one hovered over Thornton Rd and Highway I-20 for as long as we could see.

summary: I clearly witnessed a craft on fire that cruised over my house in a steady direction slow down then get smaller and disappear.
description: While watching the Alabama/Auburn at 19:00 hrs I saw out my window what looked like an airplane on fire I could tell by the way it was moving something wasn't right as in what you would see in a airplane crashing. The object just kept moving in a steady pace same altitude while on fire-I could see the flames clearly from my window. Being about 25 miles from Newark airport we are in the flight path of the airlines and see planes fly over constantly and this was not an airplane. At this time I grabbed my iPad and ran out my front door to video the object which I did while screaming for the rest of the family to come outside and witness the object. The object flew directly over my house and we all could very clearly see that the object was under control flying westward and what looked like flames surrounding the craft. It was a awesome sight beautiful actually. The night was cloudy,after the craft passed us it traveled probably a mile definitely slowed down then seemed to ascend get smaller and smaller then disappear.

summary: Main light with several other red lights surrounding main light.
description:
Main solid bright light with other red lights moving swiftly around main light.

summary: 7 fireball like objects.
description: I was leaving my home and in a car with 4 others. I looked up and there was a bright light and almost looking like a fire ball, we stopped and looked there were 6 right behind that one. You could see some of them still for a little bit and then they would start moving very slowly, then disappear. They were as high as a plane maybe even higher and very very bright.

summary: Four red-orange balls of light seen over Oakley, CA.
description:
It was a clear night tonight as I was driving home from work and looked out my window to see four glowing red-orange lights all spaced out from each other; two being lower and two being higher. 
I usually look out as I am driving and check out the night sky, so seeing something like this was an unusual sight. They were very far apart and at four different heights. 
I arrived at my house and looked outside to see they had moved. The lights seemed to get brighter and dimmer as I viewed them but sporadically like burning orbs. They made no sound. The lights began to hover and move towards each other.
They flickered out and disappeared for five minutes and then mysteriously came into view as quickly as they disappeared. 
The four orbs hovered for two minutes and then came close together and made a “Z” like formation. They then moved into a “V” formation and hovered upwards a bit. They flickered out of view after about three minutes of there reappearance.
I made my family come out and watch the orbs with me; there were five of us who witnessed this in total.
Something I really want to emphasize is they were hovering. It did not move like an airplane, balloon, or anything I had seen…

summary: Bright light in the air

As, I observed it through the binoculars and I could see flashing lights enter the object. At one point 6 "UFO's" appeared and moved into what looked like a formation. The colors varied from ship to ship, but most has blue, red, yellow, gold, maybe green alternating flashing/pulsating. It really depends on the angle I was looking and the distance, but the colors were…

summary: Metallic sphere hovering over Hwy 41 Southbound Lane, just outside of Little Chute Wisconsin.
description:
My wife and i were traveling southbound on Hwy 41 returning to our home in Oshkosh from Green Bay. It was late afternoon on November 30th 2013. About one mile outside of Little Chute we noticed a dark circle ahead in the distance over the highway's left lane. We watched it as we got closer we realized it was completely motionless. There was a car slightly in front of me on in the left lane that I was sure was going to hit it. As we approached it the object appeared very metallic in the headlights of the car. It hovered over the highway at about 8 feet, and was approximately the size of a basketball, or slightly larger. 
As the car in front of me passed directly underneath it, the object did not move at all. It hovered completely motionless even when the car passed under it. This happened around 4:40 P.M. and as soon as i got home i reported it to Fox 11 news as well as some other stations. 
This was by far the strangest thing I have ever seen in my 33 years on the planet. Whatever this was, it was silent, motionless, metallic, and unaffected by air movement.

summary: Fiery object in sky over Dunedin Florida on 113013 at dusk.
description:
I saw what I thought was a burning jet (because of the height). It flew as if on course west of Dunedin parallel to the coast. I thought it would start to loose altitude because it was on fire but it did not. After watching for 2 minutes it turned directly west and flew out of site. 
Strangest thing I ever saw in sky. 
It happened just after dusk on 11/30/2013.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: 4 to 6 shiny objects approached close to Lake Havasu City, AZ.
description:
I was walking my dog on the Island and I was looking to the S.W. over the mountains and the sun reflected on several objects that were low in the sky but very hard to see. They seemed to have a shape similar to a glider parachute. 
The first time I seen them they were heading toward Lake Havasu there were 4 to 6 of them in formation about 10 miles away from me. They were very stealth (hard to detect) the second time I seen them about 10 miles away from me they turned away 180* and the sun reflected on them, again exposing them and they headed out toward the "Heart of the Mojave" Desert. 
There was no other aircraft in the sky. Very sunny day 72* with blue sky and no clouds. The objects made no jet type of noise and left no exhaust (contrails). 
They were flying in an area were there wasn't any people and I assume they got close enough to LHC, AZ. So, rather then risk being spotted they turned around. 
I keep in mind that were within several hundred air miles from Area 51.

summary: More Strange Noises Outside House
description:
This report is new and also a follow-up to my report: "Strange Humming Noise Outside House (Mukilteo) - 11/21/2013 23:35.” It was on Saturday, November 30, 2013, (a few days after the first report I submitted for a relative). It was at 1:53 a.m. and I woke up from a sound sleep to a noise coming from outside my window in the courtyard area (which is the front of my house). It was the same area and direction where my adult relative heard a noise one week earlier.
The sound that woke me from sleep was a loud noise giving off electrical feedback, like from an amplifier, or like a microphone being put close to a large wattage speaker, creating a high pitch sound or frequency. I also heard what sounded like a muffled, soft, metallic voice speaking over or through the noise, like it was giving some kind of verbal directions or orders. I could not make out what the voice was saying, but it sounded like English. The direction of the noise definitely was in the courtyard, but seemed directed from above and down across to the house. I had been awake for about thirty seconds and continued hearing this. I was really tired and ready to get up to go look out the window, but as I was ready to do…

summary: Large, silent V-shaped craft spotted traveling southeast quickly in a linear path.
description:
Yesterday around 11:30 to 11:33pm Eastern time, I was taking my dog out in my backyard and looking at the sky since it was unusually clear. While looking at some stars I noticed slightly dimmer lights (yellowish-white) in a V-shaped formation moving across the sky. I quickly reached for my iPhone in my pocket, looked down to pull up the camera, but by the time I was ready to take a picture, the object was passing over some trees.
I did not have the time to count the amount of lights but I would approximate there were about a little over a dozen. They were about the size of the stars-that is, they were tiny lights, not large. These yellowish-white lights did not flicker or blink and were very close together, about six or seven forming each arm of the V-shape. Since the sky was very clear and dark, I could not make out an actual shape of the aircraft aside from the shape the lights made. The V-shape was neither too wide nor too narrow. It was shaped like a normal "V".
The aircraft was silent, but massive. If you stretch out your arm and separate your thumb and pointer fingers by about 2.5 to 3 inches, you will get a pretty good idea of how large it was.
It moved very quickly across…

summary: Perfect flying V but with lights, no birds or a plane
description:
Just saw a perfect flying V of lights, definitely not birds and no sound at all. Not normal plane lights and flew in perfect V formation and glided perfectly across the sky. Looked like a bird formation but was lit up and coasted too perfectly to be birds.
We suspect an evening sighting, and have amended the time above to reflect that fact. Source elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information. PD

summary: The craft was very close: fast; glowing fire red and it could cloack.
description:
November 29th 2013 in Carmichael Ca. myself and a friend were going to the store about 11 30 pm. I looked up and about halfway on the horizon I saw a large red oval shape traveling straight up in the sky. 
I nudged my friend and said, ``Look at that,`` pointing to the object in the sky. Both amazed we walked to that direction of the object in the sky.
The glowing red oval object continued to rise straight up very fast. As it reached very high in the sky it started to cloak until all that was seen was a very small faint almost clear dot than it started moving back and forth a few times very fast. It than starting to come back down as it did it looked like an orb around the dot and it gained red color. The closer it got to the ground it took on the oval shape and was fire red with a little blue. It came down and what seemed very close to the ground from where we were. It disappeared behind an apt. building from our view point and seemed to have been going to the ground somewhere nearby.
It is an amazing, beautiful and unforgettable sighting.

summary: Vibrant green and white lights, cylindrical shaped object, fell straight down approximately 500 feet less than a mile ahead of us.
V shaped object heading south.  No sound. Cloud color.  Not lit up.  Flew in a straight line visible for 7 seconds.
description: Saw a v shaped object visible for about 7seconds. Was a clear, starry night. Was not lit but rather a cloud color or frosted glass color. Would not have caught my eye but rather I just happend to be looking in the right place at the time. No sound. Flew in a straight line heading south. Could not guess an altitude hence the size. From my vantage point, I'd say, width wise, it took up about 5 times the width of a full moon.

summary: B2 Bomber/Flying Wing aircraft.
description:
I walked outside on this night to look at the stars. Only a couple of minutes later I looked behind me and saw what seemed to be a plane. It had no lights on and moved slower than usual. 
As it approached, I realized the lights still weren't on and there was zero engine noise. It was totally silent. There was no fuselage section or tail. The shape resembled a B2 bomber but lacked the jagged edges in the back. It was a flying wing shape. 
It was a dark grey color and had what looked like four equidistant lines like armament racks along the wing.
It flew over MSU University area in a southern direction. I tried to watch it further but it blended in with the sky so well I lost my tracking sooner than I thought I would. About 5 seconds after it passed over me a regular small passenger type jet followed a few hundred yards to the left of it. It seemed like a coincidence but maybe they were flying together.

summary: Reddish orange "light" traveling in unison with two smaller white "lights" at 45 degree angle from each other.
description: Bright reddish orange object traveling swiftly north-northeast in unison with two smaller white "lighted" object (no flickering or blinking on any of them) at 45 degree angle from each other (all three equally spaced) with absolutely no sounds at all.

summary: Shooting star object, much brighter that a star.
description:
On Friday evening, 11/29/13, at about 2030, I was stationary in my vehicle looking South, toward Mt Hope Bay when I saw what appeared to be a shooting star. The object was much brighter than a star, and it moved across the sky from Left to Right (or East to West). 
I observed this object for about 5-7 seconds, and in the last second or so, a small piece broke off and arched backward, as if the larger object was moving at a greater speed, and when the smaller piece broke off, the 2 objects disappeared.

summary: Two glowing balls hovering over Mercer, Maine. Shot off in unimaginable speeds after supersonic craft gets between them.
description:
Looking southeast above the tree line we walked out to see two orange/red objects floating in the sky. About 3 times larger then the biggest brightest star in the sky. What seemed to be a very fast moving military plane started to come between them the one on the left flew off in an unimaginable speed. Then 1-2 seconds later the one on the right did the same. 
The 3rd craft moved over our heads in the opposite direction as the orange balls at supersonic speeds flashing it's red and whites strobes which were extremely bright not to be confused with a conventional craft and it's white and red much weeker flashes.

summary: Flying lightbulb the size of a basketball over Maynard MA
description:
While driving south on Parker St (rt 27), an object passed over head just above the tree lines. It was round about the size of a basketball and glowed like a light bulb with a surrounding blue hue. 
The object travelled east to west at a constant velocity and on a straight line but looked to be coming down. Possibly landing nearby. 
Both of us are at a loss as to what this could have been.

summary: Bright white light travels across the night sky and vanishes
description:
Friday, November 29th, 2013. 
I was traveling south on Hopkins Hill in Coventry, RI, at approximately 8PM. I was following a car driven by my wife with my daughter in the front passenger seat and her friend in the back. The skies were extremely clear. A bright white light came into view to my right at a slight angle upwards but well over the tree tops. It moved very fast to the right and vanished. Total sighting time may have been 1 to 1.5 seconds.
I can’t be sure how far it travelled before it disappeared, but it was a good distance across the sky. It didn’t make any sound that I could detect being in the car, and it did not leave any type of vapor trail that I could tell. I cannot be sure how big it was only that it had to be substantial to give off that much light.
When we reached our home on Mohawk Trail in West Greenwich, RI, my daughter ran from my wife’s car to ask if I had seen it and I told her I had. My wife had also seen it but not my daughter’s friend in the back seat. Later that evening, I mentioned the sighting to my neighbor who said that he had also seen a bright white light go across the sky while he was standing in his front yard. He confirmed it to be right…

summary: Bright orange globes traveling east to west.

description: I was standing outside at around 1920 hours with two coworkers when one of my coworkers asked me if I see the "triangle formation" of lights, pointing to the south. When I looked I did not see what he was referring to. However, as we stood outside several minutes later I witnessed first hand a formation of rapidly moving "white" lights, moving from a north to south general direction. When I observed the lights it appeared that at first, they were in a pointed formation similar to a chevron, however as they moved, the lights were moving in and out of formation randomly. For example, some of the lights moved ahead of the others periodically, and then back, as others did the opposite. There were approximately 10 or 12 of these lights in this particular instance. Our viewing angle was approximately 120 to 150 degrees from where we were standing to the objects in question. Approximately 5 minutes later, a third set of lights was seen, a! lso traveling the same trajectory as the previously mentioned. However, there were only about 5 of the lights in this occurrence. These particular lights were moving very rapidly as well, but in more of a "line" formation, semi-diagonal in nature from…

summary: 3 crescent/Chevron shaped formations consisting of 8-12 lights.
description: Sighting consisted of 3 separate Chevron/crescent shaped objects about 3 minutes apart from each other, with a fly over time of 10-15 seconds. These objects did not appear to be accompanied by any sounds, although they appeared to be very low to the ground. The second set appeared to change shape in a similar manner to a flock of birds. All the flight paths were straight, in a north west to south west trajectory.

summary: Orange lights were silent and flying one behind the other then disappearing at the same place in the sky and were not flashing or blinking they were steady.
description: About two minutes later a plane came through on the same path of the orange lights were on looking for the lights but the lights were gone.

summary: orange dots moving to south in Maryland
description:
11-29-2013 I was eating my oatmeal and my mom called me up, sounding like an emergency. I ran up, and I felt bad, mainly because my mom sounded worried. She told me to peek out the window. I did. It seemed normal as can be.
There were some orange dots in a triangle shape. I thought that was perfectly normal. My mom told me that it made no sound. A little wave of oddness washed over me. Then they were moving south, in the same shape. Then, I saw some more orange dots coming in from the north, heading the same direction. I am now scared. All I heard were the noises of the cars moving by. And I saw the cars, too. This was about 6:50 pm Eastern Time.

summary: 5 or 6 oranges objects seen flying over Frederick MD  11/29/2013 18:50
description:
My wife was closing the blinds upstairs, and see yelled down to me, come up stairs and look at this, come up stairs an look at this. When I got upstairs and looked out the window at approximately 6:50PM on 11/29/2013 I saw 5 or 6 orange objects in the sky moving towards the S/SSE direction at a decent rate of speed, probably as fast as a plane would be seen traversing the sky, flying in a simple formation. I looked to see if the corners of the formation were steady, hoping to see a mother ship, but they were independently moving. 
The objects were overhead, not directly, overhead like if you were looking out a window. It appeared to me that one of the ships was a laggard and moving more quickly to catch up to the rest, I cupped my eyes out the window and looked at laggard object catching up and did see a rotating light pattern moving about a pentagon or hexagon shape, red, green, blue, after a few minutes the objects disappeared either behind a clouds, fog! , or they just faded out. 
There was no sound from the crafts whatsoever. Weird.

summary: A group of orange lights moving south in Urbana, MD along the Ijamsville Rd/Villages of Urbana area
description:
11-29-2013 It is a Friday evening and I went upstairs to get some lotion for my hands. I then noticed I had left the blinds and curtains open in my bedroom so I went to close them. The time is 6:50PM in Frederick, Maryland, technically Urbana, but we have no post office in this area. 
As I went in front of the window (of which there is a small wicker settee in front of it), I glanced outside and saw at that moment two orange lights heading to the right in the sky, which is heading south. It is not strange to see helicopters around here either for rescue or for the military, but I thought it was strange that I did not hear them. 
I then opened up the window to hear the sound, but it was quiet except for my waterfall of my pond from below. 
I then called my 9 year old daughter upstairs to see this strange sight. She was eating oatmeal and she came upstairs and was frightened by the site. Then I called up my husband to see these lights. I then noticed another 4 or 5 orange lights w! ere going at the same altitude, heading north to south. These lights approached from my left, from the north. summary: I was walking north on the beach from the Pearce Moser access.  First object rose from the area of South Litchfield Creek traveling south. Lasted approximately 30 seconds before it disappeared.
description:
I continued walking north to the end of the north point. I turned around and after walking approximately 200 hundred yards another object appeared coming from the same area and again traveling south for approximately 20 seconds and then disappeared. There was no noise or flashing lights. 
The winds were light out of the north. The objects moved too quickly to be riding on the wind and did not waiver. The general appearance was that of a fireball without a tail or trace.

summary: Orange Park Fl 3 minutes pulsating glowing red and orange orb seen by 4 family members
description:
Before we saw the glowing pulsating ball of ember in the sky on our drive home we noticed the sky darken within the matters of seconds. We found that to be very strange, we continued home as normal. 
I was in the house when my wife and children yelled for me to come here, I ran to see what the commotion was all about I could not believe my eyes, There in the sky a glowing, pulsating orb of some sort slowly glide across the sky and disappeared below the tree line it was so close it looked as if you could touch but so far that all you could see was the shape of the thing. I am still in awe shocked and in disbelief all at the same time.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. Witness may be same person who telephoned our Center over the UFO Hotline, but we cannot be certain. PD

summary: Three strange lights dancing in the distance.
description:
I saw 3 strange lights that looked like stars but I could tell they were much too close for stars. I decided to drive to a more open area, a golf course, and watched them. They seemed to leave small trails as they moved, like a comet and as soon as they stopped the trail disappeared. They moved and passed by each other. I watched for about 10 minutes until me and the passenger decided to go home. The background was totally black, clear sky. They looked almost like a cell phone tower height from afar. At first I thought that's what it was a tower I never noticed until they began to move and they never blinked.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Large caravan of UFO's appear in night sky over Marietta Ga.
description: I was standing at my back door getting some fresh air,it was a cold and clear night with minimal wind, when I noticed a large and very bright object to my west, it hadn't been there a moment before, as I had been standing there watching the last bit of sun fall off the horizon, The object appeared just above the tree line. At least twelve years I have seen disk objects in the sky. Red and blue lights are around these disk objects constantly circling the disk. They mostly hover but oh they do move and can move extremely fast but they can also move slow. I see them very often in Chicago skies on the South East side and South West side. Last seen November 28, 2013. 
Now I see these same objects in the South Loop Sky Last seen November, 2013 I can only see them at night, never in the daytime or on a rainy day! Always more than one. First encounter was frighting because one started coming at me really fast, I saw the dome over the disk and it was bright inside the dome and something seated inside on the right side my right it would be the disk left side. I ran inside. I was on the second floor balcony of a two story building (1999). 2013 I still see these disk objects in Chicago Skies.

summary: Duration from first sphere appearing to last disappearing approx. 7 minutes
description:
On November 28 at approx.. 5:48 pm in Amory, Mississippi we myself & my wife were preparing to make our regular trip back home where we have been taking care of our mother since late March 2011, who is a 94 year old stroke victim and lives with us in Tennessee. We take her home as much as we can it seems to help her condition 
While I was taking out the garbage during a clean up process I noticed a very bright large white star in the west south-west sky, it was very beautiful. I stared at it for a moment and then looked further to the west and gazed at a tiny star twinkling and then further west north-west an orange star began to appear it reminded me of the moon that every now and again turns yellow orange you know. 
Peering through the trees out at the horizon the orange star was moving – “ oh well jet airliner 
As it drifted higher like the ember from a fire another orange star began to appear, I was certain that the Columbus Air Force Base was conducting drills. As the two orange lights rose slowly from the horizon-I was waiting for a familiar aerial sound-wop, wop, wop, but there was no sound and then another orange light appeared in the same area of orientation and began to…

summary: Five orange-red objects flying in an inverted Y formation, no.sound.
description: Five bright orange-red bright lights were seen coming from the north of my house, moving south, There were two in front of the others and they were flying in the shape of an inverted Y formation. They just seemed to disappear after a few minutes. There was no sound whatsoever. If we hadnt been standing on our deck we would have never known. Our TV did go black screen at the same time but when we came back in we were able to turn it back on. By the time we thought of getting our phones to take a pic it was gone. We were all trying to figure out what we were seeing.

summary: Bright white stationary light over Pendleton, IN.
description:
Starting at 5:30pm on November 28, 2013, I witnessed a stationary white light high in the sky. It was located South West of State road 13 and I-69 in Pendleton, Indiana. Object was brighter than surrounding stars. Object was still visible at the time of this report.
Sighting of Venus. PD

summary: Very large object slowly became visible with sound
description:
The sun had just gone down when I heard a loud hum; like a giant electrical machine or generator and the noise was coming from everywhere. The sound was all around me; I couldn't tell where it was coming from. Waited a few seconds to see if the noise would dissipate, like an airplane going by, but it didn’t. The next thing I knew I woke up; it felt like I was brought out of a deep sleep suddenly. I was not tired at all and I don’t take naps – ever. When I “woke up” the noise was still there but an hour an a half had gone by. So at this time I walked outside to see what the noise was.
When I got outside the humming was all around, I couldn’t tell which direction it was coming from. I walked to the front of my house but didn’t see anything. So I walked to the side of the house and from the corner of my eye I seen a pixel of light appeared in the sky out of nowhere. The tiny light started to grow larger and then two more lights started to appear. I shook my head and looked around and the lights where still getting bigger. They were forming a rectangular shape. The noise was still going on and I felt as if I was the only one around.
This was in Fresno CA out in the country by the east…

description:
I didn't see the objects with my eyes, they only appeared on the picture.
I was taking 3 shots from a bus with few seconds difference. Only two of them show the objects, but there's nothing on the third picture.

summary: White circular UFO outside Boston disappears--then reappears atop neon orange vertical-ellipse-shaped cloud & witnessed to Hartford CT.
description:
Immediately after emerging from the Boston tunnels, headed Westbound on I-90, I saw a constant stationary illumination, circular and white, directly ahead of us. Too large and too early in the day to be a star, I pointed it out to my husband, who was driving. We joked about it, but I kept watching. Heading due-west, I realized it was moving North and South, but there was no smoke trail. As soon as I opened my mouth to mention it to my husband, he exclaimed, “It’s moving!” Very soon after, it seemed to stop moving North-South, but the light got smaller and smaller until it disappeared from sight.
Minutes later, we were passing over a body of water by a Framingham exit. The reflection looked orange, so I looked up, expecting to see sunset starting. Instead, the sky was bright blue and clear of clouds, except for one, which was directly ahead of us. It was neon orange in color, a vertical ellipse in shape, about 40 azimuth from the horizon, about 10 azimuth in height. I joked in less technical terms that it looked like female genitalia.
I do a lot of sky gazing, I’ve never seen a cloud like this, my jaw was in my chest, eyes trained on it. I remarked that it looked like it was…

summary: 2 Suns? Comet?
description:
As I was driving home down hwy 15 (south) it appeared I was driving towards 2 sunsets. The one to the right was clearly the sun (west) but what was the sun type object in front of me?
Looks like a reflection off of a broad swath of clouds. PD

summary: Teardropped object over marsh area with tail and aura and haze.  Then vanished after 10 seconds
description:
Just happend to look out window over very large marsh area and saw a teardroped shape object at 45 deg angle with tail. 
The center area a pale orange surrounded by white. 
Then vanished completely like it was never there.
Witness indicates that the date of the incident is approximate. PD

Blue sphere of light flashes on 1-4 and zoomed down
description: We were driving on 1-4 on the way to Tampa, then saw the whole sky flash blue then a blue sphere of light zoomed down. It was very fast and as we kept driving the next electric billboard was broken-- kind of like the static on a tv screen.

summary: Light Streaks across south sky Maple, Ontario, Canada
description:
Strange Northern Light streak across South sky over Maple, Ontario, Canada. 
Me and a friend walked onto his porch which is directly facing south and clearly at the time streaks of lights seemingly shifting and slightly changing colours and seem to stretch above and behind us (North) to where we could clearly see the streaks to the south in front of us. 
The clouds behind the streaks seem to smooth out and move south yet to the west the clouds are coming towards us and seem a lot more scattered. STRANGE!

summary: 3 bright lights hovering soundless in Lometa, Texas, seen by father and daughter.
description:
My 13 year old daughter and I were walking to camp from the deer stand. It was a very clear quiet night. To the south we saw 3 very bright lights appear to be hovering high in the sky. 
We did not hear a sound of any kind. No engine or jet sounds. 
The 3 lights were side by side. The lights appeared to hover for 3 or 4 minutes the veer away from us. 
At that time the lights appeared to change to a more triangle shape. What we saw was not a plane. It did not have the natural characteristics of an airplane or helicopter. And as stated it did not create any sound. 
This is my 3rd similar sighting in Lometa County and my first time to report it.

summary: THERE WERE 3 RED FIERY SHAPES IN THE SKY.  THE 3 RED THINGS WERE FLYING IN THE FORM OF A TRIANGLE.
They're Back!!!
description:
2013 November 28 On 11-28-13 night time, late evening, exact time not noted. Looking outside as I often do, now, I see in the western sky above tree line, a white light which hangs there, probably 2-3 miles away, at a couple hundred feet off the ground. Now this is very sparsely populated area, so there is not much over there. This UFO, gets bright then goes dim, goes out, then dim, then gets brighter, then dimmer, then brighter, then dimmer and goes out, only to grow dim-bright again. This pattern goes on for some time, entertaining for a little while perhaps 20 minutes (I would watch, go away, and come back to still see it, eventually I got busy and forgot, finally going back much later, it was gone) but, after a while, I just thought, well, they're back, again. I don't know if they are attempting to tell me something or what? I did not know until getting this iPad and going on google earth, there is actually a road back there, of which, I was unaware, I had thought it just open countryside for miles. However, knowing that now, I think the next time, I see this craft, just hanging around back there, I may just go for a ride, I hope, on them.
((
One of 13

summary: Boomarang object over 100 feet long and silently glided past my house;no lights;no sounds
description:
Got out of my car and looked up at the stars and noticed a dark shadow from the corner of my eye and when I looked straight at it I could hear no sound or lights, but as it was going by I could see a little relection of city lights on it and it appeared to be between 1 and 3 thousand feet up and it resembled a sort of boom a rang and it appeared to be over 100 feet long. I could not believe what I was seeing and I seriously was freaking the ((deleted)) out!

I dont know what it was and I dont think the Air Force would be testing any new planes in a populated area, at least we hope that thats all it was!

summary: Neon wavy streak of light. 2 witnesses. In Mississippi.
description:
My 18 year old daughter and I were driving on HWY 8, headed east right at the Calhoun/Chickasaw County line. We noticed a glowing (silver-ish) ball that was going back and forth from one ball to two balls. Connected like Mickey Mouse ears. It was just above the tree line. Hovering. After about 45 seconds, it disappeared. 
Then about 20 seconds later a blinding neon light was coming straight at us. At first, it looked like headlights. But it was so bright that it lit up everything like looking through infrared glasses. It was greenish blue waves that looked hot. Like how the highway looks on a extremely hot day- kinda wavy. This light shot straight through my car and passed by the passenger side window. 
When I turned to look, everything in the background - the field - the trees were lit up. And then it was gone. It happened so fast that I didn't realize I had slammed on my brakes. An 18 wheeler must have seen it too because he was stopped dead still on the highway too.
The reason I'm posting this now is due to my daughter's nightmares. About a month ago she started having dreams about the incident. She won't go into detail about them but she has slept with me every night since.…

summary: White lights seen at night to the north of Sabino Canyon
description:
At approximately 18:00 on the evening of 11/27/13 my friend, G*** and I walked a little over 1 mile up the paved tram road in Sabino Canyon which enters up into the Catalina Mountains on the very north east side of Tucson, Az. We set up a couple of camping chairs on the edge of the road so that we could look at the night sky to the north east and have a conversation.
At about 19:30 I turned my gaze to the north and saw a white light in the sky at about 10:00 above the horizon. The light was moving slowly from north to south and appeared to be both below and in some clouds that peppered the otherwise clear sky. The light was soft white with no blinking running lights and did not have the bright glare of an airplane headlight. It looked similar to a satellite but was about 3 to 5 times larger. There was no sound.
If one were to hold their arm out and spread their fingers to about 4 inches, that would be the distance this object travelled. It then faded out at the end and disappeared. From our vantage point this object was moving more towards us than away.
A couple of minutes later I looked at the same location and saw a light that looked exactly the same but this time it was headed…

summary: Amber-Orange triangle of 3 lights southeast of Phoenix, AZ
description: 3 amber lights in triangle formation. Quickly moved to one light then dissipated. South east of Phoenix. Seen from Cave Creek. Estimated distance 70 miles. Black sky and clear. We could see Sky Harbor approach aircraft from east to west and the lights were way past that. Lights were of a pure amber-orange color.

summary: Low-flying large object over Fredericksburg.
description:
I was in my bedroom which toward the back of a townhouse when I heard a low rumbling sound. I didn't think anything of it at first and thought it was my neighbors next door, but it got louder. I looked out my rear window and saw, what I can describe as a fleeting shadow. 
I went to my daughters room which is down the hall (10 feet), where her curtains were open and I saw what appeared to be a round object. This object flashed very bright red lights which stayed steady for a several seconds, then flashed again. There were two of these lights, and two white lights. The white lights were very bright and flashed much more quickly then these two lights. I could see a structure to this craft and it appeared to be round. Due to the darkness the detail could not be made.
Going back to the lights, the best way to explain the position of the lights is by showing them in a lower case "t". One red light was at the top, the other at the bottom, while the two white lights were one on each side of the arms of the "t". This craft was very low and after it went past my house, made no noise. flight path for aircraft flies from Richmond normally higher altitudes north and south. This craft came from…

summary: white light triangular over central oklahoma
description:
I looked up to the sky as i was driving to Tulsa Oklahoma and I saw a bright light in the sky at first I thought it was airplane but as I looked at it I could see a faint shadow of a triangular craft. The light was one of the brightest lights I have ever seen. it also looked like there was dome shape on the top part of the craft. so I pulled over and began recording it. The object would be bright then it would go dimmer then brighter again. I know it wasn't a cellphone tower because I noticed the object was moving. it was moving very slowly but nevertheless it was moving. there was only one of them. it seemed to be moving then it began to hover then moving again. this was a big object though my guess would be about the length of 4 semi trucks.
We have corresponded with the witness, and agree that the object probably was Venus, seen prominently in the southwest sky. PD

summary: Orangle lights sightings taking triangle shape and being sent from a white orb like object in the sky.
description:
My friends dad was on my back porch and noticed these orange lights in the sky. First one followed by another, then two side by side, then finally there were three in a triangle format. 
He called us out once he saw the first one and we watched each one go by the sky. They would start on our left and eventually die out. They appeared to be getting lower. 
Once there were no more being sent across the back of the house view we decided to go look at the other end of the house. We saw a white globe like object sending these orange circles out. They seemed to die out faster once we went to the other side of the house. 
Eventually there were no more orange lights coming out of the white one. Stunned, I went to looking up similar stories. The white light was very close to my house and every 10 minutes I'd go check on it and it would get farther and farther away loosing the white and turning orange like the rest of them. 
Does anyone know what this is?!? 
At first I thought chinese lanterns that is until I discovered the white orb and the fact that they took a triangle form. Very weird!!

summary: Bright Pink Stealth shaped ufo in CO
description: I was sitting on my front porch when I noticed what I thought was a bright pink star. It began to move around so I called for my friend to come see. It flew slowly in several directions, came toward us and then we could see it was rather triangle shaped. Kind of resembled a stealth. Then slowly it moved away. It seemed like it was following the street.

summary: Four multi colored orbs / lights over Hollister CA on 11/27/2013
description:
I stepped outside about 8:00 pm and walked southbound about 50 yards from the house, as I turned around and began walking Northbound I saw what I thought was a plane going into the little airport in Hollister. 
Then I saw what appeared to be a red light, as I watched I was thinking this must be the southern end of the flight path to San Jose airport. 
Then I saw a second ball of light that had more colors, again thinking these were planes I just watched then all of a sudden the first light moved back in a unnatural way towards the second light. It was at that time that I realized there was no sound. 
I listened intently to see if I could here a plane, or helicopter. There was nothing no sound. 
Then, as I continued to walk Norhtbound toward downtown Hollister, I saw 2 more orbs, for a total of 4 orbs. They were all changing multiple colores, and they moved back and forth, up and down very quickly and almost gracefully. 
I thought I should get my family to have the! m bring out a camera, and I turned again to walk back Sothbound to the house, as I looked over my shoulder to continue watching they all just seemed to disappear. 
I heard no noise, saw no lights shining up like search…

summary: Bright ball of light observed near Hobby Lobby warehouse.
description:
Driving in vehicle heading southbound on S Council just past SW 29th Street when a very bright ball of light could be observed. The sun was bright with no clouds. Airplanes were clearly visible with their condensation trails.
The ball of light was extremely bright even with the brightness of the sun and it being a clear day with no clouds. The bright light was observed minimizing in size and it appeared to leave line of sight heading in the South direction.

summary: 2 lights that moved slowly around eachother, in southern sky...
description: Very bright object, No flickering, continuous light, through telescope there were 2 spots moving around each other, shapes indeterminable. Dissipated or disappeared after 30 min's In southern sky, low to horizon.

summary: Strange lights sighted and then airplane with no lights sighted.
description:
I spotted this with my naked eyes while looking for ison. It was east south east of the city. At first I chalked it off as an aircraft but I got my binoculars and upon further examination I could see many colors. Sort of like a cops lights on but there are many more colors.
I set my binocs on the side of my truck to steady them and could still see many colors. Blue, red, green, violet, amber and possibly yellow all rotating around a central point. I'm watching it now and it is not moving. Other than the lights. 
It has maintained its position for a few hours now.
Also their is a blacked out airplane flying circles overhead. The local airport is across town maybe 20 miles. I thought it was a helicopter but it is an airplane.

summary: Green/blue light swirling high in sky, then started descending straight (very straight)  down very slowly.
description: Green/blue light was swirling high in the sky, then the lights slowed down a little and it start descending straight to the ground, very slowly. But in a straight line down.

summary: Upward curving row or lights flying low over interstate 85 NC
description: Driving North on interstate 85 NC around mile marker 147. A line of white and yellow lights crossed the highway very low and only had one other light which was higher than the others but the shape of the object could not be seen. It slightly "rocked" forward and back once while passing over the road and continued from west to east until we drove further and it was out of sight. More cars were on the interstate but none seemed to slow down or be concerned with it. It seemed to be too many lights to be an airplane which usually don't have that many lights in a singular upward curving row or be that low flying.

summary: Near Youngstown, OH- Triangle / Lights on all sides / warm, radiant, shining light / rapid descent / slow, hovering / SILENT
description:
We were driving along a main road in our city at about 8:24 PM EST yesterday. My passenger and I saw what looked to be a very bright star in the night sky, and noticed it was slowly decreasing its altitude. It descended from the sky until it was what seemed like right above our car. I could make out an unusual shape from our sunroof. It was a triangle-shaped object with bright light surrounding all sides. 
The light was not a cool blue, but a warmer light. It was radiant- as if for a moment someone had shined a flashlight in your eyes. We know it was no plane or helicopter as there was dead silence above us. It was moving very slowly, still quite a distance away. For it to descend that fast only to "hover" above the road before moving away in the opposite direction is a very odd thing for a plane or helicopter to do.

summary: a sideways disk made up of green blue yellow and red shot down making a big sound.
description:
My friend and I was walking down the street back from the store and we heard a crashing sound but we could not see anything when we looked up in the sky. Once reaching the top of her stairs we could actually see the object through the trees thinking that it was a airplane because of the color and blinking red. 
Once the figure got out from behind the trees we could see green blue red and yellow blinking off the figure, and as my friend began to take her phone out, the figure made a big crashing sound and swirled to the ground.

summary: We heard a sound, then a colorfful object shot out the sky.  The object was a disk with green, red, yellow, blue and purple.
description:
While walking up my stairs, me and my friend heard a sound like airplane crashing. We looking towards the trees, and noticed a red and yellow light. My friend believed it was a airplane. 
We waited a few seconds, and the light got bigger, then we relived it was not a plane because it was a also green, blue, and purple. 
When the light got closer, the street lights helped us make out the shape of the object. It was a sideways disk. 
As i went to take my phone out the object made a loud sound and shot to the ground.
We suspect an evening sighting, and have amended the time above to reflect that fact. PD

summary: Silent, bobbing flaming orb.
description:
On Tuesday, November 26, 2013, at about 7:05 pm, my friend and I witnessed what looked like a flaming orb to the south of East Main St. in Apache Junction, AZ. It was maybe 1/8 mile away and moving from east to west. 
We watched it for about 30–40 seconds before it disappeared behind taller buildings in the area so it might have only been about 100 feet in the air. 
It appeared to be orange in color and and flickered as if it were on fire. The way it seemed to burn was like a marshmallow, a slow lazy flame. 
As it moved it seemed to bob up and down as if it were “riding the waves”. 
At first, I thought it was a power surge on the power lines but as the power lines switched directions, it continued the same. There was absolutely no sound related to this!

summary: Witnessed a handful of cigar-shaped aircrafts with 4 red and 4 turquoise lights; red lights were blinking.
description:
Witnessed 3 – 4 UFO’s moving much quicker than normal commercial aircrafts and at a lower altitude. The aircraft was in the shape of a rocket with 8 lights. 4 lights were of a turquoise color while the other 4 were red and pulsating on and off. 
All the lights were positioned near the middle of the aircraft. The lights were positioned in a circular orientation, following a red then turquoise pattern. 
UFO’s appeared to be surveying the land, for it was moving in straight lines, making turns much sharper than normal aircrafts. 
Deep buzzing sound heard as one aircraft flew above and behind us and into the sky.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: It was a bright light, larger than a star, in western sky.  After looking at it a few times, we went back to look again and it was GONE!!!!!
description: The same thing in the same spot was out 4 nights before, not sure of the time. It also disapeared!

summary: UFO west of Fort Collins, Colorado, November 26 2013
description:
First spotted to the west, I was at College and Prospect. It was a bright white light in the sky above the mountains. 
I ran back in and grabbed my co-worker. She had never seen one before. I actually stopped some people by campus. I ran home and grabbed my neighbors. We went out to see it and watched it for another 10 minutes. During that time, changed from bright white to yellow/gold, occasionally flashed red, grew dim and then bright, lights reflecting off of surrounding clouds. Planes in the sky seem to be unaware of it's presence, we watch one actually fly behind the object and appear on the other side. 
Started drifting really slow along the horizon and began to drop. Got the car to drive west to try and get a better view. Realized it was dropping behind some hills, took a detour and ran up a hill. It was gone by the time we got there, which was around 7 PM.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Light in the sky over Danville, IL. 11/26/13 545pm.

On Wednesday 11/26/13 Bright light in the sky it did not move sky was clear I watched it for about 10 min. 
WENT BACK IN THE HOUSE TOLD MY SISTER TO LOOK AT IT OUT THE WINDOW STILL HAD NOT MOVED HAVE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE THIS BEFORE. 
We Looked again and it had moved to the west a little latter we could not see it beecause it went behind a house I have never seen anything like this before I have 2 pictures of it.

summary: Very bright white light south of corona
description:

At first i thought it was a star or a planet but then it started moving up and down i went inside to get my binoculars and looked at it, it wasnt flashing but was moving, 
when i looked a it again it was still there but moved to the right and lowered. 
no stars in my city are that bright.

summary: Bizarre color changing moving light.
description:
We observed a bright light which was slowly changing colors, from blue to green to red to white to orange and back to blue. 
It appeared to hover for periods, then it made rapid movements that certainly did not seem possible for any aircraft I know of. It appeared to be out over the ocean in a west northwest direction from doheny state park. 
I am a skeptic, but this was bizarre and unexplainable by me.

summary: Stationary Object in sky northeast of Yuma AZ
description: On our way out to Sedona AZ from San Diego on 11/26/2013 traveling east on interstate 8 We saw a stationary object in the sky just northeast of Yuma AZ. It remained there the whole time as we passed by it in the far distance. It was far away maybe beyond the mountains north of Yuma. It never moved only lost sight of it when we drove further past it. On out way back from Sedona to San Diego. This time west on Interstate 8 on December 1st it was still there. Same location. In the middle of the day. It was a bright white object in the sky. It seemed to be rectangle but it was hard to tell due to the distance. Everyone traveling on interstate 8 had to have seen it. What was it?

summary: Very fast, high altitude light traveling from the west to the east.
description:
Tuesday morning, Nov. 26, 2013, at approximately 06:15 central standard time, I was waiting for the van to warm up. I observed a light to the south, at a very high altitude moving across the morning sky from west to east. I would estimate the altitude at somewhere around 90,000 to 100,000 feet and possibly following interstate 40 over Oklahoma City, Okla. I would estimate the speed to be around Mach 20. It took approximately 120 seconds for the object to traverse from the west to the east.
The object traversed across the sky faster than the space stations, which I have watched from 11,000 feet in the San Christie Mountains at Philmont Scout Ranch. But a whole lot slower than a streaking meteorite, with no contrail visible. It appeared to me as if the sun was reflecting off the bottom of an aircraft. Although there were no white or red strobe lights that was visible. I feel that this could have been the experimental aircraft, Falcon HTV-2. I am not sure what it was, but it was fast.

summary: UFO? Over fort mill.
description: I was driving on U.S 21 road to my girlfriend's house when I see this bright yellow and green light in the sky. At first glance I thought it was just an airplane but as I got closer it didn't move at all. I looked up and it looked circular. I took a video that I'm 100 percent sure it lasted roughly around 30 seconds. When I arrived at my girlfriend's house it came only to be around 10 seconds. Which I found it to be very strange to me.

summary: Strange redish blue lights over Medford Nj
description:
As I was towing a vehicle on rt 206 (main st), crossing pemberton rd., in the far distance, about 3 miles away. Their was this strange blueish, green glow in the sky.
I wish I knew what or whom did what I saw...

summary: Many different colors of various lights zipping through the sky, changed in colors and moved irradicately.
description:
For about an hour now I have been watching strange lights in the sky. The change in color from white, green, red, orange and blue. They have been zipping across the sky irregularly. They will occasionally meet up and then zoom away quickly. They look like stars moving across the sky. I can’t say how many exactly because of how quickly they were all moving, but it seemed to be 4-6 if not more. 
I am now terrified and will not sleep for the rest of the night.

summary: Bright Strobe Light, Higher than a cell phone tower.
description:
There is a flashing light over in the field by Rolling View Marina. Continuous bright super white flash. Looks to be a cellphone tower, but it is way too tall and its not out in the clearing like a normal tower. 
We have been here 30 years and know everything about the area and every event that goes on. We are not sure what this is but we have never seen it before. 
The dogs are freaking out! I do have a video.

summary: Silent Cigar Shaped UFO Leawood, KS.
description:

No follow-up report has been submitted, and no photo has been sent to our Center, as of five days later.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: Slow-moving orange light crossing overhead, then slowly burning out.
description:
Orange fuzzy light coming from East looked like aircraft landing light but orange. Crossed overhead at several thousand feet and started to dim and shrink in size until it burned out completely. No discernible sound from object. 
Flight observed for about 90 seconds. Less than one minute later three military aircraft passed overhead at low altitude circling the area.
Observer is licensed pilot and airframe mechanic.

summary: triangular ufo
description:
My partner and i decided to have dinner out, so we went to glendale, new south wales, australia. 
Whilst we were eating in our car i noticed lights in the sky from a distance. I told my partner as we both were watching i took note of the time 20:45.
We continued to watch as it got closer we came to realization it was triangular. 
There was no sound coming from the object which was no more than 200 metres above us not even we could not see any sort of colour it blended with the night we saw 3 headlights at the front and 2 red pulsing lights in the middle at the front of the aircraft than 2 pulsating red lights at the back it definitely was not human aircraft due to how low the thing was and how slow it was moving this is not a hoax this is legit myself and my partner saw it the event lasted for 5-7 minutes.

summary: Fire like orb climbing emerging from the west moving east turning to the north.
description:
Fire like orb emerged from the west just over the roof top of a house. 
Object was about 3/4 size of a full moon glowing red/orange. 
Object was moving east, northeast and turning to the north gaining altitude. 
Orb headed north diminishing as it gained altitude. Object vanished about 10 degrees north of the zenith.

summary: Several orbs emitting constant orange light hovering over the sea
description:
I was in a public park in the city of Mataró where one can see the sea, 4 to 5 orbs were emitting a bright orange light hovering about 3 to 5 km into the sea. They didn't blink, the light was a constant orange color. They were floating in the air and had a slight up-and-down movement, every now and then one of them would slowly descend quite a bit, approaching the water but not reaching or submerging it, and then slowly return up with the rest of the orbs. This downward movement happened at least a couple of times during the time I was observing. No sound was perceived.
From the place I was, I could see fishing boats in the sea, the lights of the fishing boats were completely different (red and white color, much less bright than the orbs), the fishing boats were in the horizon line, the orbs instead were up in the air. The orbs had no blinking lights like regular aircraft. I saw passing by a couple of commercial airplanes at a higher altitude and further in distance. No other aircraft was seen, and no interaction was made.
I stared at the phenomenon for about 25 minutes, the lights were probably there already before and probably lasted for a bit more after I left the place.

summary: A zigzagging orange light ball moving upwards into the night sky than vanishes.
description:
I was out walking my dog as I do every night. 
As I looked up over the tall pines lining a field by my house I saw an object about the size of a large star emitting an orange color come out of nowhere, sit there for a split second and than started zig zagging upwards fast before it disappeared. 
I heard no noise coming from it and I continued to search the sky for a few moments afterwards but saw nothing else. 
So being easily freaked out decided to take the dog home for the night.

summary: On Saturday 11-23-13 at approximately 7:15pm I let the dog outside to go to the bathroom.  The backyard faces south.  I looked up in the sky at about 45 degrees towards the southeast and saw 12…
description:
I went inside and yelled for everyone to hurry up and get outside and look at the sky. My husband, Sam Powell, and my neighbor who was over visiting, Zebbie Wassom, came outside. I counted 10 lights in the sky. We all watched for a few minutes. There was no noise. I saw new lights emerge from the distant southeast at about 30 degrees in the sky. They appeared more of a flaming red color. The lights followed an arcing pattern through the sky. (Appearing in the southeast, moving northwest, moving west, moving southwest, then moving south and disappearing. All this activity occurred in the southern part of the sky.) Some lights were further apart from each other. Some lights were higher than others but not by more than about 5 degrees. Some lights appeared to change speed slightly. Some lights appeared to change direction slightly. As the lights got closer they all appeared more of an orange color.
	We all went back inside. My husband got out the phone book. Zebbie and I grabbed our cell phones and went back outside. It was 7:20 pm according to my cell phone as Zebbie called her husband who was at home across the street and told him to look out the window towards the south in the…

summary: On 11-23-2013, Saturday, about 7:15pm, my family, a guest and I went out back of my home to play with our dog.  The sky was clear. While there we were looking around into the sky and the…
description:
They appeared to be a bright fiery read in color and changing to an almost orange color. I would guest they were not as far away as the stars. We got as quiet as possible to notice if there was any sounds. We noticed none. Then, the further they went to the northwest they would stop and move back and forth toward one another, like they were playing, then stopping and going. They seem to be in some random formation. 
Suddenly the first several would disappear to the south of where I reside, then more would appear from the southeast. This display lasted from about 7:15 pm until about 7:25 pm.
I then called three media stations, KREM-2; KXLY-4 and KHQ-6 and none of them seem to be interested in my conversation, at all.

summary: Strange lights in the sky .
description: Outside on my deck , I looked up in the sky and seen these reddish lights (6-8) moving in a strange formation. South west in the sky roughly a few miles off from my location. The lights did not appear to be flashing. Video to follow

summary: Very bright circle of light that did not move for as long as I saw it (about 45 minutes).
description:
Very bright white circle in the sky for about 45 minutes. 
I don't know exactly how long it was out because I was on my way to a movie when I saw it. 
When I came out of the movie at about 11:30, the bright light was gone.

summary: Very Bright Stationary Light Seen Over Surry, Virginia.
description:
My husband & I were driving home in James City County, VA, & noticed a VERY bright star-like light hovering in the directing of Surry, VA. We observed it for approximately 15 minutes. It was larger & lower than a star. It hovered. It looked like a really large, bright, low, star. Some cloud cover occured & it disappeared. We waited about 10-15 minutes for it to return but it did not. 
We decided to drive up & down the Colonial Parkway to see if we could see it from that direction & we could not. It was simply gone. 
Never saw it before tonight.

summary: Possible UFO Sighting in Lake Wylie, SC.
description:
On the night of November 23rd, around 7:05 pm/19:05, I was leaving my townhome in Lake Wylie, SC, when one of my kids looked up and asked me “what is that.” I looked up to my Left and saw 5 reddish/orange lights moving from the West to S. West across the sky. Distance is unknown, but they appeared to be moving in an irregular format with one moving close to another, then back and up in formation. There was a lead one as can be seen in the video with the other 4 trailing.
Their appearances got brighter and dimmed quickly and within the course of the sighting they disappeared one by one. These objects were intersecting the flight path of the Charlotte Douglas airport as the flights typically fly in and out at this hour at night. 2-3 helicopters were also seen coming in from the direction of the Charlotte Douglas airport shortly after the sighting.
The event, from my perspective can be seen on youtube at the following link:
http://youtu.be/bBAQjBNfFAQ
