summary: I saw what I thought was a star but moving fast from horizon south to north, object zig zgged, looped, changed directions erratically suddenly stopped hoovered, change direction very fast, object had…
Ball of light South West of Sturgis, Mi. looked like an extremely close and bright planet but vanished suddenly.
description:
Was outside tonight looking to the south west when a friend and I noticed a giant orb of white light hovering in the sky making no noise. 
We thought it was possibly Venus, but the light appeared to have some sort of tail like a comet, but was stationary and not moving across the sky. As we started to look it up online I noticed that it started to shrink in size suddenly to the size of a distant star and then faded into darkness. Why were we able to view it for so long sitting in one place, but then it vanishes in 10 seconds from the time that it started to shrink. We both have very good eye sight. I thought I'd look up what it was and I found this page. I spend a lot of time out in the country at night gazing at the stars while out hunting coyotes. I can tell the difference between a jet, helicopter, ect. I can't explain this one. 
Anyhow, last week while hunting in Laporte, IN, I saw 2 balls of light just like this one over Kingsbury FWA. I wish I would have ! got pictures. Oh well. Anyone else see the light tonight SW of Sturgis, Mi?
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: v shaped moving slow over houses
description: Moved slow above 50 ft over roof top of houses. Darkened spot in the sky very few lights. Clear sky most stars were visible. Made no noise

summary: A light over Rhode Island for more than 10 days
description:
My office, my partner, and our boys, have all been watching this light since November 15, 2013. It is mostly over eth airport. A light sitting, no movement, lower than planes. But shines like a huge light. 
What I found most interesting is that other people are noticing it and talking about it.
If the time is p.m., we suspect Venus. PD

summary: Two bright lights in Santa Paula
description:
At approximately 4:41 pm me and my girlfriend were looking out of our upstairs bedroom window at the sunset. We were looking directly west. 
Earlier around 4:25 pm while driving home from dinner, she said she noticed a bright light appear. It moved to the north then vanished in the blue sky. 
When we were looking at the sunset from our room she had her I phone ready ( just in case). As we were enjoying the sunset , we noticed a small in coming plane. We live close to the Santa Paula airport. Two bright lights appeared. They seemed to be much farther distance from the plane. I would describe them as much brighter than a star. The light at the top moved north at a high rate of speed then vanished in the blue sky. The light at the bottom right of the photo just appeared, then vanished. It was stagnant. Through my girlfriends photos we determined the lights were visible for approximately 60 seconds

summary: Heading Southeast on Hwy 2 from Priest River, Id, to Sandpoint, Id, at Wrenco Loop Road. Low flying projectile, mirror-like reflective surfaces, white colored.  Stealth fighter shaped. Low altitude,…
description:
We turned onto Wrenco Loop and tried to follow the trajectory and took one photo, but the aircraft does not appear in the photograph. 
It was quickly a tiny speck in the distance, much further than any hobby plane could be, too small to be manned, not a standard aircraft. 
Two witnesses. 
Called the local news, submitted the photo, odd streak in photograph, but no aircraft.

summary: An aircraft with very bright green lights plummeted out of the sky then flew unexplainable speeds back into the night sky.
description:
We were driving I-90 W at about 11:11 pm.
Witness # one's perspective: a white light approximately 6,000 ft appeared stationary Then accelerated to speeds that were unexplainable and disappeared. Upon acceration the light turned to two green lights on an oval shape craft.
Witness #2: An oval shaped craft with green lights appeared to plummet spinning towards the ground at an alarming rate of speed. At first it was thought to be an airplane that was going down but then it picked up to such speeds it was unimaginable and disappeared in the the night sky.

summary: Stayed in proximity 5 degrees north of moon.
description: Object was high in the east, about 5 degrees north of moon. Object would remain stationery then move erratically (up down right and left quickly). Bright like a plant.

summary: Unidentified Space Station.
description: Roughly for the last year I have been observing a rather "bright" star the has been staying in orbit within the moon as it travels across the sky. The thing I find puzzling about this object, is that there is so many lights in where I observe this object that it's the only visible thing in the sky besides the moon. Also I have no equipment to get a good picture of it, yet the one time I use the google star map app and pointed the smart device I was using directly at it, the device said that there should be nothing there. Only one time have I noticed something "leaving" and seem to disappear rather quickly after detaching from the object. Also, for the most part it keeps in orbit with the moon, but sometimes it seems to just roam all over the sky.

summary: Very Bright Aqua Blue Light in Shape of Cone.
description:
Was sitting in my living room listening to Coast to Coast AM on my shortwave Radio, I had no lights on, and was looking out of my Bow window which faces directly North.
It was a very rainy misty night/morning. I am surrounded for many miles in all directions by very thick Forest, except for the the frontage to the North.
The Frontage/Clear is in the range of 2,000 feet and beyond that is the tree line, which is mostly forest to the Canadian Border (40 miles). The cloud deck was very low (700-900 feet) I estimate. 
Suddenly, as I just happened to be looking to the NNW, a very bright aqua blue light in the shape of a cone turned on facing directly South! and then Scanned right below the cloud deck about 20 degrees to the West and just as abruptly as it turned on it shut off (No Fading) of the light. I have never seen a light source as bright as this lightsource was ever in my 57 years of Life!! I am always watching the skies here in upper Maine, and have not seen this light source again.
But I will still keep scanning the night skies up here,were there is no light pollution at all.
Thank You

summary: Silent v shaped ufo all white lights   not conventional aircraft lights
description:
I was walking outside and while i was looking at the stars i noticed a v shaped aircraft with all white lights on. 
The ufo had no tail lights no flashing beacon and no red or green lights. 
It was silent and moving faster than any aircraft that i have ever seen just seeing if anyone els saw what i saw

summary: Video taped a large multi-colored lighted object in the sky below Orion.
description: On the evening of November 22, 2013 at approximately 10:45pm I arrived home late from work. I live in Rome Georgia (45 mins North of Atlanta). My home is located on top of Mt. Alto. A small (3000ft approx) mountain. Two lane road with houses on both sides of the road. Very nice views north or south. As I was getting out of my truck I noticed what appeared to be a very bright star - but it looked "too close" to truly be a star. Plus it was blinking like planets blink. Sort of changing colors white-red-yellow but only slightly. The changes were not extremely noticeable. It was just twinkling - but again it looked too close and too bright to be a star. It was about approx 35 degrees or so up in the sky. Orion was up as well as the north star. The object was below Orions foot and to the left of the North Star. It was an extremely cold and clear night. No clouds whatsoever. I decided to go get a pair of my binoculars - but could only find a! pair of my kids - which are basically just toys. It actually made my view worse. I decided to see what my phone would do. I put it on video (Droid Razr Maxx) - Immediately I saw a distinct shape and set of lights in a row. Looked like the classic…

summary: Orange dim dark lights 1 on each side.  Invisible craft.
description:
Seemed to be trailing a plane then vanishes into clouds. 
Very close and no sound. Moved with perfect motion.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Massive structure with blue lights flying across sky
description:
Early winter of 2013, I stood out on my front porch to get some fresh air. It was around 10:30pm. I looked up to the sky because I saw blue light out the corner of my eye. It was to the right. At first I thought it was a shooting star because it was moving so fast. But as it flew further from me, I saw blue light from the left as well. 
That’s when I realized the lights were a part of the same structure. It appeared to be on the wings of a massive sort of flattened crescent shaped structure. And I mean massive. It stretched from one side of the sky to the other. If it were on the ground, it cover several miles. I couldn’t see the center and body of it well, but I could see where the lights were. The wings were thin and very aerodynamic looking. 
The body of it was shadowy. But, I could see the stars through the body of it as if it were kind of transparent. It was very fast and extremely quiet. That’s how I know it wasn’t man made. I’m ex-military and I’ve seen most of what we can do. 
Our technology is junk compared to this thing. We cannot create something so massive and so fast, yet doesn’t make a sound as it zipped across the night sky. 
I waited for news reports. I just knew…

summary: Dark wing or triangle shaped soundless object flying at low altitude and extreme speed.
description:
Unidentified craft was flying soundless below an airplane at a low altitude, and behind it traveling northbound. 
Then it veered left, westward, in a very short arc at a rate of speed I have never seen before. Extremely fast and again, no sound. 
The craft was a dark colored triangle or wing shaped with two very dim orange colored lights on the tips. 
The background of the area was dark as it was about 10:30pm. 
Overall the sighting lasted 5-7 seconds until it was out of sight.

summary: Very bright white light in northwestern sky.  White/red light to its lower right side.
description:
Very bright white light in the northwestern sky. I have seen it this past week also around the same time. 
Tonight, there was an additional white/red glowing light to the lower right of the bright white light. Both lights were stationary for at least an hour. 
I have looked up the night sky for tonight, and there are not supposed to be any stars, or comets in this direction.

summary: Two lights, three lights, four lights, gone!
description:
I was driving behind my wife on Butterworth. We turned onto O’Brien St and I was instantly drawn to two lights in front of me in the distance. At first I thought they were car lights but soon realized they were up in the sky.
The next thing that came to mind was a plane with its landing gear down and lights on. There just seemed to be something odd about them though. There was no red and they weren’t blinking at all. Just two bright white, almost blue lights. As big as the lights were, if it were a plane I think I would have seen it moving.
Now I’m thinking a brand new cell tower. As I got to where they were almost to my side up in the sky, I slowed the vehicle way down almost to a stop and looked for the tower itself. Realizing it was way too dark to see a tower at night, I focused back up on the lights again. Now there were three lights, all the same, in a triangular pattern.
I am now at a complete stop in the middle of the road intrigued by these lights. I decide to pull up off the road and am trying to do so without taking my eyes of the lights but have to look away to pull over. When I look back there are now four lights in a nonsymmetrical diamond pattern. Kind of like one…

summary: Orange/yellow fireball seen in northern sky near Humboldt Sk that was sighted by father and son.
description: A fireball in the northern sky above humboldt that lasted approximately 10 seconds. It was travelling from west to east. It had a long orange tail with the ball itself a combination of orange, red, and yellow. We've never.seen anything like it. It kind of flared up twice as it was perhaps going through layers of atmosphere. There must be more reports of others that witnessed the same.

summary: Bright red spheres flying in formation over Pemberton,  N.J., Burlington County.
description:
Walked upstairs to my front door when I noticed 2 small, bright, red lights from my front door. They were bright, like red flairs, and made no sound. 
They flew in a level manner, unlike what a flair would do. The speed was about what a helicopter would cruise at. One was at the 8 o'clock position, the other at the 2 Oclock position. 
At first I thought it was a large aircraft banked over way too far, but both lights were red. I then noticed the lights started separating but moving further away. 
They were approximately between 700-1,000 ft in altitude. They were moving approximately 52 degrees North East towards Joint Base MDL. 
The one at the 8 o'clock position began to slowly fade out like a flair does, and eventually disappeared. 
The one at the 2 Oclock position continued toward MDL, until it faded out like the other one.

summary: Bright light in sky, one red light to one side one green light to other side too fast to be a plane.  No noise heard when it passed
description:
At first thought it was a Chinese lantern but was still for around an hour before the object started to move. 
Lights came out from the object and sunk back in again as if to make you aware. 
Then there was movement and there was one red light at one side and a green/blue colour on the other. 
That is when we assumed it where a plane but the speed was too fast for any kind of "man made" craft. 
It then hovered over the flats we where in and changed direction still within our view to where it sat for another half hour. Then completely vanished.

summary: Two small orange glowing lights spotted traveling from west to east. No sound emitted, and lights traveled in a static manner.
description:
My two friends looked out their window and saw a small, glowing orange light at an unknown height in the air traveling from west to east. They yelled for us to come and see, and by the time the rest of us got to the window, there was a second orange light traveling on the same vector and at the same speed.
We watched it travel slowly and silently due east for about 45 seconds, unchanging and steady, until it disappeared behind the surrounding trees.

summary: Red objects above SLC
description:
I was making dinner and AGAIN noticed a large red object hovering in the western sky.
The object was stationary and seemed to glow. It was red, orange and yellow it emanated light and energy. 
Out of nowhere a second object appeared underneath and just slightly south. 
Then a third. 
The second object moved up towards the larger stationary object. The third object moved to the south and suddenly changed direction, heading the first object. It disappeared .
Planes flew right by this.
Much to my dismay the video I shot cut out right when the smaller object moved towards the big one.
This happens almost every night. It always varies in duration and movement .
I have found more people who are also seeing it but no one bothers to report it.
We are 60 miles away from Dugway proving ground and I for one would like to have some answers.
Who am I supposed to talk to about this? No one seems to care.
I am a professional business woman and I am putting myself out here in hopes that someone can help .

summary: Our first night in Cancun, we randomly ended up having dinner outside.  My wife (completely not a UFO believer) happened to notice something in the sky.
description:
Being a engineer and avid viewer of the sky, I suggested what we were seeing was a satellite or ISS. I noticed another light tracking a good distance behind which caused me to look directly overhead upon which we saw a cluster of lights in a completely random formation following the original two objects. 
The two objects and the cluster were only visible for at most a minute as they were traveling incredibly fast west to east toward Venus clearly visible in the sky. 
I quickly grabbed my phone and shot some video, but from my phone screen, only Venus is visible. 
When I get home, I will analyze the video further.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: oval shape craft with lights around attached to the craft. with haze
description:
I had seen the similar craft 5 times in Padang West Sumatra, the last time I saw it was last week. 
I reported here already 3x. Yesterday Friday, Nov 22, 2013, I was on my trip from Padang to Pekanbaru, about 200km from Padang at 7pm I saw the similar look craft in the sky, lower than usual.

summary: Two round lights one small, one big.
description:
i went out side to get the news paper and i look up in the sky and off to the sws direction i see this big bright light. and as i watch i see a smaller light break from it but stayed very close to the bigger light. 
and you could see like three or four flashing plane lights heading toward it from diffent directions. 
i have a small video of it but it dose it no justice of what i seen.
Possible sighting of Venus in SW sky? PD

summary: Bright red light performing maneuvers and landing
description:
(Addendum to earlier report) Earlier I described my sighting of a strange red light that I saw today. This light rose in the air about 200 yards in front of me and a friend while we were parked in my car facing NORTHWEST. This was around 5:40 EST. In a populated area with intersections, restaurants and bargain centers. The sun had gone down but it wasn’t totally dark yet. The object seemed to have structure but the light was all that could be seen.
When it first caught our attention it was rising from at least 50ft from the ground. As it rose slowly it seemed to come closer to us but mainly going straight up. It elevated around 500-600 ft then it stops suddenly and at that point we both were puzzled because this wasn’t normal flight maneuvers for anything I’ve seen in the sky and this was so close. There were no sounds coming from it. Now that it’s closer it appeared to me there were actually two red lights instead of one but both were bright and bled into each other. They were side by side but seemed to both be on one object. I couldn’t make it out clearly, but it looked like above the lights there was structure.
The object at that point seemed to slowly spin 180 degrees now…

summary: Solid structure with red light flying low performing controlled maneuvers
description:
Me and a friend were sitting in my car when we seen an object with a red light rise into the air about 150 to 200 yards in front of us. Our first thought was that it was a shiny red balloon but it rose straight up quickly maybe 500 ft in the air and just stopped suddenly and hung there. Just a solid red light.
Then it moved to the left a ways, then to the right. It moved unlike anything I've ever seen before. Changing speeds. 
I cannot guess how big it was. It wasn't very big, maybe the size of a car. The light also changed to white, as if it had turned around and I was looking at a different side to it. 
I got out the car to get a better look. It went away from me and lowered seemingly to the ground about a quarter of a mile from where it was before, and it got there quickly.
I could see the light go behind some trees in the distance. I kept watching for it to rise again and it did. It came back near the same area as before flying low and moving very deliberately and strict. 
There was no noise and the area of the sighting is very busy. 
There are busy intersections and many shops and strip malls. I'm sure others had to have seen it.

summary: Bright red objects over Raytown
description:
Looking north from my couch coming directly from the direction of the stadiums, I saw what first looked like a plane that may have been on fire, the light was bright red and moving about the same pace a small engine plane would move only no sound and seemed to be floating instead of actually flying. I used my binoculars and I saw what looked like an orb with fire in the center heading due south....and just as that one disappeared in the distance another appeared following the exact same path, and looked exactly the same.
I've never seen anything like it, and for the life of me can't think of anything that can fly man made that I can compare them to.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Brilliant blue flattened oval, small, about tree-top level
description:
I was traveling westbound on Rt 40 near Mechanics Valley Rd. I saw an extremely blue, small flattened oval traveling very solidly from left to right. It was very low to where I was and seemed to move purposefully. 
I was driving so had to watch traffic and when I glanced back up, it had already passed by.

summary: Three bright lights moving in unison then splitting up dramatically, later regrouping... power outage 4 hours later
description:
I am a researcher at one of San Diego's largest employers and I can say without a doubt that these objects had the ability to move beyond the gravitational forces that a human can experience without dying in a conventional gravitational field.
Three objects moved across the eastern san diego sky right at the cloud line in very mild San Diego thunderstorm conditions. 
At first the group of three moved in unison circling around in the clouds almost looking as if it was a very very low flying plane with one white light on the nose, and one on each wing. 
I have seen large low flying planes circling exactly in the same manner at the Miramar air show and there is a considerable amount of noise when this happens. These objects made no sound at all and after circling around several times within the clouds came out of the clouds and set still for a moment. 
They then dramatically split/jumped into different directions in a manner impossible with airfoil lifted craft. One headed north, the other went to the south.
After 5 minutes they were gone, then we spotted them in unison again 3minutes later, now flying much closer to the horizon at a high rate of speed about the same as a fighter jet…

summary: This was only caught on camera nothing seen by witnesses
description: Tried to take a picture of a rainbow the was visible with the cloud in the pictures however when the photos where transferred onto the computer we noticed the picture in question I know it's been a while since the picture has been taken and nothing was seen by the naked eye only on camera this was caught but curiosity has got the better of me

summary: Blue light fastly moving up and down
description:
We were sitting in the ferry line on Guemes Island and I looked up toward the south above state ferry direction. 
I saw a blue light moving slowly then it started to move up and down very fast and then shot off in the direction of the San Juan Islands. 
I watched it for between 7 and 10 min.
Time confirmed with witness. Boyfriend, who also witnessed object, may submit second report. PD

summary: It was an orange light in the shape of Chevrolet car logo.
description: While waiting for the stop light to turn green we looked up and there was a large object that was lit, orange and yellow. The shape was that of the Chevrolet car logo. It did not move for a good 15 seconds then I felt like it knew we were looking at it . It disappeared or at least it was not lit anymore but we could still see the shape. We were scared.

summary: Glowing orange spheres over Redmond, Oregon.
description:
Approximately 1:00 am: 
3 orange glowing spheres. Thought at first they were seasonal decorations, floating approximately 20' above a house. 
As we approached in our vehicle, it started to float slowly up like a balloon, then propelled northbound at incredible speeds. 
We immediately saw another sphere up the road that was also hovering about 20' above another home. A smaller orange glowing light was "dropped" onto the house before the sphere departed in a similar matter. 
Third craft was seen on our way home when we decided to go inside.

summary: 3 circles moving in the sky and disappeared about 5 seconds later.
description: Saw 3 bright circles moveing in the sky above the tree line. Then it disappeared.

summary: sited 2 bar shaped brightly lighted objects that changed shape
description:
2 objects, lights were red, white, changed from a bar shape to a pentagram shape, flying at a 30 degree angle, one mirroring the other from a distance, event took 20 mins
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Over our house, we saw a UFO that looked like it was changing colors and it was flying over between 30 minutes to an hour.
description: It was shaped like a circle with lights all around the perimeter. It looked like a glowing hoop.

summary: Strange Humming Noise Outside House.
description:
This report is being submitted for a relative. My adult relative was concerned and distressed about a strange noise she heard on the night of Thursday, November 21, 201,3 at 11:35 p.m. 
She was in bed sleeping soundly when she unexpectedly awoke to a loud sound that was right outside her window. It perplexed her and she seemed a little disturbed by the event. She said the noise was like that of machine, or a metallic noise, that was very loud, close to her window. She said the noise took on a certain high and low pitch and it started humming for a duration of 5 minutes. 
I asked if she got up or too look outside and said she did not. I gathered from her statement that she might have been too scared to do so, so no craft or lights were witnessed if there were any. We live in a small quiet neighborhood where six houses share a beautiful courtyard that is about 100 feet long by 30 feet wide. The front of our house and bedroom windows face the courtyard. 
My relative said the humming noise pulsated loud and said it sounded like it might have been hovering in the courtyard near our bedroom windows because she felt the pulsating vibrations through her window. We live south of Paine…

summary: Small changeing light moving different directions.
description:
For the second night out of three, I witnessed lights that changed colors from white to red and blue. 
Moving up down sideways in the sky for two minutes. It looked like a small flashing light.
Possibly a "twinkling" star?? PD

summary: Fireballs floating across sky then disappearing.
Massive craft slowly moving away from my position.
description:
I was walking out to my car tonight to go get dinner around 9:10PM. I always stop and take a good 360 degree look at the stars when we get beautiful clear nights like tonight. 
To my northwest maybe two miles away I noticed 2 flashing red lights that where approximately a quarter mile or so apart from each other. I also noticed that they were blinking in unison. This would not have been anything strange, except for the fact that they were slowly moving away from me at a very low altitude (maybe 1500-2000 feet), and that they moved in perfect unison together which lead me to believe these two blinking red lights were connected to ONE craft! It was very slowly traveling away from me. Slower than conventional aircraft fly. 
 Judging by the distance between the two red lights, this thing must have been massive!! I also get the feeling it maybe have been triangle shaped and I was seeing the rear part of the craft. But there was no visible propulsion systems and no noise. 
It traveled in a northwest course towards the Puget Sound. 
I work in aerospace building modern day commercial planes. I have never seen anything that large, that flies like what I saw tonight. It was so big I'm just…

summary: 4 orange flying object monroe wa
description:
Driving down 169th in monroe, wa, off e main street exit, I was riding as a passenger in my moms car, to a friend's house, when we saw 4 orange lights like balls of fire. They were aligned like a constellation. 
my mother and I parked and before i could even take a picture, one changed to like a white star like color, and flew straight up fast. two others did the same in different directions.one stayed the longest, then it took off. They were relatively low on the horizon but within 2 minutes they went from orange to star color, (white) and flew away

description:

summary: traveling fire ball in the sky.
description:
My family and I were having dinner and I was looking out the window as I am eating. 
I see a bright orange light traveling slowly towards our direction. I could tell it was no helicopter or plane. 
My husband and I stood up to go see it. It was right above us. It looked bright orange like a fire. 
We took pictures and studied it. 
My sister and granddaughter were next door watching it. My sister thought it was going to land and told her granddaughter to go inside. 
The burning light took a different direction towards the Valdez mountain and then dissapeared.

summary: Orange Objects Ascending Over Philadelphia.
description:
On the evening in question I was traveling northbound on 95 approaching the Aramingo avenue exit. I saw to my right several slowly rising objects from the northeast in my peripheral vision. I then focused my attention to the objects.
I counted approximately 12-15 of them. The objects appeared to be triangular in shape with a solid orange color. There were no visible navigation, beacon, or strobe lights, which are required on all civilian aircraft, and usually on military aircraft as well. I did not hear any sound from the objects, although I was traveling at highway speed and only briefly put the window down. The objects slowly gained altitude. I would estimate from approximately 150 ft AGL up to 12-1300ft AGL at which point I lost visual reference due to traveling in the opposite direction.
They appeared to originate from an approximate heading of 040º magnetic on an outbound of approximately 235º toward the downtown area. It appeared as if they remained in a tight formation of 2-3 craft in front, at a slightly higher altitude, 4 in a roughly arrow formation, and the remainder flew in sequence. The overall formation reminded me of the uneven arrow which geese fly in when heading…

summary: My friend and I spotted a orange orb hovering in the sky from the side of the road and I took pictures.
description:
I was going through some of my old photos that were saved to my Dropbox account, and I found two pictures of a strange object that my friend and I saw in the sky. Specifically, this friend was my sisters now ex-boyfriend, who I have not spoken with in a long time. The photos are dated 11/21/2013 and the timestamp shows around 7:30PM EST. At the time, my phone was automatically saving photos to my Dropbox account with the file name as the date and time, so I am certain this date and time is precise.
It was now over 10 years ago, but I will try to recall as many details as possible. We were driving southbound on a fairly rural road that I grew up near, I was riding in the passenger seat. While we were driving, we saw this glowing orange ball in the sky over the tree line to the southeast and decided to pull over further down the road and get out. We stopped by a field that is used to grow hay to get a clear view. In the one picture you can see the silhouette of a tree to the left. (You may have to turn up the brightness) This makes me think that we stopped right after the northern tree line that bordered the field, and I have marked the exact location on the map. We stood on the…

summary: Blue light which changed to orange travelling fast then disappeared.
description:
My husband and I were driving home the evening of 11-21-13, when we noticed a blue light traveling across the sky. 
The object was traveling at a high rate of speed, was blue in color, and after about 5 seconds the color changed to orange. 
It sped across our point of vision, changed colors, and then disappeared as it darted away.

summary: Steady Orb with tail
description:
As I was driving on the south west side of Fayetteville to the east I had spotted two aircraft. 
The first aircraft or orb maintained a steady altitude, then began to spiral downward. The color of the orb was bluish white. The orb had a tail when it spiraled, however, when it maintained a steady altitude the light emitting from the orb possessed a sphere shape. 
The second aircraft seemed to be flying near the orb almost as if the aircraft was observing the orb like object. 
The object did not seem to be a flare due to the movement and acceleration.

summary: 2 red lights blinking in the night sky.
description: I was outside smoking and I looked up and notice 2 red flashing lights very far apart from each blinking seconds after each other i am thinking this was a very large aircraft of some type, or 2 different aircrafts blinking insint ((sic. In synch??) from each other.

summary: Orbs dropping larger orbs into the ocean.
description:
Thursday, November 21st, 2013 Sandy Beach, Oahu, Hawaii 
Sometime between 11am and noon local time, my son and I were walking along Sandy Beach watching the bodysurfers when my son yelled, “Whoa, did you see that?” I did not see anything while we were on the beach but my son, who is 13, was quite impressed with what he witnessed. Below is his story in his own words: 
“We were watching the bodysurfers surfing the waves. I was standing near this big rock right by the ocean, looking out over the horizon when I saw an orb that was bright white, almost like a florescent light bulb but sphere shaped. The orb was about as big as a grapefruit. It had come from thin air, going very fast but slowed to a halted hover in a very small space. 
As soon as it slowed, it dropped an orb that looked the same as the other one but just bigger, like a soccer ball. The bigger orb dropped in the water and made a small splash. The small orb hovering in the air flew off and disappeared in a flash, literally. 
I looked down at the water where the orb had fallen but there was nothing there even though I saw a little splash. 
I looked in the sky again to see if there were more orbs. I scanned the horizon and…

summary: Single fireball hovering in Lockport at the Niagara County/Erie County border.
description:
First noticed the fireball while traveling south at Ohio St and the Lockport Bypass. It was hovering in the south west sky around the Niagara County and Erie County border in Lockport.
I traveled south onto Bear Ridge Rd and turned off at Fisk Rd, once I got to Transit Rd and headed south it was gone. 
I know it wasn't a plane because soon after it disappeared a plane was making its rounds towards the Buffalo airport, which is a sight I am familiar with every morning.

summary: Bright light triangle hovering then swiftly changing directions the other way
description:
We came up on a road over looking a field. And saw this big bright shining light when we stopped it stopped like it was trying to trick us. 
Me and my friend tried to chase it in his car. When we drove down about a mile down the road we had caught up to it. 
It was triangle and in had one big spot light pointing to the clouds 2 flashings lights on opposite ends and was hovering over us once we caught up to it and it was just above the tree line. No more then 20 feet above them, when all of the sudden it just stopped and took off the other way. 
It barely made any sound but maybe a light roar. Nothing like it should of sounded .

summary: White lights, triangle shape, low altitude, slow speed.  I have a military backround.
description:
Driving home, as we approached our driveway we noticed what we thought was an aircraft flying over the property. 
We quickly realized that this was not a plane or helicopter as it was flying at a very slow speed no more than 200-240' above the field. 
The craft had three very intense bright lights in a triangle shape with three not so brights in between along the inside edge.
We quickly pulled into the driveway and hopped out and ran into the field just as it proceeded over the treeline. 
The craft could not have been going faster than 40-60 MPH and made no noise whatsoever. 
The craft was 25 yards in length at most.

summary: Bright orange cylinder spiraled in sky
description:
Driving along wexford bayne rd on the way to a store my boyfriend, and I looked up and saw extremely bright orange cylinder shape spiral in the sky for about 15 seconds, and then disappear. 
I've never seen anything like it in my life while looking at the stars. It wasn't a street light. It was in the sky and it was so bright. 
We both work all the time and had the day off today so we have been out and about doing different things and then out of nowhere we saw this thing appear and disappear in a matter of moments.

summary: 6-10 white lights in a V formation flying south at hight speed.
description:
From my porch, facing west, I saw a V shaped formation of 6-10 pale white lights traveling south. They were very faint and hard to focus on. They seemed far away, but fast moving.
There was no strobe lights or red lights. I'm not sure, but each light may have been a separate craft since the lights may have been moving slightly in relation to each other (as if they were not lights affixed to a single object). But, I'm not sure of this since they were hard to focus on, and my view of them was quickly obstructed by trees/houses as they flew behind them. If they were separate objects, they were definitely flying in a strict V shaped formation, like ducks/geese.
All aircraft I've seen at night around here have at least one red light and a strobe light, never more than 3-4 lights.
There was no noise.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: I saw 3 small but bright lights floating.
description:
At first I thought they were stars but then I realized they were moving following one bigger object. The bigger object had 5 bright lights coming from it, and looked like the shape of a saucer. 
Then they started moving faster and one by one they were disappearing over the freeway.

summary: Four orange/red orbs seen in Nogales, AZ sky
description:
Observed three red/orange lights traveling North in the Western sky. They disappeared and then reappeared. 
Two seemed to join, then separated, appeared again and then the group was joined by a fourth. 
Was this a UFO or pieces of the Australian satellite that reentered our atmosphere last week? 
A beautiful scary and exciting moment. 
Over so soon, for trees blocked my view.

summary: Four large yellow/orange round lights in the night sky.
description:
It was about 9pm on November 20, 2013 when my wife and I were sitting in our living room and my wife noticed four bright yellow lights in the northern sky. They were lined up in a slightly jiggered line from left to right.
One disappeared and then came back.
This went on for several minutes, then they simply vanished. There was no sound during this event.

summary: I went out on my back porch and lit a cigarette and something caught my eye.
description:
I have stared out in the sky before and thought a star was moving when it was actually an illusion. This was different. 
This UFO was changing direction left, right, side to side, in circles, and sideways figure 8's. 
The elevation changes both up and down were dramatic and took about 1-2 seconds. 
The color resembled the color of a star but at times, appeared to be omitting a reddish tiny with every once in a while a little sparkle of blue. 
I pulled my compass out from my phone and I was facing northwest at approximately 330 degrees facing northwest. 
This was such a strange and unusual experience.

summary: Triangular solid blue light flying over South end of Diablo Range in Hollister
description:
November 20, 2013 8:00 p.m.
Saw triangular solid neon blue light in the sky over Hollister, CA. Flying from North to South under the cloud level. 
Was there for about 6 to 7 seconds before I lost sight. 
Was completely silent, moved faster then an ordinary plane but at a constant speed. 
Once it was over the south end of the Diablo Range, it spiraled downward twice, then at an accelerated speed disappeared behind the hills.

summary: Large, very Low, very slow flying triangular object with a light a each point.
description:
Driving southwest at approx. 6:25pm, I noticed two lights 300 feet or so above the tree line. 
I watched them for several seconds trying to figure out what it was I was seeing. 
I then pointed them out to my husband and he had no idea. We continued to drive and then noticed the third light, as we were catching up to it. It was dark in color, dull, trianglular with a light at each point. Flying very low and very slow. We were driving about 15mph.
I poked my head out of the window to see more clearly and did so, also noticing that the craft made no sound. It was quite large.
Sun was down, and it was cloudy/overcast.
At first we thought it was a plane flying under the clouds until we realized it wasn't moving much at all and then saw the third light, outlining the shape. All we can say it was very strange. 
This morning I looked up to see what Orange County drones looked like, still trying to figure out what is was. No comparison.

summary: Red/orange lights moving east to west over Pittsburgh, all the same speed, then winking out.
description:
At approximately 6:20 pm on 11/20/2013, we spotted several orange lights in the sky, in some semblance of formation. It started with two side by side objects, moving approximately east to west, one winked out after about 2 minutes, then the other disappeared. Then two more came across the sky, then one, then another two. They moved fairly slowly, all the same speed.
This continued for about 20 minutes. There was no sound associated with the phenomenon, and the evening was very quiet.
My boyfriend noticed them while we were driving home, and we continued to watch after arriving home until no more lights were in the sky. We tried to take videos, but our phones couldn’t get the lights in the dark sky.

summary: Several orange fireballs all perfectly spaced and moving at the same speed.
description:
Around 6:15pm, I was sitting in my car in a parking lot talking to my grandmother, when I noticed something out of the corner of my eye. 
At first, I thought it was a plane, but it had a red/orange glow and looked like sparks were falling off it, kind of like when a rocket takes off and sparks and embers fall off. 
There were several and they were perfectly spaced and moving at the exact same speed. Then there would be a lull and then more would come. 
I took two videos but they really don’t do what I saw justice. 
I watched the news to see if anyone had reported it and there was nothing on the news which kind of freaked me out even more. 
I so want to know what they were!!

summary: White blue light in sky appears and hyperdrives away like it never happened.
description:
I work in the oilfield here in Alaska, and I'm driving back to the shop to finish my work day. 
While I'm at the stop sign a white blue light flies overhead in the sky at a fast pace for 5 seconds, then shot forward and disappeared. 
You probably won't believe me, I'm finding it hard to believe myself but I know what I saw and it wasn't a plane or light reflection from something else, it was definitely its own light source. 
I wish I could've gotten a picture with my iphone, no one will believe me. But at least I know now,
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

About 20 minutes later one similar object in the eastern sky, same colors and pulsing bright to fade then disappeared. 
Could have been a coincidence but witnessed a satellite high above racing over the sky, southern sky to northern. Speculating trying to acquire visuals?

summary: Row of Bright White/Yellowish Lights

Last night 11/20/13, around 6 PM, I was driving home north on I-93 in New Hampshire (around New Hampton/Sanbornton). I was in between exit 22 and 23 heading north.
All of a sudden I noticed a kind of line of bright lights (Kind of like the old fashion street light= white with a yellowish/orange tint). There were about 5 in row..... I was looking up ahead through the windshield and was puzzled by what I saw. 
Then the lights pretty much faded out one at a time.... I did not see movement, nor did I see any type of craft, just these lights and as soon as I noticed them, the started going out. It seemed that the lights went out one at a time from right to left. 
It was quick and only lasted for a quick couple of seconds. 
Definitely not an airplane, lights were two big and bright and definitely not stars... much larger than stars....
Not sure what it was, but it was quick and it was odd.... out of place...and the lights started going out one at a time as soon as I noticed them…
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Circle changed shape white lights suspended over house changed formation and up they went

I pulled over to photo them. As I did again they changed formation till the were in a vertical straight line then they went up and disappeared. 
No noise round lights with a slight bounce as they were suspended in the air stationary. 
I have pictures of them.

summary: Group of lights seen over Thetford, Vermont.
description:
I was driving north on I-91 when in the direction of NNW I saw four very bright and large lights (I thought it was a meteor) disperse. 
They then gathered back to a small, faint blinking light. 
Five seconds later, they dispersed again, then vanished. The faint blinking light began to travel southwest. 
I'm guessing the craft was over or near Thetford Center, VT when I saw it.
We wonder whether the correct time might have been 5:50 p.m., 1750 hrs.. However, source of report chooses to remain anonymous, and provides no contact information. Hence, we are unable to contact the person. We have amended the time above, so the report conforms to the time of the many other sightings from New England on this date. PD

Then we realized that it wasn't because it was in the wrong location and then it just disappeared. 
Then about 2 minutes later we turned left onto West Shore Rd and several more bright orange balls appeared in the sky toward the NW. They came into the sky quickly and brightly. They lined up in a row or formation and we saw 6 of them. 
We immediately found a place to pull over to watch them. 
My husband turned on his video recorder on his phone and we both got out of the car to watch them. There was another vehicle parked by us and the gentleman in it got out to observe them too. They went from orange to a bright whitish color and then went dim. 
Then all of a sudden they started flashing different bright lights (red, yellow,white) and more appeared. Then they took off in different di! rections rapidly. As they were leaving they would flash brightly every few seconds. 
All 3 of us were mesmerized by how they were flying off so fast and we could see their flash way off in the distance. My husband did get…

summary: Over North Central Vermont:  Three large stationary red lights in a triangle for 15 seconds then simultaneously disappear.
description:
3 red lights, about 5x the size of Venus, were in a triangle to the SE of Woodbury VT. I saw them for about 15 seconds. They were stationary, then all three disappeared simultaneously. The distance between them was about a hand width held up, and about 30 degrees above the horizon. Two on the bottom, one on top equidistant.
About 10 minutes later I saw intermittent white flashes that were quite far away. There were a minimum of two dozen that were concentrated in the SE, covering an area about the width of my hand held out across the horizon. They were low, about 5 to 10 degrees above the horizon. Then a single red light, the same as the first three reappeared in the same area of the sky as before between my location a the flashing lights. It stayed for about 10 seconds then vanished. 
I kept seeing the flashing lights spreading outward and upward along the horizon. They would fade out, then reappear. I could not count the number, there were many flickering in varios places in a larger and larger area, maybe 3 handwidths. 
They became less frequent and faded out. At first I thought the were UFOs, then I realized that they were probably scrambled fighter jets.

description:
On Nov 20th, 2013, I was driving home from work heading south on I-89. I had just come to the top of the big hill and was passing the Berlin exit on my right when I looked to my left and out over the city of Berlin I was what looked like up to 7 large (maybe the size of a pea if you were to hold one out in your hands at arms length) bright orange lights. 
I watched for a few seconds as the light stayed stationary in an odd slightly uniform geometric shape, maybe something that would resemble the corners of say an octagon or possibly a six sided star then a few of the lights" faded out," except three that stayed in a large triangular shape for maybe another second or two then they faded out as well. 
The size of the formation was maybe the size of ones fist, i.e. if you held out your fist, it would roughly cover the array of lights.
I reached for my phone to turn on the camera and try to get a picture, but they were gone by then. The sighting lasted possibly 5-7 seconds roughly. 
The skies were perfectly clear and bright with no clouds and no limit to ones visual range. 
I would say that the direction I was looking in was South possibly South West.

I heard a loud steady noise coming from outside. The noise was a loud hum; like if you were close to some kind of giant electrical machine or generator of some sort.
When I got outside the humming was all around. I couldn’t tell which direction it was coming from. I walked to the front of my house but didn’t see anything. So I walked to the side of the house and from the corner of my eye I started seeing something what appeared to come out of nowhere.
I believe I was looking in the direction of what would be the side of it. At first it looked like a radio tower up in the air and horizontal. I could not see the object until it was just going past me which revealed the rear of it. As the object was passing by the “rear” was coming into view and what looked like little red lights at first turned out to be large rectangular red lights.
My best guess with the dimensions is it was 200-300 feet wide x 20-30 feet tall but could not tell how deep it was. It wasn’t until it stated passing me when I could really see it.
There were 4 rectangular lights a least 20 feet high by 50 feet wide. It looked like there may have been other lights that were not on or were dimmed but the 4 bright red…

summary: Bright light seen all day into the night.  Solid light and flashing it would would/is moving around the sky.  It is visible all across MA
description:
The light has been here for quite some time. It would normally be visible every other week and be intermittently in the sky until it disappeared. Not moved away but the light would eventually dim out and disappear. 
As of this week, it has been visible every single day and night.
My first sight of it yesterday would have to I guess be around 01:00 am. I went to sleep and woke up the next day only to see it has I was picking my son up from the bus as he got home. I was taking pictures of chemtrails and when I went inside to look at the pics I could see the "Orb" or "light source." It stayed visible for the rest of the night. It was visible from here all the way to Hyannis, Ma.
It was not stationary. It would move across the sky to the east then back west. It would move lower and then higher as well. There was WAY too much movement for it to be anything that was part of our Solar System. Around 7:00 pm it began to flash & move. Intermittent flashes as it would dim out and then get brighter while it was doing so.
Over the past Month I have been cross referencing its location with star maps and every app I could download with augmented reality. Nothing is there. NOTHING. Nothing to…

Weather: Mostly clear with light, very scattered, thin cirrus clouds. Dark, very little twilight in eastern horizon.
Description: No autos following me or oncoming. I was travelling west of Benton City, WA, east of Prosser, WA, on Interstate 82 westbound. 
Pale, perhaps translucent and gaseous, fluorescent green streak or cylinder originated from above towards ground, with lower end squared off, with rounded corners, as though ended with gaseous cloud at its termination. 
No actual object seen or right spot to indicate an object entering the atmosphere, appeared to be a vapor trail. It was not bright as in a meteor event and lacking the “sparks” commonly seen departing from main meteor in its travels. 
Never seen anything like this in my 53 years.

summary: Bright fireball object.
description:
I was driving down the road coming from Carlsbad, NM, direction, heading to Artesia, and right around mile marker 45 I seen what I thought was a light tower out of place and super bright, 
At that moment it started to raise in elevation, it was only a 1/2 mile away so I got a good view if it. 
It went up about 300 feet then dimmed out like a fire burning out, then 3 seconds later it lit back up and changed directions and went up another 50 feet and disappeared.

summary: My employee and his wife witnessed two lights in the sky that lingered for most of an hour before disappearing.
description:
This was witnessed by one of my employees and his wife while my employee was working the graveyard shift last night.
At approximately 0400 US central time, my employee walked outside of the plant for a security check. He observed due east of our location a pulsating light in the sky that at first appeared to be a star or planet. From his perspective it was about the same size as a bright star or planet like Venus, but again, the light was pulsating from relatively dim to bright, back to dim then back to bright, etc. The apparent altitude was about two fingers' width above the horizon.
After he had been watching it for about 20 minutes off and on (he was in and out of the plant checking operations) his wife arrived to bring him some food while on her way to work. This was at about 0430. They were both watching it when she spotted a second almost identical pulsating light that he hadn't previously seen move from the north side of the original object to its south side.
After the second object moved to the south side of the first object, the first object started to move higher into the sky, as though gaining altitude without moving in any other direction, forward, backward, or…

summary: Orange ball over Sun Lakes, AZ, fell from sky.
description:
Orange ball above tree line. Was still for a few minutes Then it dropped straight down.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: We saw 3 objects in the sky.
description: Multi colored lights appeared over my pasture toward Livingston State Park. The first one was over the trees with 5 lights vertically aligned. The lights were red and yellow. While watching this object a second, smaller version appeared behind the first one. I noticed another small object beginning to descend over my pasture, within 30 yards of my home. I approached and tried to take a picture but it would not appear in the view finder. The lights would not show. I could hear a sound like a child's toy helicopter. There was no actual helicopter chopping air sound just a steady whirring. The object descended very slowly but I couldn't make out the object due to the darkness. It appeared in the dark to resemble the shape of a dragonfly. It was so close that I became fearful trying to take a picture. The object then lifted straight up and disappeared into the darkness after going south from my home. I then turned my attention back to the large object! which had descended partially behind the tree line. My boyfriend said he thought it was a cell tower, however; I explained that we would have noticed it by now since we are outside every evening. As we were discussing what it could be…

summary: An orange fireball moved in the sky near Washington, D.C., turned direction and "burned out".
description: At first I thought it was a plane/helicopter as there is a lot of air traffic in this area. Then I realized no blinking lights, just a bright, solid orange color. It was moving steadily, but then a small blue light broke off and burned out. Then the orange "fireball" appeared to slow down to an almost stop. It moved in a slightly different direction, then disappeared.

summary: Bright Aircraft Emitted Sparks and Disappeared.
description:
Was standing outside, saw a bright reddish-orange object in the sky moving way too slowly to be a plane, then it flamed/flashed bright reddish-orange, what looked like sparks were emitted, and sped up; at which point I called my friend out to look at it. We watched it travel a short distance across the sky, flash brightly again, emit sparks, then change directions and begin going East towards the ocean at which point it appeared to get smaller and smaller until it disappeared completely. 
Second one we saw tonight, first one was only seen by my friend and was a few miles from where this was seen.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: 9 orange-red circles in the western sky that faded out over 10 minutes.
description:
My wife got home from work around 8:15pm. She came in and asked me to come outside to see something. 
I walked outside barefoot into the cold and looked up to see 9 lights in the sky. We were looking to the western sky. 
The crafts were an orangish red color and circular. There were no light tails, just the colored balls. 8 of them were grouped together, 4 on top and 4 on bottom flying south (left). They were not in perfect formation. The 9th craft was flying the opposite direction to the north (right).
About a minute after observing 4 of the crafts flying south faded out quickly like they had started flying further west out of sight or just disappeared. Similarly the one flying north had disappeared as well. 
The remaining 4 flew slower still south a few more minutes. The one going north that had gone away reappeared and changed course to go south. The 4 others faded out like the first 4 had withing 10 seconds.
I then tracked the one remaining that had re-appeared and turned south for 2 minutes. It got brighter for a about 20 seconds like it might be getting closer then it did the same as the others. It took about 10 seconds and faded out.
I watched the skies for another 5…

summary: Triangle shaped hovering lights.
description:
One large triangle shaped light formation, 3 bright white lights, one blue and one red. Hovering about 300 feet over housing area. "Chased" two smaller lights. The larger light shot forward , disappeared and reappeared going in the opposite direction. The smaller lights moved after it. Shortly after this happened three military aircrafts flew in the direction of the sighting.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Red flashing orb/fireball seen near Front St. in Kansas City, Missouri
description: I was driving South on 435 from Liberty to Front Street exit to meet my ex and pick up my girls and noticed a red flashing light. At first I thought it might just be a very bright light on a radio tower but as I got closer I could see it was not attached to anything and was 3 or 4 times higher than the towers around it. I parked the car and watched to see if it was moving. It was moving very slowly straight across the sky and then would stop and move the other way. It flashed on and off just like the lights on top of the towers. I watched it for 5 minutes and then decided to get closer underneath it, so I drove to the train yard it was up above. It stopped flashing and was just a dim orangish, red color, and I could barely see it against all the street lights when I got close to it a couple minutes later. I drove back to the spot I parked at and couldn't see it anymore. A white light had appeared in that direction and looked like a plane coming in for a landing just to the north of Front St. and right off the highway. I'm not too familiar with the location but I know there is not an airport. It is very industrial and has lots of trains and big warehouses around. I don't know if it…

summary: Three Orange Spheres in a Rectangular  Cluster with a Pulsating Sphere on the Right Side
description:
My sister and I were walking our dog. It was a clear crystal night with no clouds in the sky. There was a cluster of three orange spheres in a rectangular shape. These spheres remained in a hovering position. The spheres were very close together and maintained a hazy appearance. On the right portion of the rectangle, there was a pulsating sphere. 
We went to go show our friend and not even two minutes later, coming back to the exact same spot, the lights were gone.

summary: Bright Electric Blue Light over Indian Trail, North Carolina
description:
My family went outside our home looking north to see the launching of 29 satellites from Virgina. 
Myself, my wife and my two children then noticed a electric blue round light to the east comming towards us at a high rate of speed, about 10,000 ft. In the sky. 
As soon as it approached we pointed at it and it immediatly stopped, turned red and maneuvered quickly at a downward right position, turned white and returned to where it had came from very quickly and disappeared from sight. 
About 5 minutes later, it again came from same location and height in the sky, electric blue again, circled and turned white and left very quickly in the same fashion as the first time. 
Another 3 minutes pass and a final time the blue light came slowly towards us in the same fashion the other times, blinked red turned back to blue and, without stopping, shot backwards without turning or slowing down, and disappeared and didn't return. 
This ufo was visible for about 2 min combined from all three sightings. 
It was unmistakabley not something any of us had seen before, never made a sound and was travelling at such a high rate of speed it could not have been a manmade aircraft, heli, or balloon.

summary: Object moving fast, slowed, hovered, then faded away,
description:
Reddish orange indistinct object seen for more than 3 minutes in far distant nighttime sky traveling in my general direction east to west much faster than an airplane, then slowed, then hovered maybe 8 miles away and 5 miles altitude, then slowly faded away. 
One minute of not seeing anything, then an exact repeat for less than two minutes.
For some reason, witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: 10-12 bright orange spherical balls of light, some turning away from others, and one coming in close
description:
On November 19th, I was filming sunset with my HTC-one cell phone. After seeing strange, odd crafts flying during sunset I stayed and continued filming after it got dark. 
I first seen around 4 bright orange/red orbs, perfectly spherical and, not flickering or flashing like lanterns. They were flying from north east to west. I watched as one of them made a slow right turn away from others and all vanished soon after. 
I did not have my cell on during the first set, the cell battery was dying and I had to use cigarette lighter to charge. But then two more came in from same direction, flying next to each other. 
 One of them made the same slow right turn away from me before disappearing. The other stayed straight, then also disappeared. Moments later I watched one fly in by itself. Then another by itself, but this one was much closer than the others. It came in just as fast as others, but slowed down while in flight. There were a few more that came by, whole event lasted around 7-8minutes. 
This was one of the most amazing things I've ever seen, I'm glad I had my new cellphone to share this experience. I am not happy how it came out, the video is great with amazing close-up. But the…

summary: Three red lights in horizontal formation.
description:
Saw three red lights in a perfect horizontal formation hovering above neighborhood area looked to be within several hundred feet. Appeared to be the side of a large hovering aircraft. 
Slowly and steadily hovered from the south to the east part of sky for about 10 minutes until the lights slowly went out one by one. Was silent. 
Military aircraft seemed to be in the air before and after incident as I observed trails in sky. 
Called friend who lived in same area on phone during incident but they were unable to view it from their residence due to obstruction.

summary: Bright red/blue/red lights at mid-point in sky, lights in a vertical formation.  No sound.  Moving very slowly in western direction.  Too low altitude to be jet, moving too slow to be airplane, no…
Bright orb hovering and dancing around the car, in Mt. Airy, next to Pilot Mountain, NC
description:
On Nov 19 at 6:35 PM we were driving on highway 103 going south toward Mt. Airy, Nc. We saw A BLUE white orb with a darker shape behind it. It was beside us on the right, twenty feet from the car. It wove in and out of the trees at the same speed as we were traveling. (55-60MPH) It blasted way up in the sky in front of us, (shooting left to get directly in front,) higher than the trees on the hills, then stopped and hovered for three seconds and then shot down, toward the right, behind the trees. It was gone. The whole thing last for thirty seconds.
Our cell phones didn't work for several minutes. We slowed down and saw a deer on the side of the road. She was a huge doe and seemed very disoriented. She was looking across the road, into the woods and didn't notice our car. The fur on the left side of her neck seemed roughed up, like it was wet and pushed up. She was solid brown (no white) and there were no other deer around her. We had to swerve around her and she did not move or look away from the woods.

summary: Triangle, rounded leading edges reddish /pink glow at tips of wing, white left to right pulsing light at rear.
description:
It was 6:20 pm. We had arrived back at my home in the country where my friend's van was parked. It was past dusk and a fairly clear night. Normally when I come home and the lights from the car hit the chicken coop the chicken are out wanting to get fed, along with the cats and dogs. 
The 1st thing I notice the only ones out where a couple cats. . 
My friend got out and said what that is and pointed up. I look up above the trees (a good estimate is 250 to 500 ft. off the top of the oaks) was a huge triangle shape object. It was big the; tip of say the forward edge of the left side was by the pool and the leading edge of the right was over the trees in to the back yard. I would say bigger than a C5A Galaxy even bigger that that big Russian heavy-lift plane I seen In Bosnia. 
I could almost make out what appeared to be seams in the material but it was not shiny, duller and like carbon fiber. The leading edge was rounded and there was no tail to say, (in today’s aircraft everything has a vertical stabilizer with a stabilizer or ailerons. Sort of like a big T or a little t. The anti-collision lights go on top, bottom, left and right.) This had none of those. 
The object appeared to be…

summary: Three red lights moving in the sky.
description:
I saw three red lights in the sky and they were slowly moving upwards in a vertical line, then the lights would dim and I could make out a round object. They would light up again, and move around, and then up and down. I saw other people pointing up and looking at it, and then I did as well, this kept going on for at least two hours before I went in the house, not sure if they are still out there.

summary: Short line of bright white lights w/ red center + small triangle
description:
Just after dark I saw a short line of bright white lights maybe 6-9 in total with a slow red strobe low in the center, very close together in front and slightly to the left of me, almost a solid line. It appeared stationery, a few seconds later I came to a stop sign I saw it move very slowly to the right behind a hill in front of me. I made a left hand turn drove about 15 seconds and then made a right turn and pulled over. In the area a bit to the right of where I parked, where the lights should been I saw what I thought was a helicopter. 3 dim pinpricks of white light in a perfect triangle with a dim slow blinking red light ditectly in the center. The triangle, from my perspective, was the size of a U.S. Quarter held at arms length moving about the same speed as a helicopter would. It moved in a straight line away from me to the right of my parked car, as the triangle left I saw and heard a high flying large jet with its lights blinking very high above me and moving roughly in the opposite direction of the triangle. I tried to take a video but my cell phone camera didn't even pick up the stars around the triangle.
 We see small private aircraft around here every day. Dane county…

summary: Unidentified foreign obeject was seen flying over New Mexico
description:
11/24/2013 To whom it may concern: My mother and I decided to go to the store for some grocery shopping. On our way to the store, we came to a complete stop. 
I happened to look in the sky and see 3 blue lights. They seemed pretty low to the ground, but thought nothing of it. They stayed pretty even and straight, so our minds went to the thought of it being a plane just flying really low. 
We went to the store, and went on with our night. Coming home from the store, we looked up once again to see it in the same spot. 
Knowing my planes don't fly this low, my mother requested I pull over. I was able to pull out my Iphone before she got her phone up. We sat there then recording it. 
As we looked at it more, we began to see a squarish oval shape with the three lights evenly among the side of the "plane" as we recorded it more, it slowly started to move. Slowly, it got faster, and moved towards the mountains. We watched and recoreded it until we couldn't see it anymore.
Sincerely, ((name deleted))
Video is forwarded to NUFORC, but it appears to be ambiguous. It shows a flashing red and/or white light, which moves across the sky in a fashion that is reminiscent of an aircraft on final…

summary: on 11/19/13 my daughter and I saw a triangular shape object with blue then green lights over some housing in Rio Rancho, NM.
description:
To whom it may concern, This is my account of what my daughter and I saw on the night of November 19th, 2013. My daughter has filed her own report, per instructions of Mr. Davenport.
Approximately 5:55pm, my daughter and I decided to go the store, and as we turned onto the next block to leave, heading north, we spotted two solid blue lights, evenly spaced about 200ft apart, right in front of our view, but about a mile away. There was a red flashing light next to one of the blue solid lights. 
The craft was moving very slowly to the north/northeast. We figured it may be a normal aircraft, although we have never seen a craft, other than a helicopter, move that slow, so we ignored it and continued to the store. 
On our way home from the store, approximately 6:48pm, I was looking out the car window, when I saw three green lights, triangular in shape, suspended about 300-350ft off the ground, staying in the same spot, again with one red flashing light next to one of the green lights. It was just outside the window on the west side of the road. 
I told my daughter to take the next road to the right, which has no lights, and when she asked why, I pointed to the lights. She pulled over…

summary: 4 reddish orange lights appeared one by one, then disappeared one by one, appeared to be headed northeast.
description: Driving south on 91 just after exit 22 for St. Johnsbury I saw 4 reddish orange lights appeared one by one, then disappeared one by one. Appeared to be headed northeast. Very short duration. Each light was on for maybe 1 second before disappearing. Very large. Seemed to be quite close. Equivalent to the size of the planet venus as seen on the horizon that night.

summary: SIGHTING #30 – 11TH SIGHTING OF ORANGE-RED “FIREBALLS” IN A CLOSE BY STRUCTURED FORMATION
description:
At 7:10 p.m. I arrived at the beach where I regularly skywatch, just north of the rock jetty at Blind Pass, on the south end of Captiva Island, Florida. The sky was slightly overcast and the full moon had not risen yet, so it was quite dark. Since my last sighting late August, I had not been sky watching much since then because of health problems, but nonetheless have been out for short periods of time at least a dozen times since then, and saw nothing of consequence. I was thinking that all of the concentrated action of the past summer was pretty much over until last night.
 At 7:15 p.m. one of the :fireballs” came on briefly, due west of me, about 40 degrees up in the sky, and in front of clouds on the horizon. It came on as they usually do, like on a dimmer switch. From when it first showed up until when in went out was about 5 seconds. A few minutes later, another fireball came on in the same fashion, just a bit to the left (south) of the first one. It also went out after about 5 seconds. These lights were a little bit larger than Venus – about the size of a pea at arms length.
 Then, about 4 or 5 minutes later, I saw for the first time, a very small orange-red light…

summary: Not crazy looks like star got pics.
description: Theres been a ufo sleazing around bergen and passaic counties. I got pics, looks like a star bright but not a star took pic with iphone. Just sits there in the sky and slowly moves. Acts like it a star. It been around for a while. but Its been caught. Sent pics to place. If theres one theres usually more. F

summary: Saw a silver ball traveling at a high rate of speed going from north to south, then it went in a cloud.
description:
I was driving home from the store was sitting at a light and looked up and saw a silver ball traveling at a high rate of speed going from north to south, then it went in a cloud. Clouds were only on my left side clear blue sky on the rest of the sky.
I looked back from where it came from then back to the cloud and saw anther one going in to the cloud.. Then a fighter jet followed them in to the cloud.
They were very fast and went the from one side of my windshield to the other side in about 2 sec.
I'm a Retired Truck Driver.

summary: Metallic sphere pauses and becomes transparent after being spotted
description:
At about 2:00pm on November 19th, I was walking up my driveway to the mailbox when something caught my eye. Above the tree line to the south, a metallic silver sphere was moving at a constant speed eastward. I continued watching the object, walking backwards, as I ascended uphill to gain a better view. When I got to the top of the driveway, it continued as it had for a moment... then, paused for a view seconds in one place. When it started back up, the speed was the same as it had been, but it became more and more transparent! It wasn't moving further way, it was still appearing to be the same size.
It eventually disappeared. The whole sighting lasted about 50-60 seconds. I cannot figure out what it was- it was perfectly round and very fast so it couldn't be a plane. No audible noise or vibrations accompanied it- everything was quiet and calm during this time.

summary: Silver
description:
Fergis rd in St Charles Michigan a siler cylindrical craft was seen in the sky, a clear bright day. It hovered in the sky for several seconds then disappeared.
Source of report provides little contact information, and what is provided is flawed. PD
