Large white circular light,Approaching the south,of milton ontario,object veered very quickly to the east.
description:
At approx,7:50 am,I was looking out my back patio door which looks out to the north, At approx.1000-2000ft in elevation (cloud ceiling was very low yesterday morning, as we had alot of wind, rain that nite, So the clouds were very low. Above the townhouse complex roof i saw in the distance (which i guess would be possibly over highway 401, area) Which i saw a very large white light, looked perfectly round, It was moving towards the south,then it very quickly turned to the east, nothing like a plane, helicopter, etc. I did not observe any noise, It turned very sharply, As it turned i could not follow it as the townhouse complex and trees, were obstructing any possibly of viewing it. (Moved Very very quick.
Thank You

summary: One object it was a Circular.  Green and reddish/orange lights on the side, middle was a greenish color, moved right.
description:
I was on my back porch, facing south. An orange/reddish light caught my attention from behind a tree. I watched as it moved right. 
When It was no longer behind the tree I saw that it was the shape of a circle; it was just above the tree line. It had green and reddish/orange lights on the side, it's center looked to be a green color. From my point of view it seemed to be a fourth of an inch wide. It changed pace from kind of slow to slow. As it went right it seemed to go back and forth slightly, It eventually went south/southwest and I could no longer see it through the trees. I heard no sounds coming from the object.
Background wise. The length from our porch to the tree I saw it through is roughly 50-60ft. 
Then there is a clearing behind that, that is about 30-35ft long. 
Then it's a wooded area beyond that.

summary: Very bright sphere in sky, thought it was planet but had one blinking light.
description:
Standing on top of a hill, my friend and I thought we saw a plane. Then we realized it wasn't moving and thought perhaps it was a planet. 
Then we noticed a blinking light on the bottom of it. 
It didn't seem to be moving but was stationary for a few minutes, and we left.
We suspect that the sighting occurred at nighttime, although the witness indicates a time of 10:00 a.m.. We suspect he/she may have meant 10:00 p.m.. Witness remains totally anonymous, so we are unable to confirm the time. PD

summary: Stationary oscillating lights north of I-10
description:
Saw four stationary lights oscillating a 1 hertz approximately 4000 feet above ground. 
The sighting was slightly north of the I-10 while heading east from Red Rock, Arizona.

summary: multi-colored flashing orbs in sky over Ct River
description:
For the past 3 nights my family and I have noticed a ball with multi colored lights on it in the general vicinity of Haddam-East Haddam. 
At first we thought it was a star but it was twinkling with different colors. So we looked at them through a high powered sighting scope used for hunting. Upon looking through the scope we realized that they were more of a cage of vertical lights in red, green, white and blue. The lights pulsate up in down. Sometimes they altogether disappear minutes after viewing them. 
This is not the first time we have seen them and at other times there are more than one, sometimes three. We have seen them at about the same time at night.
We suspect a "twinkling" star sighting. PD

summary: Large orange cylindrical object flying over and near Pioneer Peak Alaska (6,000 ft in elevation)
description: Watched the cylindrical object with an orange "fire ball" appear over Pioneer Peak and head in a North Easterly direction. It had abnormal flight patterns, hovered and chaned altitude/ direction a few times before attaining a linear path. Altitude then remained high, object moved slowly with no sound. I contacted my neighbors to confirm what my family and I witnessed. They too saw the object and had never seen anything like it before. When I looked at it through my binoculars, it looked like a fire ball with a cylindrical shape, but had an almost translucent top, it almost resembled a sail.

summary: 3 triangled crafts eastern Nashville, TN. red/orange/yellow lights
description:
I was outside looking into the eastern sky. I was amazed with how clear and bright the stars looked, when I noticed 3 triangled shaped lights following each other in a line. I thought how strange that planes would fly so close to each other. 
Then I noticed each craft had 2 red lights (not blinking) and 1 Orange/yellow light (not blinking) that's what made me more curious. 
As I watched the 3 crafts headed north in the eastern sky they slowed down then hovered. 
I noticed that a aircraft at this point turned and went into their direction and at that point its as if they just disappeared.

summary: Small orb like object, made quick sharp turns, very very fast and from my vantage point appeared to be red.
description: The event occured the night of the launch from Wallops Island on November 18, 2013. The time was between 1930 and 1945. I'm sure of the time because while headed to class I heard about the launch on the radio. Class normally ends at 1930 but I left early (around 1915) to make sure I was out of the building before the launch took place. I didn't see the launch, but as I was was preparing to turn into my neighborhood I saw a red orb like craft flying (I'm not good with directions) so I'll have to use my home as a point of reference. I'm on the street heading toward my home and my home was on the right side of the street. The craft approached from the far right of my home and was headed left and would have passed in front of me but it veered sharp right and ended directly in front but above me. It wasn't flying very high...it was low and close enough for me to see that it was round and was red or from the rear was red. There was no sound and it was moving very very fast. It did not appear to have many lights, the object itself appeard to be red.

summary: a fast bright ligh in sky
description: On 18th of evening I was standing on my roof and saw a huge flash in the middle of sky and suddenly it took of to a very high speed. It was like few seconds I could see that flash going towards north in very high speed. I am quit fond of spotting meteors and other astronomical activities but never saw such bright fast moving light in the sky. This all happened for like 5 sec but I am damn sure it was a UFO.

summary: Red and blue sphere connected to brightly lit, hovering craft in Nashville
description: I observed a very bright stationary white light in the sky, within several miles of my home, at a relatively low altitude, to the northwest, toward South Nashville, in the general direction of the airport. It appeared to be hovering and have a set of extremely bright lights. As it sat there, not moving, I took several photos of it (attached). As I set up to shoot and began to focus, several bright lights going extremely fast and curling tightly, like a berserk firework, shot across my view finder. They never appeared again. I focused in on the bright lights, still stationary, and took a series of photos. To my surprise, the light did not show up...only pictures of a strange blue and red orb. See to believe.

summary: Strange lights in sky south of Red Lion
description:
We thought this bright light was a plane but it didn't seem to be moving. 
It looked like fireworks (multiple colors) went off but stayed in a permanent position. Then some lights went off and it went away.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: oval shape with very bright lights around attached to the craft.
description: This is my 3rd report here. My 2nd report was last month. Actually within this week I saw it 2 times, almost at the same times but today the position was lower than last week. Since I am in Padang for already 1 month now, I feel oblige to watch the sky. The shape of the craft is almost the same, oval with very bright lights attached to it. I really feel that it is necessary to find out what they do here and what attract them to come. If you have people in Indonesia may be can do the watching, to confirm my report.

summary: Orange orb seen by a woman in the horizon in Waldorf, MD
description:
I was speaking with a friend of mine when I pulled up in my driveway and looked at the sky and the horizon South East. I asked her if she ever saw the planet Mars for it was clear. The sky was extremely clear. I could see helicopters, planes, the stars. It was beautiful. The orange orb was amongst the stars in the horizon. I looked at this for several minutes and asked her to go outside and join me. She lives 20 miles from me. When she exited her home she could only see the full moon. The entrance of house opens to the East and the way I was positioned in my driveway I was facing south. This orange orb did not move.
She told me she could not see it for the moon was full and bright. I unfortunately could not see the moon so I kept looking and told her about seeing this planet early spring.
All of a sudden this orange ball starting shooting upward and fast, as if were a rocket. My first thought was I was witnessing a shooting star. From my vision it moved on an angle straight up to the left of my vision. I followed this until it was angling over my house. I was not particularly concerned for it was moving quite fast and was very high up in the sky. The movement from the horizon in…

summary: 2 lights (seen later in pictures as crafts)
description:

I thought at first this was a constellation, but upon my family observing closer while driving in the car, we realized the orbs were MOVING very steadily, and quite rapidly, towards the west.
The first formation seemed to be in a diagonal, turning into the shape of the Big Dipper constellation, and then 4 more came out of the Northeast corner in the formation of a diagonal, one after the other.
I waited till they disappeared - there was no color change. They maintained their orange hue until they all of a sudden disappeared with a final white light flickering. And they were gone. One more came out of the horizon and that too followed a diagonal path, then disappeared the same way.

summary: When outside with our dog around 6:30 pm on Sat., Nov. 16th, I spotted a bright white orange light pulsating somewhat coming above the SW tree line horizon.  Its location, seemingly, would have put…
description:
I watched it go directly overhead on a NE trajectory toward Portsmouth, RI. And it was soundless. A meteor? Too slow. An unmanned flame-driven hot air balloon of some kind? Too fast and steady in its trajectory. There was little wind. And its consistent horizontal path did not suggest a flare of any kind.
Moments later, a second object, similar in size, appeared following the same trajectory. As I watched both recede toward the NE horizon, I called my wife to come outside to see if she could get a glimpse before they disappeared.
Then a third object appeared on the SW horizon, followed, yet again, by a fourth. She could see what had caught my attention. They passed directly overhead, spaced in much the same fashion as the previous two, about fifteen seconds apart (as they emerged over the horizon). And each took about seventy seconds to pass from horizon point to horizon point. And as the others, they were round in shape. The light emanating from all was flame-like white orange...again, with no sound at all. All four moved at a speed and trajectory that did not suggest floating objects. My inability to ascertain the light source made altitude difficult to assess. My best guess:…

As it was too early for stars, I assumed it was an aircraft. But my wife and I observed it for the next 10 minutes and it never moved from its position. It was extremely bright and its shape seemed to change. 
We took pictures with our cell phones to try to zoom in and identify it. When zooming, we also noticed it seemed to have a blue light at its right side. 
When our friend arrived we showed her and she suggested it may be a planet. When we left the game an hour later, the object was still there. 
When we got home, we checked the position of any celestial objects which would be visible at that time, and in that position (relative to the moon and big dipper)and found none.

summary: Green ball of light cruised across sky

It would be hovering close to mountain to our left and then it would zoom off out over the Great Salt Lake and back (a distant of close to 10 miles) in what seemed to be only two seconds.
It then suddenly split into two objects that were both flying in the same erratic way. After a few minutes of this we saw it merge back into one object. After this it almost seemed to be following us. This sparked our interest so instead of driving straight home we decided to continue driving for longer so we could investigate a bit more.
As we were continuing to drive it turned towards Stansbury Lake. We followed in that direction and once the lake was in sight it flashed very bright (almost like the flash on a camera) and then dropped down into the lake with a small flash and that was the last we saw of it.

It pulsed like that the entire two minutes as it slowly moved directly over me…maybe 10,000-15,000 feet above? It went almost in front of the half to full moon so it was very easy to see. I’d describe it like a Jelly Fish. The inner part of the jellyfish is where the glow was and I could clearly see an outer dome over it. The object continued on the same trajectory and same speed over the course of the two minutes and there wasn’t a single noise associated with it. Strangest thing I’ve ever seen. Went from South South West to North North West

description:
I was looking out my window into the backyard and saw a boomerang shape of green lights. If I held my hand out at arm's length, the space between my thumb and finger would measure between 4.5 to 5 inches wide (it was HUGE!). The green lights shimmered/glowed and seemed to have a random pattern of brightness, almost like a morse code.
Dogs in the neighborhood starting barking loudly.
The lights slowly went over my home. I ran through the house to the front yard, but due to the number of large trees lining my street, I was unable to see it clearly, other than some glowing light between the high branches. By the time I got to a clearer area, the craft was gone.
I didn't report it right away, but was looking online hoping for confirmation. I do hope if someone reads this and saw something that night, they will confirm my sighting.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Bright orange lights over Robinson road, hovered then vanished.
description:
Took the dogs out to their kennels about 10PM. After about 15 min they started barking (warning bark) I went outside to see what was going on, when I walked down to the kennels I seen a bright orange light appear from behind the kennels which is all wooded area. 
It shot above the trees moving fast and headed north over my driveway then stopped and hovered for a moment.I thought it was people shining deer at first, then thought shooting star, the dogs still barking at it. 
I quickly realized that it wasn't It had two orange shaped lights in a round type sphere that looked to be one orb. but quickly vanished. The moon was bright last night so I could have seen an object in the dark...there was nothing there.

summary: We were driving south down the interstate between Tomah and Mauston when we happened to look up to our left.  We saw 3 fireballs in a triangle formation.  They hovered for a second, and then just…
Bright Orange balls of light in the sky.  Stayed in one place for a few minutes then began moving North until they disappeared.
description:
My wife, son, daughter and I witnessed. We are just a normal working family. Saw a large bright orange light standing still towards the North. Was about 2x the size of Venus at its brightest. 
First thought it was a planet although not in a normal location and obviously not the same color and I called my family out to see. 
Then a second slightly larger one flew in from East to West at a slightly downward angle about the same speed as an airplane and then stopped in the same area as the first one. 
They stayed still for a little and then one at a time, began moving North and disappeared. We went back inside for a minute and looked again and there were 4 more in roughly the same area. They remained still for a while and then repeated the same Northern pattern as the first 2. 
There was no noise whatsoever and the lights were solid-non blinking. They looked just like images we found on the internet after we came back inside (some pictures in the UK). 
Watched for another 30 minutes and none returned. 
These were not any aircraft that I've ever seen. 
Any explanation?

summary: Huge ball or circle --- going to fast to know .  Light was bright bright , lit up the clouds , very white white light .  Traveling super fast .
Three clustered bright red lights slowly descended and disappeared.
description: My husband and I were driving south about to enter into Spanish Fork City. Approximately to the southeast we observed 3 bright red lights clustered closely together about 100 feet in the air. The light moved slowly straight downward for approximately 30 seconds, not reaching the ground, and then just disappeared.

summary: Triangle craft seen over Toms River, N.J.
description:
Location: RTE. 37 West Toms River, N.J.
Time: 20:00 Approx.
Weather: Clear 
Distance from Object: 1/4 mile 
Object Path: East to West then turned North 
Speed: between 15 and 25 mph 
Object Description: Triangular with white running lights, and red and blue flashing lights. Length approximately 250ft. along each side. Object made no audible sound.
Observation: Object approached from the east crossing over the Garden State PWKY. The object then stopped and hovered for approximately 30 seconds before turning north. What caught my attention was its size and very slow speed at which it traveled.
Opinion: I believe it to be a new aircraft being tested by our military. I draw this conclusion by the use of FAA regulation lighting and its close proximity to Lakehurst Naval Base and McGuire AFB. I also witnessed the same object a few nights later hovering over the area between Oyster Creek Nuclear Power Plant and the Garden State PKWY.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: Multiple triangular objects with red and white lights spotted over southeast Missouri.
description: Multiple triangular lights seen to the west, east, and overhead. Some were closer (low flying plane high), some were further away (those overhead were very high, like low orbit high). There were at least 3 white lights and multiple red lights on each object. All objects were exactly the same. The only things that differed were their location and altitude. Many people exiting a Wednesday night church service saw them as well as those working late at the local school district. At least 34 people saw them. There were definitely more than 10 of these objects. All objects except one seemed to just hover in the sky. One object did move slightly towards an airplane that was in the sky.

summary: Orange fireballs in a pattern of three, winking out and returning in another location, repeatedly.
description:
While locking my gate at night, I saw what seemed to be an orange "burning" object in the sky, approximately 40 degrees above the horizon, and several miles away. I wondered if it could be an aircraft on fire. The fireball did not move, then it winked out after seeming to flare up. It next appeared off to the south of its previous location, and winked out almost immediately, followed by another very brief appearance even farther to the south. It reminded me of how fireflies will light up in several different places as they travel. 20-30 seconds later it appeared farther to the north and much closer, repeating the previous pattern. Avon Park Bombing Range is located in that general direction, and I wondered if it might be something having to do with them. 
I did see tiny (much, much smaller) white flashing lights of aircraft in three different locations in this general area, however, these seemed much farther away, and flying in predictable patterns, that is to say, as normal flight patterns for aircraft in that area. I drove several miles from my house then on my way to work, and saw these fireballs again in the same general area. Several people in this area have told me about the…

summary: triangle air craft
description: We were driving north west on CTY HWY 14/61 towards La Crosse and saw a solid looking, dark gray, silent triangle pass over us. The triangle appeared slim and solid, it also appeared to have a dim bluish light at each point of the flying triangle. It was flying just a few feet above the tree tops near the highway. I also seemed to be silent as is passed above us.

summary: 3 orange  fire balls in Upstate New York
description:
Between 19:15 & 19:20 on November 13, 2013. A 34 year old male witness 3 orange fire balls in the night sky. The witness saw a single fire ball traveling from the northern sky. The single orange fire ball made a 90 degree turn to the eastern sky. Within two to three minutes later, another single orange fire ball followed the first fire ball and took the same route as the first. A third orange fire ball also followed the same route as like the first two, two to three minutes after the second fire ball.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Red and white lights above the great salt lake that appeared to be moving
description:
I was driving to work on the evening of November 13. My route takes me on I80 along the great salt lake. It was already dark outside and I glanced over at the lake and saw numerous orange/red lights Perfectly horizontal, Approximately 4 on each side with white lights in the middle, at what appeared to be 150-200 feet above the water. I was eastbound, just shortly after Saltaire so I know it wasn't the radio towers that are closer to 7200 west.
I grabbed my phone and slowed down (as much as I dared) to try and get a picture. It didn't appear as though I captured the lights in the pic and the lights disappeared. I didn't really think much about it afterwards until I was going through pictures, looking to delete what I didn't want. I found the picture of the black night sky and zoomed in to try and remember what it was I was trying to capture. In the picture I can clearly make out 4 horizontal red lights on the right and 3 on the left. At the top near the lights on the right there is another red light with a white light next to it. At the bottom near the left lights is a single white light. In the picture, all of the lights are streaked. I assume it is because I was still moving.

this went on 4 time over 30 seconds..

I shouted for ((name deleted/wife)) to come confirm this as I really could'nt believe my eyes. I gave the binoculars to her,looked up and it was gone. No trace. Almost like it knew I spotted it. summary: Object flying in the cold jet stream air and not leaving a vapor trail from it's hot exhaust like other jets were leaving!
description: Peter, 6 of us were watching the sunset at 17:35 on 11/13/13 my wife pointed out to me and said there's another one of those things like we seen last year! The object was flying in the jet stream 35,000 to 40,000 feet in elevation. One of the six people said it's just a jetliner (Lake Havasu is in a fly over pattern for aircraft flying to and from Phoenix, AZ. to L.A. and S.F.) I quickly quipped if that object is an aircraft why isn't leaving a contrail (hot white exhaust smoke hitting the cold air) like the other jets (there was four other aircraft in the area all four flying to the West as the object was) and why doesn't this object have strobe lights on like the other four aircraft in the area. Another comment was maybe it's a star and I quickly pointed out the planet Venus, which was ! visible in the West and told them that Venus was the brightest light in the night sky for a star or planet and this object was 3 times brighter than Venus. Another quipped it's just one of those U.S. Marine Fighter Jets going…

As the orange light got close to it, it disappeared!!! This would be my first ever sighting like this.

summary: Two pitch white cylinders flying close to the moon in daylight.
description:
The date was the same as I write this. November 13th, 2013. It was approximately 4:15 PM and the sun was setting. It was still very light outside even though the sun just started to set. I was on my way to my grandmothers apartment same as I do almost every week to help her out with sme household stuff and just to talk and visit. Normally I would have used public transportation to get there completely however due to construction I had to walk the last had mile there.
 Her apartment building is right across from Lake Michigan, I don't feel comfortable being anymore specific. As I was walking down the street I looked out over the lake like usual to enjoy the view. As I was looking I noticed as usual some planes going over. Then, I saw this white object very close to the moon. It drew my attention because it made no sound and had no exhaust trail behind it. As I began to look closer I noticed it had no wings, or appeared not too. This made me think it was one of those new "drones" police departments are using to monitor their districts. So, I wanted to get a better look.
 I hurried across the street to get a better view. When I did I saw another pitch white cylinder shaped object…

summary: Squadrons flying in formation and not in formation, all flying north, for 2 hours.
description:
For the span of two hours we observed several (20+) unidentified aircraft, that looked nothing like all the other planes flying around them, fly from the east, to the north and northwest. 
They were faster than the other aircraft too, and there were no visible wings and no engine sound. We also have photos. 
One of the aircraft flew back form the west towards the east, and looked like it changed to a red color.

summary: Unknown extremely bright pulsing light in sky.
description:

It pulsed extraordinary bright with a star burst affect. When the traffic light turned green I began driving south, I kept looking up every 2-3 seconds to watch it.
It seemed to rotate did not move across the sky as I could tell. Suddenly there was a huge flash and it was gone.
It was not landing lights of a plane thats for sure, it was brighter then the sun.

But then they began flashing again, but red light only. They began rotating clockwise making what I can only describe as a star shape design up and down the length of the object. As it flashed up and down one end it moved on to the next making a five sided design that looked like a star.

summary: hundreds of objects fly over small town in Washington State.
description:
Two 60 -70 year old women witnessed hundreds of round luminous craft, flying from the N. N.E. towards the S. S.W. over a small town in Wa. State. 
The objects were a bit below the star line, they were flying at the same rate of speed and seemed to be at the exact same height. Some were in triangle formation or in groups of 2 or 3 or more. Some were lone but still flying at the same rate and equally distant apart. They did not veer off from each other but stayed in formation from front to back, they just kept on going overhead for around two and one half hours. 
When my neighbor first noticed them she said there were thousands of them going overhead toward the south. They were not in a real hurry but seemed to be going at a medium pace. The moon was out, the sky partly cloudy with breaks so we could see them flying over, there was a slight breeze which moved the clouds around. One of the women is in the healthcare field, the other is a teacher of healing courses, she also cares for unwanted horses.

summary: Lights in a horizontal line in south sky east of Omro, WI.
description:
It happened really fast. I was watching SOA on TV with a friend. The TV is right next to a sliding door facing south. I saw a light turn on then another and another till there was 9 lights on in a horizontal line. And then the first light that turned on shut off and the rest followed till there was no light.
I went out to see if I could make anything out but couldn't see anything. It was low but above the trees. The only thing that was different was that I could feel something. As if a semi was driving by but no sound. Just a low vibration of bass or something that I couldn't hear.
We've seen lights moving in odd patterns out here before and I just figured it had to do with the airports in the area. It is also common to see skydivers and odd looking planes as the Experimental Aircraft Association is not that far away. But the time we see these lights are usually late into the night.
If anyone saw or could explain this one, I'd like to hear it as I am the only one that saw it tonight.

My brother also noticed a slow-moving airplane flying in the sky at the time, heading in the opposite direction of the lights. We could not tell if the plane had seen the lights and was following them or not.

summary: Multiple orange lights ascending then disappearing at a consistent altitude.
description:
On Tuesday November 12, 2013 at approx. 9:15 pm MST I was watching television when my wife called from the other room. I got up to find her staring out the front door toward the South East. She said “look at that”. To my surprise there were multiple orange lights floating in the sky.
We both walked outside to get a better look and stood puzzled as 8–10 lights, moving independently seemed to be slowly ascending into the sky. They were the same size, brightness and color and resembled very bright stars with an obvious orange hue. They rose into the night sky in no particular formation and each disappeared once it reached a specific altitude, which was approx. 40 degrees upward from the horizon.
They were moving slowly enough for us to watch for several minutes and I even called her parents on the phone to tell them to go look. They went outside just in time to see the last one ascend and disappear. My wife said about 6-8 had already "gone dark" before I got to the door, so there would have been 14-18 all together at the moment she noticed them.

summary: Open triangle shape, spherical corners, no lights,emitting a short, thick grey 'exhaust' trail while slow moving across daylight sky.
description:
As I was driving home I noticed a triangular shaped object with the corners connected with round ball shapes. No lights. It was a dull gray color and it was emitting a gray 'exhaust' trail behind it. It was dense near the object and did not trail for long, as does an airline exhaust and did not 'shine' white as an airline exhaust does. I wanted to get a picture, but I only had my cell phone and I knew it would not be clear enough to justify pulling over to try, so I instead used the phone to call my boyfriend to look and verify what I was seeing. He was just a mile from where I was. I did not get the call through to him, so he didn't get to witness it. It than moved directly away from me rather than across the sky and that is where my occurrence ended.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: non flashing bright object moving from the SW to the NE over the Denver Skyline at 5:15 am
description:
At 5:15 am I went out to get the paper and noticed a bright non-blinking object in the sky, moving from the southwest to the northeast over the Denver metropolitan area. From my position it was moving from over Chatfield Dam, across Bowman and NE towards DIA. It was moving at a uniform speed.
I knew it was not a plane, since it was so bright, like a planet, with the sun shining on it. The light was pure and non-fluctuating. It was moving at such a speed, that I was able to run into the house, grab some binoculars and get back out to look at it. It had moved about 20 degrees across the sky. When I focused on it, I was looking for the typical wing light that are on a plane. I did not see any, just the pure white object moving through the sky. I did not have any time to get my 800 power spotting scope to look at it.
There was no sound associated with the object. Planes that usually fly this route leave an audible sound trail.
I routinely look at the sky in the early morning, which is why I found this object so interesting. I immediately checked the Internet to see if this was the space station. I could not confirm the location of the space station on any of the web sites I searched.

summary: 12 inch long teardrop shaped hovering craft along Oregon Coast
description:
Recollection of Object Seen 11/12/13 I was at the Oregon coast two days ago vacationing with my boyfriend. We were on the 6th floor of the 10 story hotel with all rooms facing west towards the ocean. Outside our room was a 10 foot long balcony.
We had slept most of the day, had a very late dinner and then a bath (no drinking or drugs were involved). Both of us are veterinary professionals that work at an emergency clinic, oftentimes working long hours overnight, and are accustomed to being up late.
It was about 2:45 am when we decided to get to bed. I decided that I would take one last look at the ocean before going to sleep. It was raining, blustery and cold. The sea’s waves were crashing. As I stepped onto the balcony, I looked out west and saw a very elongated teardrop-looking object hovering in the air approximately 10-15 feet from the end of our balcony. The night was dark, but the hotel had spotlights extending onto the beach. This object appeared very dark-colored (maybe gray or black), about 12 inches long with a very rounded "front" end and a very sharp, long "tail". It also had a wide stripe of a faint greenish-yellow about 1/3 of the way from the tip of its nose. There…

summary: Pulsating beam of light with colors changing, intermittenet buzzing loud noise.
description: At 1:15 A.M. 11/12/2013, I was awoken by strange buzzing sound, as close as I can describe is like a florescent light buzz but loud, also with the intermittent buzzing there were also some other sounds I cannot quite describe. The beam so bright it lit my window up outside like day light, the light came from above the house, this caught my attention. We have low power street lamps nothing that bright only illumination enough to see to reach our doors safely. At first I thought oh maybe it is a helicopter so I listened, no helicopter sounds only a buzzing sound, then the light beam started to change colors, red, blue, back to white and pulse. This caught me off guard as I had eliminated a possible helicopter by noise it was omitting, and the change of colors. At this point it startled me by the sound alone. When I got up to try and view the light source or see what what it was, as I reached the window there was a loud popping sound and whatever was there w! as gone like it never existed. 11/12/13 later in the day I contacted the UFO center, but before I wrote my account I called the Police Dispatcher no accidents, no helicopter in my area, and none out at that time. This morning…

summary: I was returning from work and noticed what at first looked like a star low in the horizon, it began to move up word gaining speed.  A second "light" appeared and did the same thing then a third.…
It looked like an orange moon setting above the tree line & it slowly descended down into the trees.
description:
I've been seeing this same thing off in a distance for a few nights but this was right in front of me. 
I've also seen strange objects in the past 6 months that I've never seen before. 
My dog has been sensing strange energy fields.

summary: Bright star-like light.
description:
For the last 3 nights when in bed (we have a high window in our bedroom with no curtains over it) I have seen what seems like a very bright star in the sky. But it lights for a period and then disappears completely and then a short while later returns really brightly again. The brightness is not completely constant - it can pulse brighter and not so bright. But it stays in the same part of the sky (so not seemingly an aircraft) and seems too bright for a star. Roughly in a Northerly direction.
Possible sighting of Venus?? PD

summary: Glowing Object Streaking Across the Sky
description: While taking my dog outside, I immediately observed what appeared to be a brightly glowing meteor streaking across the sky. Orange in color, it moved in a westward direction, toward Madison, in a swift and precise fashion. In its wake, a sustained flickering remained in what seemed to be the object's path. It remained visible for upwards of a minute. There was no noise associated with the sighting.

summary: 5 fireball objects in formation. Disappeared then came back going a different direction. Some would dim then fade out. Lights were soli
description: Noticed 5 fireball like objects (red/orange) floating, going the same direction. The seemed to be heading the same direction at first then would disappear one after another. Then they came back almost in a linear pattern then became more like a large "U", but in a different direction, almost like they were circling around. Only 4 lights visible this time. Then the formation changed and they disappeared up to two then none. There were planes visible going the opposite direction. The light from these object was very distinct compared to the light of the plane.

summary: Blue leds
description: The ship stayed freezed in the sky, them moved a little bit at a time, and then disappeared in the night. It was one object, that changed colors from blue to white, like leds, all the background Was black. I have a video

summary: Multiple objects in the sky, moving, flashing, and disappearing
description:
There appears to be multiple objects in the sky, not stars, dancing in the sky from left to right, than up and down, some appear to move to different areas, some are lined up, their colors change and are mostly a flashing red color, different sizes and flashing patterns, some have vanished from the sky and others have appeared out of no where, google sky is not picking up some of the "constellations" in the sky, and i have never had an issue with it not being able to identify anything.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Two bright orange lights hovering low in the sky
description: There were two bright orange lights, not very high in the sky. They crossed over each other and then they looked liked they were just hovering for about 4 minutes. They then seemed to go further away and finally disappeared.

summary: all we could see was 3 lights in the sky that were defnetly moving around silently. Very strange...
description: I/we saw 3 lights hovering above the Lake Worth Lagoon just south of the Lake Worth Bridge in a triangle formation. They were not connected. They were definitely independent. They were slightly moving about and weren't very far from us. It seemed they began to rotate in the formation somewhat. As we got closer one light seemed to be getting dim. The other two got pretty close to one another then in the matter of a few seconds they moved west and gained altitude at an amazing pace. They didn't make a sound. They became so distant they ultimately disappeared. It probably only took 8-10 seconds to evacuate our location completely. It truly wasn't normal. If they were some kind of craft I'd say they were pretty small. No bigger that a Mini Cooper. But all we could see was light/ lights in the sky that were defnetly moving around silently. Very strange…

summary: 8 orange balls move across the sky.
description: At approximately 8:30 pm me and a friend were outside facing the N.W. when 2 orange lights bigger than a quarter came across the sky. They were parallel to each other and traveling at the same speed. I ran inside and got my 3 other roomates came out and they continued moving south together. There was no noise at all nor blinking lights like seen on every aircraft in the sky. Then when the first two started fading out to the far south another two lights appeared in the same location as the first. They followed the same flight path as the first two and by this time a neighbor had come out and witnessed the second pair. We could not hear any noise at all from them. Then when those two were in the south 4 more of the same lights came from the exact location but they came one at a time along the first flight path. The lights all disappeared when they got in the southern part of the sky. I've seen aircraft in the sky but this was definitely not a helicopter flares or airplanes. I called 2 news stations and searched endlessly to see if any explanation could be found.

summary: 10 orange and grey teardrop shaped lights flew silently and swiftly over head and then disappeared
description: I was driving back from Wenham at a little after 8 and about 1/4 mile before the H-W train station when i looked but and saw a semi circular grouping of 10 orangish lights. They dimmed and glowed repeatedly, were sort of fuzzy tear drop shapes, very orange at the center and sort of a ghosty gray/blue surrounding. They did a little swing around and formed a curved line and moved over very smoothly, with no sound, towards the north east. I can't tell how high they were because there was no identifiable object against which to compare them, though i don't think they were that high (maybe 1000 feet?). They were well spread apart, a good few 100 feet i'd say, and were in absolute unison once they made their line. Then 6 of them disappeared, just winked out. I pulled into the fire station parking lot to watch. The remaining four kept moving NE and then they disappeared one by one. It wasn't as if they dimmed towards the horizon; even though it was dark, I had a sense of the horizon and it was before that. And they didn't dim out... they just disappeared. And then there was a final one that came after the others had gone and it flew overhead going NE, then it also 'disappeared.' I…

summary: Bright light in sky that did not move.
description:
The object observed hovered above treeline for over an hour. Bright, Bright lights, this was not any type of aircraft. Just thought it should reported.
Possible sighting of Venus, we suspect. PD

summary: Reddish- orange object with beams of light emanating from body of object.
description: Object silent moving west to east, reddish-orange with starlike beams of light emanating from body of object. Did not look like any previously observed aircraft. Object proceeded to move off into horizon with increasing speed.

summary: Me and my daughter seen the most beautiful shiney spaceship. Not a UFO it was real and was watching us all watch them!
description:
Me and my daughters seen a huge spaceship and a lot of other people got out of there cars and seen it too. It was so beautiful ans shiney. They was watching us watch them. She. Was getting nervous and wanted to go where the other people were. I said no honey I don't want to take my eyes off it. 
Right then I turned my head and it was gone. 
It was so beautiful and shiney.
We spoke via telephone with the witness, principally to confirm the date and time, which were November 11, 2013, at 18:45 hrs.. We have corrected the time and date above. The witness indicates that the object looked like a disc, and he has offered to submit an illustration to our Center. PD

summary: Out for a hike in Coeur D Alene, Idaho.  See a glowing golden orange light in the sky.
description:
I was out for a hike in the hills near Coeur d Alene, Idaho around 6:00 pm. I was on the east side of Tubbs Hill facing south over Lake Coeur D Alene. I decided to head down to the edge of the water and sit down. I looked out over the water and saw a glowing golden orange light. I asked the friend who was with me what planet it was. 
I then realized that it was moving slowly. I saw little twinkles around it as it moved slowly westbound across the sky, like little shooting stars. 
My friend and I both acknowledged its movement and then tried to figure out what it was. I had heard about other fireballs from a co-worker who frequents this site and then thought about posting this story. 
We left before Tubbs Hill before the glowing golden orange light left our sight.

summary: Hovering then moving very bright light with very bright light on top.
description: I saw this thing on 11-10-13 while driving south on US highway 19. It was in the north western sky. It appeared to be an usually bright star. I observed it for about 30 minutes. I really did not think much of it other than it was unusual. The next night,11-11-13 at 6:15 PM I was in Bristol TN. Near the Painter Creek Marina on south Holston lake. I was with a friend outside looked up and saw it again! I ask my friend what he thought it was. He was in the process of telling me it was a satellite when it suddenly move toward us very quickly, then went away slightly and stopped. It hovered for about a minute, then flew off very quickly! While it hovered it made no sound, it looked like a very bright light about the size of a large plane, with a very bright light on top of it. When it flew away it sounded like a jet plane. I don't know what it was, maybe a drone?

summary: Bright white light hovering in southern Arizona night sky
description: On November 5th, 2013, I saw a bright white light to the south. It was around 5pm, dusk with a few scattered clouds (a storm was coming in). The light had a haze about it and I thought it was a really bright star at first or an airplane. So I watched it for a 3-4 more minutes to see if it was a plane. But it began to move erratically, it's behavior nothing like that of a plane nor star. It appeared to be hovering, bobbing up and down. Then it would fly up to the left, hover then float back down farther to the right. (distance was hard to tell, though it appeared to be far, but at the same time it almost seemed like it was right above the San Tan Mountains.) After witnessing the strange behavior, I went inside to get out my astronomy binoculars, ruling out a plane, star or satellite. Looking through the binoculars showed me the object was spherical, with bright gold lights encompassing the entire object and the lights appeared to be moving clockwise, which I suppose suggests the object was rotating, revolving as it hovered. We would periodically check on the light every 30 minutes or so and still no change. At around 8pm the object (while viewed from the astronomy binoculars)…

summary: Bright light, watched for an hour, watched it speed up and go east and stop over field by Ponoka, AB and then disappear.
description:
Driving from Edmonton to Ponoka AB, Highway 2 south, I noticed a bright light looking like a very bright star. It was in front of me to my left in the sky and maintained that position in front of me up until about 16 km out of Ponoka. I noticed it looked like it was slightly moving closer and farther during the drive, and was trying to figure out what it was.
About 16 km out of ponoka, it had moved closer to the ground, brighter and to my very right side looking out of the passenger window. I was going to take the Rimby exit to follow it to my right but when I got to the Turn off, It was straight ahead of me and seemed less bright, like farther away. I took my Ponoka exit (headed east) and I could see it behind me in my back window. Right before I made it into town I saw it Speed up an d pass my two passenger door windows and back to my windshield and off to my right.
 I passed the stampede grounds and pulled over close to the arena and got out of my car to take a picture of it. It was still bright but lower to the ground. I had to leave to get my dog from the sitters, got back in my car to go find it but it was gone.

description: A sketch can be included of the craft and their positions, superimposed over an image of where they were sighted. However, at the time of the sighting, nobody had a mobile phone that didn't have a dead battery.

summary: Unidentified object seen above rainbow in Texas
description:
On November 11, 2013, at 12:09 PM, while taking pictures outside of a rainbow, I discovered something strange on the picture. 
It is a circle of lights 9 (nine) in all with one being longer that the others.

summary: Dull nosed, triangle object with no lights going slightly west of straight south at a fast speed.
description:
Object seen was tiangular, about 140 degree front--wider than it was long. No lights, moving very fast, No sound, could not tell how high up it was, going south south west. Slightly lighter than the dark sky (light from the city showed it up). 
I am a carpenter, 75 years old, taught school (industrial arts--wood shop) for 5 years and have never before seen anything like this. Stealth B-2 Bomber has more of a sharp nose. It was going in a straight line--on an angle--like towards Jackpot, Nevada. 
Viewed for only 5 to 7 seconds across the sky!!!!

summary: TRIANGLE OVER HEARTLAND
description: I just got home and as I do I was setting in driveway with the moon roof open in my car. I was looking up, it was half cloud cover, half sky and stars. I was facing South when out of the corner of my eye to my right (west) I caught something moving fast. At first I thought it was a bird. Like when it's dark and u see a bird above, black on black makes it hard to see. But then I seen a row of lights, that's the only thing that made me keep flowing this accross the sky. It was NOT a bird. It was almost as if the lights were bairly on. They was very dim, but enough that it wasn't black in black. (meaning black sky behind black object. It took about 4 seconds to cover entire sky from West to East. It was very low, under clouds, and very fast and silent. Not a sound. Now this next part take it for what it's worth. I'm in a bad spot in my life rite now. With bills, No job, injury, ect. I was looking up in the sky asking God, mother earth and the Universe to help me. I've been reading law of attraction lately, the book called the secret. In it they say the universe is alive, mother earth is alive. So I was talking to them. I guess praying to them. I asked for them to show me something,…

summary: @ 2h25min Montreal downtown, seen something going super fast and high in the sky, a lot of lights flashing.
description:
At first it went in a straight line, pretty fast (like a helium balloon), it had lights (orange-firey colour) on the front part, flashing one after the other. 
After a couple of seconds goings straight up, it starting turning left in the sky, until we lost sight of it.
At that point, it had only 2 lights open that flashed. It was about 3 times smaller than a plane, it had a diamond-like shape and the middle of it was like made of glass, almost translucend or with a lower type of light.

summary: two silent blue lights followed by a hellicopter
description: I live in down town Las Vegas. I stepped out for a cigarette and saw two solid blue lights flying smoothly across the sky. The first was moving at a slightly higher rate than the second. The second blue light was moving slower and had a helicopter following it slightly higher and behind it. The helicopter was flashing a red light and a distinct chopper sound was herd. I saw the three objects for only a few secants before they were lost to my view behind houses. The three objects were headed towards the general direction of Nellis Air Force Base.

summary: I WAS TRAVELING EAST ON HIGHWAY 24, COMING BACK FROM PERU INDIANA, WHEN I SAW A FIREBALL OVERHEAD TO THE EAST.  IT LASTED ABOUT 10 SECONDS, AND THEN BURNED OUT CLOSE TO THE GROUND.
description:
IT WAS BRIGHT WHITE, WITH NO DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS. 
I HAVE RARELY SEEN A FALLING FIREBALL IN THE SKY.

summary: Was coming home from a friend's house and before my exit I saw an unidentified flying object.  It started out right out front my windshield and slowly moved south and i saw it then again through the…
description: We suspect that the sighting occurred on November 10, and not October 10th. We have amended the date above. PD

summary: Lights in triangle shape then a line
description: About 5 star like lights moving fastly across the sky in a triangle for about five seconds, then the top light moved to form a line with the others and lost the sight of them after five seconds.

summary: Orange ball of light.
description: Orange ball or sphere of light traveling from east to west at cloud level. Through clouds. Clouds were flat and blanketed. The light traveled through clouds enough to blaze trail and separate them. No sound.

summary: Flying Box with No Marker Lights
description:
Was sitting in my vehicle speaking to my girlfriend, when I noticed a gray box moving (in the peripheral of my left eye). My car was facing east (towards Tennessee) and the box was north of town. It appeared to be about 1.5-2 miles above ground and maybe about 10 miles north of the Jonesboro. The box (or dark gray spot) was traveling from west to east. And when I started paying attention, it went behind a building in my apartment complex (which broke my line of sight). I stepped outside my car and noticed the box traveled back into my line of sight, going from east to west. I proceeded to tell my girlfriend what I was seeing. I then noticed the box make a turn northwards, slow down, then accelerate and disappear (it didn’t fade into the distance, it just disappeared).
I could see the box because the ambient lighting of the city lit up the sky, and it was darker than the surrounding area. Also, it did not have any marker lights (red, white, amber). Lastly, the turn radius it had was too small for an airplane but too large for a helicopter. Additionally, an exhaust/vapor trail was non-existent and the pulsating, whirring sound that you get when helicopters are traveling was not…

summary: video of giant triangular craft and helicopters that come shortly after and hover beneath it.
description: It is a video taken very close up of a GIANT (baseball field sized) triangular craft that is also tall. 2 helicopters then fly under it and hover. The details of the craft are very pronounced although it is dark outside.

summary: Red Orb over North East Florida seen from Airplane
description:
I was on a flight from NY to Orlando, FL, and while looking out the window, noticed a bright red light to the South West. The captain mentioned that we were passing Jacksonville just before, so I assume it was in the area, though I could tell it was not close to the aircraft. It also appeared to be above the horizon (aka in the air) judging by the surrounding ground lights and sky though it was difficult to see it’s relative location exactly.
The object did not blink and was a solid red color initially. After approximately 2 minutes, it seemed to subtly pulsate with red/orange coloration (no blinking). The light then disappeared completely for about 30-45 seconds and reappeared for another minute more in a similar location. It then disappeared again for about 15s and reappeared for another 30s (approx.) before disappearing completely. The object seemed to fade in and out instead of 100% on/100% off.
It seemed to stay in the same relative location, though it could have easily been traveling towards the plane. It was a very bright object and had a distinct color, which is why I took particular notice. I fly pretty frequently and I can't say I've seen anything quite like it before.

summary: Lights over New Westminster
description:
At about 8:00 o'clock pm I went out onto my patio to start the BBQ when I looked out into the sky.
I saw 3 strong red lights in the southwest sky.
I immediate called my wife to come out and have a look.
At this point the original 3 had moved up into the sky and disappeared and 3 others had appeared rising into the sky.
We both went into the house to get out phones and she started to video the event and I took still pictures.
This lasted for about 15 minutes.

summary: Orange fireball over Punta Gorda, Fl 11/10/2013 approximately 19;30 hours.
description:
It was dark out and partly cloudy. I noticed an orange flickering ball of light coming from the Northeast traveling Southwest. There were no aircraft type lights; no headlights, no strobe lights, nothing red or green, just this orange ball that flickered the way a camp fire in the distance would appear. It flew below the clouds, I'm guessing at a height of 5,000 to 7,000 feet and traveled at a speed consistent with prop or jet aircraft on landing approach. Again, guessing about 150 to 300 miles per hour. It did not leave any kind of trail.
I was facing North and this object passed from my right to left. The whole time, about 15-20 seconds, it never changed speed or direction, nor intensity of light. Watching it come and go, the "ball of fire" appearance never changed; it appeared the same coming as it did going. What made me think this was a noteworthy experience was the complete silence of the entire event. I never heard a sound, when normally aircraft within this range of vision can be heard, especially when they have traveled psst my vantage point.
I'm reporting this as confirmation should you receive a more detailed report and or video of this event.

summary: It's snowing hard our first real snow of the season... I went in the kitchen and happened to glance out the window and I saw these fire like orbs floating from the ground up and left into the sky…
description:
At first I saw 3 one behind the other and one by one they went up into the sky and disappeared ... I kept watching and then more kept coming from the same location and each one disappeared into the sky...
They kept on coming at 1 or 2 second intervals there was about 13 all together... Then I didn't see any more but and each one appeared to be dropping 1 or 2 pieces of fire from them that disappeared as they floated towards the ground...
As the fire balls went up into the sky they changed from fire orbs to an orange color before they disappeared ...

summary: Round V shaped craft going west to east looked like refracted light in color.
description:
Sitting in my yard facing North i see a round v formation of What i thought was one Craft flying west to east directly over me not making a sound. 
I watched for about 10 seconds total and The only way i could describe it was light relecting off the front of an invisible craft that formed a V shape. I know it was not Geese i got a very good look at it and it was very low prob 200 feet. 
About 30 minutes later, The same thing flew over my house going the same direction and i watched that for five seconds.

summary: No information provided by witness.  PD
I witnessed a large, orange, silent fireball just under the cloud cover that moved slowly and disappeared up into the clouds.
description:
I stepped out of my front door in Graham, WA, at about 6:25 pm Sunday November 10th. There was a cloud cover but no rain or wind. 
I immediately noticed a large, bright, round, orange ball of light just under the cloud cover and about 1/2 mile away from me to the west. The ball flickered like fire and barely moved forward casting an orange glow on the underside of the clouds above it. When it moved it bobbled slightly instead of staying in a smooth trajectory. It made absolutely no sound and was about 90% from the horizon. 
The fireball was approximately the size of a full moon. The light began to fade and I realized it was moving up into the cloud cover and then disappeared. The whole sighting lasted about one minute.
I am a 66 year old retired person who has lived in the area of Joint Base Lewis McChord all my life and quite used to regular aircraft. I told a pilot friend of mine about the sighting and he had no idea as to what it could be.

summary: They were very fast and the with the bright flash surprised me.
description:
At 6:17 PM on November 10 2013, I was outside looking up at the stars and thought I saw a satellite flying overhead. Then suddenly it changed directions. It continued to change directions for about 5 minutes, and then it more or less settled in to drifting between 2 stars. If you were to draw a line between the 2 stars, it would continuously drift across this centerline but also, it would move closer to one star then the other. This was all in the eastern sky. A second object appeared and flew by the first in a southerly direction till it disappeared. A third object appeared, randomly changing directions. It also flew south till it disappeared. The 4th object flew by the drifting one in a southerly direction but didn’t disappear exactly. It was in plain sight. Suddenly there was a bright flash of light and it was gone. The 5th object flew off in a southerly direction as well, but faded till it was out of sight. The 1st object is still there at 7:35 PM. I haven’t seen any more yet.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Horizontal twinkling lights transforming into triangle follwed by all lights going in opposite directions.
description:
I was traveling east on Route 64 towards Randall Rd. in St. Charles. I saw 5 sets of lights in a horizontal pattern. The lights were blue and red and were twinkling. I thought it might be a blimp returning to the DuPage airport.It was moving slowly. As I drove closer, the horizonal formation mechanically tranformed into a triangle. When I looked again all lights that composed the angles of the triangle were moving off in seperate directions. All that remained were multiple single lights in the sky. The initial pattern is below.
 . . . .
. . . .

summary: Single object hovering over Lake Ponchartrain Louisiana.
description:
My wife and I were driving side by side in seperate cars heading home towards Lake Ponchartrian when we both noticed at the same time, 3 bright objects flying in a triangular formation over the lake. 
She called me from her car asking me if I was seeing the same objects that she was which I did. 
We quickly drove to the lake, got out of our cars, and ran up the levee where one single object was left hovering over the lake. 
I got out my cell phone, and was fortunate enough to capture an 11 second clip of the incident. 
It hovered in place for about 10 minutes changing colors rapidly, and moving in an erratic pattern. The object gradually drifted away at a slow pace toward the horizon.

summary: I stepped out to have some Colorado tobacco and faceing east towards the grandmesa I looked up and saw the orange glow of the sunset reflecting off a pumpkin shaped craft with vertical ridges around…
Enlarged horizontal dots flying at high altitude over Lima, Peru skyes for about 5 minutes
description:
Date: November 10, 2013 
Time: around 4:30 pm 
Angle: 45 to 60 deg from normal 
Altitude: 300 ft over sea level 
Facing: North East 
Condition: Sunny Crystal clear sky, no clouds and the moon could be seen 
First I saw a white sort of enlarged horizontal dot travelling from SE to NW direction, which I thought did not have the physical characteristics of a commercial or military jet aircraft, nor it wasn’t on the regular path to Lima’s International airport approach only a few miles west from my standing point, nor an enroute plane to other destination due to the altitude it seemed flying on was lower. 
The whole thing didn’t last more than 1 minute as a building on my way obstructed the sight. I expected for the object to pass the building, as an aircraft should, but it just didn’t happen or it may have changed direction staying on a North bound course where this building didn’t let me see any more of it. I came inside the house wondering and commented the sighting with family members.
As I kept wondering, not over five minutes later I went outside again and started staring at the same point I saw this for the first time, the I turned myself slightly to my right and saw about four…

summary: 5 pix of a red ball in the sky.
description:
I don't know if this will be of much use since I didn't see anything when I was taking the pictures and want to send them but my limited knowledge of the computer prevents me from sending them from my cell phone.
My husband and I were driving home from Oroville, Calif., nearing the Beale AFB exit going south on Hwy. 70. It was a clear sunny afternoon on Sunday, Nov. 10. around 4:30-5:00 and the sun was setting. I often take pix of the sunset and was taking some of this one. 
After the 5th picture I had taken, I glanced at my phone to see if the last one came out clearly and saw a red ball shaped object on it. My partner got out of the car while I made the phone call. The objects were glowing an orange color with blue and white twinkling lights on the bottom. The objects moved from east to west and seemed to go out of sight when they hit a certain point in the sky. By the time we parked (approximately 5-7 minutes after the first sighting, there were only three objects present. They did not seem to travel in any specific order or formation, but continued to “drop” lights or sparks from the bottom of the object.

I kept watching it as I drove about ¼ mile south to an intersection, where I stopped and saw rays or beams of whitish/bluish light shining down through the overcast, as if a powerful searchlight was suspended above the clouds, shining down. The light beam did not reach the ground.
Only the immediately surrounding clouds were lit, not a diffuse glow. I turned east at the intersection, and saw that the light seemed to stay in the same position. Intrigued, within a few hundred yards I turned off onto a side road, and positioned my truck so I could see the light and area around it clearly, put the vehicle in park and rolled my window down.
I couldn’t hear anything but my truck idling, and it looked like the light was slowly drifting east above the clouds. At this point I remembered to take pictures with my cell phone, with my arms extended out my open window. I took the first picture, and the flash went off, so I turned off the flash and…

summary: Light in sky very strange, but believed to be noctilucent clouds seen through dark, lower clouds.
description:
I saw the report of another witness and I observed this as well. I cannot be 100% sure, but I believe it was the most extreme example of noctilucent clouds I have ever observed: very bright and very blue -- all the more so because I could only see them through gaps in multiple layers of dark, lower overcast that was moving fairly rapidly. The effect was rare and odd, causing me to study it for a while to attempt to identify what it was exactly and verify that it was not simply the aurora. Since Kuparuk is at latitude 70 North, the Sun slides down at a very oblique angle to the horizon and there are many hours of twilight. This enhances the duration of twilight phenomena.
I give permission to provide my name and number to the other witness, because I also work at Kuparuk and would like to compare notes on this strange event.

summary: Bright light inside an orange object, floating slowly overhead and not affected by the wind.

There was a fairly strong breeze, but the object wasn't affected by it. It moved steadily in a lateral direction for another few hundred yards, passing over and above the creek and toward the downtown area. It then gradually moved upward in a diagonal direction until it seemed be several hundred feet high. When it was about a quarter of a mile away, I began to lose sight of it, but the light was still as bright as a star.

I am a 57-year old female professor. I have never seen any other such phenomenon.

I looked like a typical movie style meteor entering the atmosphere but moved very slowly and didn’t dart through the sky as I have seen other meteors do in the past. I tracked it as it moved across the sky for about 10-15 minutes and would wait as disappeared behind clouds and reappeared through openings and I was able to judge where it would re-emerge due to its very linear trajectory. This was a distinct, large fireball with a dark mass towards the front and a bright yellow/orange tail trailing behind! It that did not leave any contrails. I would be very shocked if no one else in Northern Virginia saw this object. It could have just been a large meteor but I thought I would write to you and report it anyway. 
Thanks you for…

summary: Exactly as said then it went swiftly to tha left swiftly to the right and then just shot up into space on a perfectly clear day wow.

summary: White illuminated disks over east Los Angeles mountains
description:
On the way to work on the 405, 3 large white glowing disks were hanging in the air above the San Bernardino mountains in the east. They were all parallel to one another but at about a 26 degree angle from the horizon. 
At first I thought that they maybe vapor trails but they did not change in shape and were self illuminating. When first appearing they seemed closer but then they appeared to be miles away but still in perfect formation.

summary: Light moving faster and higher till it disappeared.

I was looking up at the stars, then I saw a red light moving fast and really high up there, then the light turned blue and continued to move faster and higher till it disappeared.

summary: Floating craft over my neighborhood.
description:
I was out side playing t ball with my daughter. I had a feeling of being watched, I killed around didn't see anyone. I looked up and seen a large white colored cigar shaped ufo in the sky. It was hovering like a helicopter but didn't make a sound and was too large and was very high in the sky.
After I looked at it for about 1-2 minutes it started moving straight up. I could see it for another minute then it was gone. It never made a sound and it seemed like the sound of the traffic on the highway, which is very close to my street. I don't even remember what my daughter was doing for those 3 minutes. I was so focused on that object, I don't think I even could look away if I wanted too.

summary: Bright orange lights in the shape of a triangle or star appear at night.
description:
object was seen hovering over my residence for the past several nights, it appears around 1130pm the lights are bright orange in the shape of a triangle and/or star, they disappear after a few hours. the animals act jittery around this time. 
This has become a nightly routine with the neighbors to see if the lights reappear every evening.

summary: Large slow moving craft with yellow lights over Hazel Dell Road.
description:
My son (19 years old) was on his way home and saw a craft over Hazel Dell Road as he was heading north. It was large and had multiple yellow lights that were flashing. It made no sound and moved very slowly. It had a triangle like shape with wings that extended down and a flat top. The back was lined with yellow lights. He drew a picture of what he saw the moment he arrived home. 
He stopped in the road as there was no traffic and watched it for a minute or two. As it moved out of his sight, traffic began to appear again. He called me on his cell phone as soon as it was gone and told me about it. 
He had left the house at 11:20 PM and now it was 11:53. His trip should have taken no more than fifteen minutes.

summary: extremely bright white light!!
description:
Seen in Erie, PA 11:20pm 11-5-13.
Viewer was in suburb of Erie. Object was south of him. He said it was way up in the sky. He had to tilt his head back to take the pic. The angle was similar to if the object were 10 ft. above the building next to his house. It was a cloudy night. The object appeared to be high, but below the clouds.
-Called 911. They had received no reports. They said to call the airport.
-Airport didn't answer that night. When called the next morning, they said that there were no reports of anything unusual on the radar.
The light field was two football fields and was very bright. Viewer visually boxed it in making a frame with his thumb and forefinger about a foot from his face. Said it measured approx. 3” within that box.
-Picture was shot with Canon gl2. Second, brighter, picture was enhanced.
-Object appeared to be completely motionless, like a picture held up in the sky.
-Duration of event was approx. 8 minutes. He just stared at it at first. Then he went inside and got his camera, and it was still there, unmoved, when he returned. Went back inside to get a video cassette, and when he returned, it was gone.
-Thoroughly checked the area in daylight to be…

summary: Bright Amber light in the sky.
description:
It was Orange-Amber light in the sky. Dim at first then bright. Hovering in the East, started moving towards the West, then stopped. 
Hovered for about 10 seconds then started moving South then stopped. Then moved back off towards the East and faded out.
Date of sighting was flawed. We have amended it, to reflect a sighting on Tuesday night, November 5th. PD

summary: Four glowing orange orbs were seen over the Gulf of Mexico in Panama City Beach, FL.
description:
We're on vacation and had just got back from dinner. We're staying on the eastern beaches near St. Andrews Park. I saw an orange glowing object through the balcony door and got up to go see what it was (we're on the 22nd floor, so it was odd to see something that high up). We saw three orange glowing balls of fiery light over the Gulf waters. 
One was traveling West to East. Another was traveling East to West above the first one. A third was traveling just above the surface of the water East to West. The first two vanished, leaving only the third one. The third one began to climb upward in a slow arc. It stopped and hovered for a moment and seemed to change colors to a more star like white color. It rapidly accelerated away from us and disappeared into a pinpoint of light. 
As we were reeling and trying to come to grips with what we had just seen, a fourth glowing orange orb appeared miles away and far off in the distance down on the Western end of! the beach, which would be Front Beach. We looked at it through the binoculars and saw that it's fiery orange glow was reflected in the water below it. As we watched, the fourth one slowly disappeared into the distance and was gone.…

summary: Bright light v shaped craft
description:
As we were heading on I40 heading to conway by the rice fields in front of us we see a lights going straight down. Think its a plane about to crash it jolts, straightening out, then appears to hover and falls behind tree lines. 
Then a few miles up the road we see it agian now in feont of is and it has bright lights in a v shape. Then it seemed to hoover over our vehicle amd you can hear humming of the object. Then it seems to slow move. As we decide to pull over the craft is gone.

summary: Solid orange lights arranged in the shape of the big dipper but with many more in the tail.  They floated in sync with each other and did not blink.
description:
They were seen on a cloudy night and bright enough to see beyond a the flood lights on the soccer field. 
They were drifting to the north west and went down behind the treeline. 
The individual lights were a circle in shape and there was 12+.

summary: 2 fireballs, same pattern, silent.
description:
On 11/5/13 around 8:20pm in Medina City (Medina County), I saw a red/orange fireball going across my window from south to north. I went outside because I knew there would be a second fireball as I have seen this twice since August. Sure enough, about 2 min later the same kind of fireball following the same path went by. Sighting is silent.
	Previous sightings were around August 31st near Lake Erie and October 5th in Mohican (Knox County). Different times of night. I have a video, but it’s not very clear as the object was moving too quickly.
	I would say it was a Chinese lantern but it was moving too fast and following the exact pattern, also I question as to why there would only be two each time.
