One object, flying East, to Southeast. Looked like a sliver of a moon, or circular in shape. 
Glided along at slow speed and was very low.

summary: Triangle shaped craft with orange lights flew quickly and silently.
description:
November 5, 2013, UFO Sighting At approximately 19:22 hours, 
I was on the roof of the employee garage, headed to move my car (while I was on break) and grab a notebook for work. As I walked toward my car, which was on the far end of the roof, I looked up and noticed something moving toward my direction in the sky. At first it wasn't clear what it was. As it approached, I noticed that it was moving rather quickly, and as it started to pass over me I noticed the shape.
It was a triangular shaped craft, with dim orange-ish lights at each of the three points, and was dark in color (black?) as it matched the night sky. I turned my body and followed the craft as it passed nearly directly over me. I managed to shoot my arm out and measure the size with my thumb; the rear two lights were visible from both sides of my thumb. The craft seemed to move in a straight line toward a North Easterly direction (From San Francisco toward the Sacramento area). It took about 10-12 seconds to pass from when I first noticed it. I didn't have time to get my phone camera on to take a shot, but I did call my co-worker and told her what I saw.
My heart was racing and I was trying to comprehend what I had…

summary: Hovering Orange-ish light over Keizer, OR.
description:
I saw a bright orange-ish red-ish glow from my window towards the west. I thought it was a plane on fire--went to investigate. 
I saw a glowing cylinder about 400 ft in the air moving slowly from W to E. 
I ran to get my binoculars--when I returned--it was gone. 
It stopped mid air and just hovered.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Red orange fire ball northbound at a curve towards earth.
description: I saw a red/orange fire ball like thing moving north at a curve towards the earth.

summary: 5 slow moving glowing objects in the sky.
description:
My son and I were driving home on Sumneytown Pike at 6:45 PM when I saw 4 really bright glowing orange dots about 20 degrees above the horizon. 
Knowing something was up we quickly found a place to park [nearby school with no trees to block our view] and got out to investigate. Objects were moving very slowly, very bight, seemed to have faint flicker almost like a burned out firework. 
After the initial 4 dimmed out of view I looked straight up to see a 5th. My son quickly got out his ipod and got what we could on video but the video does not do it any justice.
My nearest guess would be a very slow moving space object barely catching the outer atmosphere and not completely burning up.

summary: 4 white/orange orbs seen over Grayson/Lawrenceville GA neighborhoods 11/05/2013
description:
I was in a parking lot and looked up toward the north sky. I saw 4 objects that were stationary and appeared to be a bright white to orange in color. 
They were at uneven levels from each other. Two were close together and parallel to the horizon, one was feet above the other two, and the fourth one was about 200ft from the others. 
They were motionless and made no sounds. They appeared to sparkle or pulse in lights but never went out. 
I made a few pictures from my phone but they don't appear as colorful or large as they were to me. 
The sky was dark, the air was around 54 degrees. 
I looked around to see if anyone else was in the parking lot looking at them but didn't see anyone. 
I called home to speak to my mother as I was looking at them because my family and some friends have been seeing a lot of unexplained crafts (UFOs)in our skies over the last 8 years. After I watched them for a few minutes they just disappeared.

What made him take the picture was the round cigar shape cloud in the upper left of the picture because it pierced the cloud in the center of the picture. 
This picture was taken with an I Pad while he drove. This was about 5:30 PM during Daylight Savings Time. 
Picture on right was first picture and the left was the second picture taken. The sun was to the bottom left of the picture and this was taken pointing to the West. The other interesting thing about the bright object is that it has a contrail behind it so you can’t say it’s the sun reflecting off the I Pad lens. He didn’t notice the bright object until he showed his wife the pictures later. (I will submit the 2 pictures) taken

summary: Strnge orange triangle

November 5, 2013. Western Sky at Sunset approximately 5:30 PM. My wife and I where just outside of Oromocto, NB on Trans Canada highway number 2 when my wife spotted what appeared to be a jet trail coming straight down. It was partially blocked from our view for a split second by a small cloud and then it appeared to split into 3 plumes, one going left, one going right and one straight down, all at exactly the same velocity. 
We watched this for 10 minutes until we arrived at our destination, then all traces were gone except for an orange triangle with it's pointy end facing right and the flat bottom facing left. 
Have no idea how long the triangle lasted because we had to go to work.

The object headed from my left to my right before it faded away and created a trail of white light which lasted only for an instant. 
I stress the brightness of this object. It was no less brighter than that of a star at night.

summary: Silver cigar shaped object crosses Augusta Ga sky silentlyb around 7:15 am 11/5/2013
description:

The object was moving at the same speed during this sighting am guessing around 300 to 400 nmph.
This object also gave sun reflection as it passed overhead, no sound whatsoever, then the object continued its westerly direction at same speed until disappearing from sight all while I was attempting to film this sighting.
The filming showed nothing but the blue morning sky according to the first playback, my zoom was not on at the time though I had thought it was, my zoom only goes 4x, when I realized it was off, I had turned it on and set it to max, by then the object had traveled moreso to the west therefore a dot may appear once enhanced.

summary: UFO thought to be an airplane flashed colors and moved in swirl motions until it dispersed into the night sky.
description:
First noticed at 2pm on Nov. 4. Disregarded as an airplane. Later that night, at 11pm, My husband and I noticed it was flashing orange, red, green, and blue colors. We thought it was simply an airplane however it didn't move it's location. After about a half an hour of watching, 
It began moving in swirls. 
Unfortunately I don't have a telescope so I wasn't able to see much detail. What sounded like a Jet flew right above us and then the UFO somehow dispersed into the night sky and vanished.
The party who submitted the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information, so we are unable to contact the witness. PD

summary: 3 red lights on shadow outline of triangle shaped craft, slowly flying just above tree line silently.
description:
Four of our dogs started growling and barking towards the front of our home. I was in bed with my husband and saw a floating light through the slats in our bedroom window. I could tell they were too high off of the ground to be a car, so I got out of bed to check it out. 
Looking out the window, I saw the tail end of the craft. It was triangle shaped with 3 red lights on the rear and emitted no sounds at all. I could hear the cars driving down the main road by our home, but could not hear any engine like sounds coming from the flying craft. 
It seriously scared me, it couldn't have been a plane or helicopter as there was no sound at all from the craft. 
My husband thinks it may have been a government drone. I don't know what it could have been.

summary: Red light appearing/ disseapering and then moving into 3 different locations and disspearing
description:
My boyfriend and I were taking a walk in Bagley nature center (part of UMD campus)and we stopped to observe our surroundings as we began talking about the universe. Coincidentally, as we were looking in the sky I saw what I thought was a shooting star. Immediately after, 
A red light appeared that I thought maybe was already there and didn't notice. 
However, the light disappeared after 10 seconds and reappeared after about 5 seconds. It did this about 3 times before my boyfriend decided to pull out his phone to take a video. 
As soon as he was looking for his phone, I saw the red light move from one spot, to another, then another in the shape of a triangle and then disappeared for good. Unfortunately, none of it was caught on camera like planned. I think it stopped for that reason alone.

summary: Large bright white triangular shapes streaking across the sky coming to an abrupt stop, holding position for 10 sec. then disappearing
description:
On November 4, 2013 in the late evening (around 10pm) while sitting on the beach in Key Largo, FL, I saw about six to eight very large, very bright, very distinct opaque white triangular shapes resembling an irregular tightly formed flock of birds crossing the sky in a split second. They traveled in a perfectly straight line in a westward direction and abruptly came to a stop. The shapes held that position for about 10 seconds and then just disappeared. I attempted to bring them to my husband's attention, but he missed the event.
About 5 minutes later, he pointed out a singular triangular shape in the northern sky identical to the ones I had just seen. It rapidly crossed the sky from west to east then zigzagged in a downward direction and disappeared. My husband does not believe in UFOs but said he could not think of any other explanation than the possibility of an experimental military aircraft.
We talked about it for a little while and then just sat and enjoyed the night. Unbelievably, about twenty minutes later, a star-like flash of bright white light streaked from behind me heading in an upward northerly direction and quickly disappeared into the night. It happened before I…

summary: The craft did not look or act like a plane and was silent as it first hovered then moved through sky just above the trees.
description:
I was driving home on Rosendale road just before 10 pm. I was driving towards the Lisha Kill nature preserve which was to my right. I looked up to the sky to my right over the tree line and saw lights in the sky. 
At first I thought it was an airplane because we have Albany International airport not too far away. As I got closer I thought I can't be an airplane because it was stationary and low to the ground the object was maybe 50 feet above the tree line. 
My next thought was it must be a helicopter but as I got closer to the object I knew it was not a helicopter by its shape and the fact it was making no noise. 
I stopped my car in the middle of the road and through a gap in the trees I could make out the object. It had sky-blue lights on the ends of its wings and four lights underneath alternating red and white. The lights gave off an illumination that was different from a light on a regular airplane, they were almost glowing but not like spotlights. 
The object was small like the size of a car. Its wings were shaped like bananas or like a three-dimensional triangle which were divided symmetrically by a similar shape on top of the center of the craft. Underneath the craft were…

summary: Long oval dark craft, moving silently with two long dimmed red lights going width of it, strait over me, west to east.
description: Sitting in my Yard facing west,and a silent dark lower flying craft went directly over me. I watched it fly over for 20 seconds total. It was long oval black with two dim long red lights that stretched across width of craft. Looking at it it looked like i was looking at the bottom of a boat, and made no noise and moved very swift. Moving from west to east.

summary: Blue/Red cigar shaped object with three lights hovering in southern sky for 5 minutes
description:
Cigar shaped blue and red object, 3 lights within the object in southern sky. No movement x 4 minutes. 
Could not take picture, object would not appear in camera view finder. 
Helicopter appeared coming from north, and the object disappeared.

White lights constantly seemed to rotate. Did not fly fast only slowly moved lightly to the right. Got smaller as we attempted to get closer.

summary: I and three others saw three triangle  objects with lights, silently fly north of my house  in a V formation  .
description:
Tonight, on November 4th at approximately 7:09 pm in Clearlake, California, my family, best friend and I witnessed three triangular a shaped, silent flying objects with bright greenish white lights hover over our town. They were in a V formation and moving quickly north of my house .
They were small compared to a full moon my mom, best friend ,brother and I watched them move north for approximately 5-6 minutes and my best friend tried to call her father and her phone wouldn’t work just static. This was the scariest experience of my life.

summary: Saw a craft ejecting red flares over the night sky in Southern California
description:
On Monday, November 04, 2013, at approximately 20:04 hrs., my girlfriend and I walked out of our home to take our dog for a walk in the northwest part of the city of Escondido, California.
As soon as we walked outside, I noticed a reddish/amber light in the northwestern sky. The light was so bright that I mentioned it to my girlfriend and said something to the effect of “I wonder if that’s Mars or Venus so bright tonight?” 
We both stopped to look at the object and we both noticed that it was moving. We kept our eyes on it as we walked another 50 feet or so. The light moved from our northwest to our southeast. We both stopped walking, and I remarked at how bright the object was, but that it didn’t have any blinking lights on it (the kind I normally would associate with an aircraft). 
As the object was flying in the southeast horizon, we clearly began to see red flare-like objects coming from the bright amber lighted craft. The objects were glowing red, similar to the color and intensity of a roadside flare. We saw approximately nine (9) of these “flares” come from the craft over a span of three (3) to five (5) minutes. At least one of these flares broke apart into two independent…

summary: Falling lights.
description:
On the fourth of November at approximately 20:00 I left my house after my television spontaneously switched channels. Outside there was a ball of blue light falling from the sky far above the clouds near the city of Albuquerque on the eastern side close to the mountain. Once it entered into the clouds the light could be seen to be a blue and green pulsating ball of light with a trail of white smoke behind it which was so pale it looked like steam. It moved so fast, and appeared to be so large I expected to feel the impact, but I felt nothing. 
About five minutes later three to five search planes began circling the area where light crashed and remained searching for at least an hour.
There was no report of this incident, and I appear to be alone in this sighting. 
If anyone else saw this event please step forward and provide a report.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: Red glowing sphere that appears out of nowhere  hovers, moves up
description:
I set up my camera on my porch and left it on. I have done this for many nights in a row since our sightings have begun . It never fails to amaze me.
On playback, there is a red light that seems to appear out of nowhere . It moves straight up after hovering and then zips off. There are two instances on this video where it does the same thing.
You can see this is right in the flight path of The Salt Lake International Airport.
I have been doing some investigating and am finding accounts from people that date back 4 years. These accounts describe the same things we are seeing now.
It still amazes me that people don't pay attention to their surroundings or take two minutes to file a report .

summary: myself and partner in garden watching an airliner disappear in the distance when directly above us 3 lights appeared from nowhere flying away from us and in an inline formation.
description: as we watched the 2 end lights converged into the central light and became one bright light and split into 3 again just before they disappeared from view over our neighbours roof.

summary: Orange lights over the ocean then disappearing and reappearing multiple times
description: I was sitting on my deck next to the Seaview fishing pier. It was dark and as I looked out over the water I saw an orange light - it appeared to be coming at me and then disappeared. And then I saw it again. This time a second orange light appeared next to it and then they both disappeared. One then reappeared and then 2 more appeared and then all 3 disappeared and didn't return. They appeared to float slowly and then dart a bit before disappearing. The whole thing lasted 3-4 minutes.

summary: Three flying objects in a row, red and green lights.
description: They were three objects following each other in a row, their lights were red and green and they were moving slow.

summary: Observation of two circular unidentified lights not behaving like man made object
description:
First sighting at 7:00 pm. Two lights tracked together like landing lights on aircraft. Slightly jagged edges, white with orange cast like the color of fire. Slight halo around the lights about the size of 1” disk held out at arm’s length. The lights were approx. 30° to 40° on the horizon from ground. 
The lights were moving from east to west (toward us) and banking like aircraft turning. The lights dimmed out together.
Second sighting the lights faded on together over an open field approx. 1,000 A.
Third and finale sightings was a single light for 3 seconds.
The brightness of light compatible to campfire light.

summary: triangular shaped light in the sky with a fourth orb following behind
description:
Driving home the other night my fiance and I looked up in the sky only to see a triangular shaped "craft"of some sort. The table consisted of 3 separate bright orange/yellow lights spherical in shape. There was also a fourth "craft" moving behind it. This fourth craft appear to attach itself to the triangular shape and from there the bottomed right craft slowly peeled.off and the lights disappeared. It didn't appear to be an airplane because there were no flashing lights indicating so. 
We have also witnessed this occurance while driving near Armada, MI. We he no explanation for what these lights could possibly be. The lights either completely vanish only to leave the fourth orb of light by itself for approximately a minute and then that too vanishes, or they all completely disappear together. 
On a side note, both my fiance and I are hunters. And since seeing there lights we have not seen any wildlife. Including birds and squirrels.

summary: One brightly blinking light over Berkeley, CA
description:
One bright blinking light over what appears to be Berkeley, CA (northeast of West Oakland, CA). Plane flew close below it, appears to be in our atmosphere. Blinks different bright colors, looks like pieces of bright neon glitter moving in brownian motion when viewed through binoculars, also shifted to cross at some points. 
One craft, three witnesses (students), all used binoculars to confirm our uncertainty. Maybe a closer view from Lawrence Labs if someone has access to that location. Unfortunately, my camera cannot register the phenomena.

summary: Bright white light craft shaped like a bat and another large ship with red lights
description: My parents called me, they live close by to tell us that there is something strange hovering in the sky near their house by the water. My husband went in his car and drove towards their house to check it out. My father, mother and husband saw a large craft shaped like a bat with bright whitish light surrounding it. I went out about one hour later and saw a large craft hovering over a farming field. It was huge with red lights all in a line. The craft was about the size of half a football field, then it disappeared. About one and a half hours after that sighting, I saw what seems like the same white craft my parents and husband saw hovering over the water near our house. When I drove towards the water to get a closer look, it disappeared.

summary: Bright flashing white ball in broad daylight
description:
Around lunch time on a job site in Durham, NC, several co-workers & I looked up to see a bright circular white light in the sky. It was a very blue sky crisp clear day, almost no clouds. From the rear of the homes I saw, rising from ground level a series of 6 large circular lights that were reddish orange in color. The lights rose in time intervals of a few minutes between each, except for 1 instance in which 2 lights rose simultaneously. 
At first the lights rose straight up and then they angled upward at about a 45 degree angle. They rose extremely high, appearing to me to be the height of the many Jets I see nightly, as I live near the Fort Lauderdale airport, and eventually they became the size of stars and then faded from view. 
I contacted the Golden Beach police to inquire if they had any reports of Chinese Lanterns and they said they did not have any reports.

The three trailing the first helicopter were barely visible except for the taillights and portions of their shapes that could be seen when they passed over lighter/illuminated clouds. They were flying south-east.
I know that this is not an actual UFO sighting, but I could not find anything about this event online or in the news. And I am uncertain where they would have been flying from or to.. I also had the impression that there may have been some barely-glowing lights along the trailing edge, perhaps four, but it was so dimly-lit that I can't be sure of that at all. As I watched it disappear into the night I said, "That was a ((word deleted)) UFO!!!"

summary: Probably not a UFO
description:
Came out of Western Hills Best Buy and noticed 3 burning orbs in the northern sky. I captured them on video as they slowly decended towards the horizon. They started out in a straight line then formed a triangle as they decended. They disappeared one by one below the horizon. 
I asked my father about if he knew anything about it and he said it was skydivers with yellowish white flares on their feet as they decended in the friday night football game at LaSalle High School.

summary: Giant orange fireball shooting across sky.
description:
Hunting trip, immediately after sunset-looked west and saw a giant orange fireball shooting across the sky…
at first I thought it was an airplane because it was so close, 
it flashed a blue light right before it zipped away past the tall trees where we could no longer see it, it was heading north.
The party who submitted the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information, so we are unable to contact the witness. PD

summary: Bright light for about an hour hovering above mountain.  Due south of Liberty Lake.
description: Sighting of Venus, we suspect. PD

summary: Triangler shaped object by the placement of 3 bright lights spread aways apart
description: We were driving east on Hwy 73, when we noticed out in the distance above a field 3 triangular lights, red and blue. The lights were spaced far enough apart, that it did not look familiar in any way. It was also standing still in the air and did not move. The 3 lights were round and very bright, also somewhat large looking at them, and they formed a triangular position. We all seen it and couldn't explain it. We kept driving, and it disappeared when we looked back. I go down that road everyday and always look in that area of the field, and have never found any other explanation for what we seen. I am first writing this now, cuz I never got this out of my mind, and I have been hearing other familiar reports of this shape of whatever it was. There was no sound. It was a very clear night

summary: Black object in picture
description: I took a picture of the the sky for fun on the 1st of november (i know cause of the moments thing in the ios 7 photos) so i took it for fun cause it was a clear day and stuff and made it my wallpaper and stuff and it was forgotten about untill 15 minutes ago i was looking for pictures to put on our album cover and i was zooming in and out and shit and i came across this black dot at first i thought it was something on my screen but it was and i screenshotted and zoomed even more and it started to look like a ufo, dark oval and high up on a bank to the left and i told my friend and he searched it up turns out there were alot of sightings in melbourne that day

summary: China,  Circular.  10-20 seconds  Along Yangtze River at Qutong Gorge
description:
I am a Singaporean and was on vacation cruising down the Yangtze River on cruise ship Century Sun on 1 November 2013. It was a hazy rainy early afternoon and we were cruising through Qutang Gorge towards Chongqing.
I was aiming my compact Lumix Panasonic camera on the red structure perched on the mountain side and decided to take some shots.
Unknowingly, I captured an UFO by accident. I was not aware of it until when I sort out my digital shots much later after returning home.
On close examination, I believed that it is an UFO of an enormous size as compared to the red structure and the two peaks in terms of scale.
It cannot be a sun flare or lens reflection as the background mountains were misty and the shot was taken on an open ship deck.
It cannot be a speck of dirt too as the circular craft looks lighted in yellow and huge in size. There were no people present on the ship deck as it was raining. What sort of object is it remains a mystery. I am looking for a plausible explanation .
More details: The shot was taken with a 24mm leica lens 3.8x zoom compact camera from the open ship deck.
The area where the UFO appeared was a secluded and an isolated region near the Qutang Gorge…

summary: Extremely bright light, not moving.  Situated just at the cloud cover line in the eastern sky.  Darted up through the clouds.
description: I was driving to Pioneer High School with my daughter. As we turned from 7th St. onto Stadium Blvd. the light was visible just under the cloud cover, in the eastern sky (slightly southeast). It was extremely bright and at first I thought it was a meteor. However, it did not move. Just as I was about to point it out to my daughter I saw it move slightly upward and shoot into the clouds, disappearing very rapidly. My daughter had seen the whole thing too. She then told me that several nights prior she and three friends had seen two of these, moving synchronously before disappearing.

summary: Two very slow moving "stars" seen well past sunrise.
description:
Two bright objects, originally thought to be stars or planets, still bright in sky at sunrise. They were located about 15 degrees North of directly overhead about 20 degrees apart from each other. No other stars visible. 
Stars move from East to West in the sky as the Earth rotates. These objects slowly moved toward the East throughout the morning. 
At the time of this report the Eastern object is no longer visible but the Western object is still quite clear.

summary: Blue, Pink and Violet Lights.
description:
Heavy rains and wind. looking out my kitchen window and facing due west. about 300 yards away. beyond treelined horizon and skyline. 
I saw the area in the facing direction light up bright blue for about 3-4 seconds. after 30 seconds it lit up bright pink for about 3-4 seconds. It lit up blue again and stopped.
I went outside to get a better view and I saw the whole facing area light up violet for about 3- 4 seconds. 
This entire time I heard no noise that would indicate lighting. Thought it might be a power outage but none were reported in the area. The rain subsided and I did not see to lights again. 
Very interesting and hope to learn of an explanation. If I don't that's ok, too.

summary: I'd like to share a post from my old blog. I was a senior in high school, and it was a very cold snowy morning.  I had been waiting at my bus stop with my neighbor.  The object was a kite shape, and…
description: "This morning while waiting at my bus stop, I saw something that I do believe to be an unexplained phenomena. The event lasted for a short while. I first noticed it from the corner of my eye: a bright flash of light filled the sky. My first thought was heat lighting, since there was no thunder that followed. I looked over, and the sky lit up once again! I stared in awe. I had now noticed that the sky pulsated with a red and blue light that caused the illusion of purple in some parts of it. It was so beautiful that one could mistake it for the northern lights (which was my second idea). It happened about three to four times within the timespan of less than a minute or so. I pulled out my phone to record it, but my phone wouldn't respond- and by the time I got to recording, it had stopped and my bus came moments later. I now feel a strange atmosphere and I have a feeling I have witnessed something important. I'm not sure what, but I will never forget how gorgeous it was, ! the bewilderment I felt, and what I still feel because of it."​

summary: Dancing, darting, bright white sphere, opaque plasma, basketball size, seen by 2 people together.
description:
A ball of light the consistency of plasma, bright as a welding arc, the size of a basketball dancing around a light at the top of a parking lot light, just like a humming bird flitting around a flower. It stayed spherical but did occasionally slightly change shape like a fragile round balloon in the wind. That's all it did. Dance to and fro around the street light. Just like a quick humming bird! No repeated pattern, just zoom, dart, hold, zoom, dart, hold, over and over, no more than 1 to 2 feet away from the light. Occasionally, it darted in a straight line in a split second 100 feet out to the right and then flies back, then 50 feet to the left and come back. It looked controlled somehow, like that hummingbird leaving and then deciding to come back to a flower.
Its intensity was like a welding arc. Intensely Bright! The sky was pitch dark and the street lights were on at the corner of Morse Road and High Street, Columbus Ohio. Two of us watched it at 5:00 am for at least 10 minutes 1.5 years ago. I looked at the other man and said: "Do you see what I see?" Answer: "Yea! Crazy! What is it?! 
It was still going strong when I left, and I still am not sure what it was. Not ball…

summary: Witnessed a bright orange-red fireball type of object moving from Maui toward Molokai at 4:30 AM.
description:
Witnessed a bright orange-red fireball type of object moving from Maui toward Molokai. With binoculars it appeared to have a balloon or some type of parachute attached. 
It floated for about two minutes then quickly burned out and fell toward the ocean.

summary: Flashes of blue-white light toward the north in Athens, Ohio.
description: Coming home from work. Driving slowly down my road: county road 24 I saw a bluish white light flashing over the hill coming from the north. It flash about 4-6 times in about 90 seconds. the next day my friend told me he saw the same thing at the same time, before I even told him about my experience.

summary: 3 lights in formation flying south.
description:
Was out smoking looking at stars before bed like i normally do. (in off chance i get to see a supernova).
Looking west from OSU campus i seen 3 objects flying straight south.
At first i thought it was birds but the speed was way to fast and constant.
(was over 2x the speed of a commercial passenger plane) Also thought it might be some airplane but the shape of the formation, speed, and zero noise. 
While flying straight south 2 of 3 lights (more like glow) where on the west side of formation like a triangle pointing east but its flying south.

summary: Several orange fireballs over Davenport, Florida.
description:
I was outside looking for my dog who ran off earlier. I noticed several(at least20) fireball like lights descending from the sky. At first I thought they were stars. But they were orange and moving. They all moved in formation. They were like a flock of birds. I watched until they all went below my fence line. But then 3 of them ascended and got smaller until they disappeared. Then 1 more did the same. And 1 at a time, they all did the same. 
I got a little on my camera. 
I have never seen anything like this before.

summary: greenish box shape object at erode
description:
I was lying on terrace of my house on yesterday night listening to music. All of a sudden i saw a green box shaped object moving in sky. It was moving at a rapid speed. Sky was cloudy and the object was flying beneath clouds n was clearly visible. It was moving in straight direction(horizontal) and all of a sudden it changed its position towards upward(vertical) and dissappeard into clouds...
I dont know what exactly it was....
But sudden change in its direction n disappearence in split seconds made me strange...
The incident occured in erode,tamilnadu,india

summary: Deep red light flying south due northeast with a paused flight pattern.
description:
On 10/31/2013 at precisely 22:13 my girlfriend went outside to smoke and she instantly called for me to come outside. 
To the south of my position was a deeply red colored object flying northeastern bound. The object's flight path was very stable but halfway through the event it paused for approximately 6-10 seconds then proceeded on its way at roughly the same amount of speed. 
The light started to fade momentarily, illuminated back to original brightness and then vanished. 
There was no noticeable noise from the object at any point of the event. 
I look to the south and see a commercial or military aircraft approaching.

summary: Strange unexplained tiny pulsating cluster of lights converged on ground in treeline.
description:
I looked out my back window and noticed tiny bright shining lights at the far end of the back yard. 
At first they moved around quickly, not unlike fireflies but moved much quicker and were much brighter,also bigger in diameter. From the distance I was looking from, around 50-75 feet, they seemed to be around the size of small eggs. 
Then the majority of the lights converged in a spot on the ground in the treeline. They seemed to form a circle, blinking occasionally. Two or three of the lights remained separate two around 20 feet away and forward to the left, and one around half that distance and forward to the right. 
I also noticed on three separate occasions that the cluster of lights would dance around and flash in a recognizable pattern, followed almost immediately on one occasion of a wave of even tinier lights seeming to fall from nothing visible in the sky upon the cluster of egg shaped lights. 
My sister and I both observed these lights from two ! separate rooms in which we had extinguished all the indoor lights. We watched these lights, looking for explanation for well over an hour. 
At first we hoped they were the reflecting eyes of several small mammals, such as…

summary: Loud stationary noise and lights
description:
On October 31st, 2013 at approximately 21:03 hours, my wife and I were standing on the rear porch watching the weather. It has been windy and overcast for the last two hours and the rain from earlier had stopped. We were both facing to the north to keep the chilling winds at our backs. Suddenly a loud noise came from the sky to the east-northeast.Along With the noise was steady flashes of bright white lights reflecting off the low, fast moving clouds. It was a loud noise and sounded like two distinct but simutainious notes. The lights and sound did not move... The noise sounded like two simultaneous steady tones... If I had to guess what the tones sounded like, I would say a pair of jet turbines but very clean... meaning no low rumble of exhaust sounds, as a jet makes when flying. Again, the lights and sound stayed in one area only. The noise and lights stopped after about 10 seconds. The event stopped as fast and as loud as it started the only difference is! that the tones dropped quickly in pitch.
This was completely strange because that kind of noise with lights did not belong in the sky. In fact, I've never heard anything like it before. After the event, my wife and I just…

summary: Bright white/blue light flying at high speed, then speeds out of sight
description:
On the night of October 31st 2013 I was driving on I-84 westbound last night when I saw in the SW sky a bright blue-ish white light traveling at a high speed horizontal to the ground at about cloud level (there was only one cloud and I saw it pass through it). Whatever it was was of a pretty good size. The light did not flicker/waver like the meteors I've seen, it was definitely at the altitude I said. It didn't have blinking light like a plane nor any wings that I could see. I saw it flying for about 5 or 6 seconds before it seemed to accelerate and speed off into the distance and then it was gone. It did not burn out, just sped out of sight...
A day or so later now, I've heard reports of my girlfriend's parents seeing something similar too, and there's military helicopters all around Melba, ID, where they shouldn't be. What I/they saw was no helicopter...

summary: 6 Blue lights in a single row.  All of them equally distanced from eachother.Everyone in the neighborhood watched them for hours.  They never moved.  In the morning they were gone.
description: We called the news station and they had no idea what it could be.

summary: A dark chevron shaped craft moving quickly while phasing in and out.
description:
At approximately 21:00 hours, a friend and I were standing outside in my front yard looking west into the night sky and observed a chevron shaped object just above the glow of the city lights. The object was neutral in color, without any external lights and seemed to phase in and out while on a very straight but fast trajectory for about 10 seconds in a southerly direction. 
Approximately 1 hour prior to our sighting, one of my daughters and her friend had witnessed an object of like appearance in the same area and informed me of what she had seen. 
I dismissed her account until I went outside later and witnessed it for myself. I live near Tinker AFB and I have seen B-2 bombers flying before. This was distinctly different. The shape was long and thin with a slight boomerang "V" configuration.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Blue lights splitting into 3
description:
2 Blue Orbs split into 3. 2 stayed front 1 in back. The one in the back looked like it was going to split but was out of sight before we could see it. 
They all moved individually. 
Saw the orbs or balls of blue lights from SE and they were moving towards NW.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: UFO seen over civilian side of Birch Hill
description: My family and I were traveling down the Steese Hwy heading towards Fox, when my son noticed a strange object in the sky and asked what it was. I looked out of the passenger window and saw a diamond/football shaped aircraft with bright orange lights around the entire perimeter. I was lost for words. I heard nothing. It just appeared to be hovering. I know what the lights of helicopters and planes look like and this was neither. I live on Fort Wainwright and this was nothing like I have ever seen before in my life. Totally unexplainable. I try to talk to people about it and they appear to think I am a little crazy sounding, but I know what I saw. It was a UFO.

summary: Riverview/Brandon FL, 1 strange light that changed direction and color from white to red and green
description: On 31 Oct 2013 at approximately 20:17 hours in Riverview, FL, while handing out candy with my wife and 3 year old daughter, I witnessed what I thought to be a fly over of the International Space Station again (it passed over our area a couple of days ago). It was a bright light moving from Northwest to Southeast just as fast as the space station did but then it started to slow down, stop, change from a bright white to a red and green light, back to dim white, slowly move east, then slowly move north again. I thought this to be extremely odd and that’s when I called my wife over to witness it with me. We stood at the end of our driveway looking north and watched it change color and patterns a couple of times. I asked my wife to film it with her Samsung Galaxy S III phone but because of the distance and with the light coming from my house (to inform trick-or-treater’s that we are handing out candy) the strange light in the sky didn’t show up on her phone. At approximately 20:20 is when my next door neighbor came out from her house to see if there were any more kids going to stop by. I asked her to come out to the end of her driveway with us to see if she knew what it was. She…

description: Standing very close to the Santa Cruz beach A very bright object suddenly appeared in the sky and made an arc downward at a very fast speed - disappears below the trees - as if heading into the Pacific Ocean

summary: long slim line of dimmish lights of different hues of green yellow and orange, descending and then disappeared
description:
It was a long slim line of dimmish lights of different hues of green yellow and orange but I couldn't see the shape of the craft, only the lights. It was about eye level in the horizon and it was pretty damn close. 
I thought it was a plane out of the corner of my eye until I looked directly at it for about 2 seconds and it straight up disappeared out of the air, just gone!!! It freaking disappeared like it was crazy!!!

summary: Object falling from sky
description:
We were night watching when a large object appeared in the sky. We thought it was a star at first, but then realized it was falling and also was way to large. 
The object was sphere shaped in the west part of the sky. It was slowly falling and after about ten minutes vanished from sight.

summary: I was looking to see the International Space Station on Halloween night when a craft flew directly over my home.
description: It was Halloween night and on the news that evening, the weatherman reported the International Space station would be visible. So between groups of children where I was handling out candy I’d be looking up in the night sky just to see if I could see it. At approximately 19:00 hours while looking up directly flying over my house in a westerly direction I could only see the bottom of this craft. It appeared to be approximately 40 yards long with the bottom being metallic, but not being smooth. The bottom of this craft looked molded to circumvent or to go around internal equipment. The craft shot off continuing West faster then ANYTHING I have ever seen. My neighbor across the street was on his deck cleaning up and asked what that was. Initially I was excited because I actually thought I’d seen the International Space Station. The following day I was speaking to another neighbor who is in the FBI and a huge Amateur Astronomer. I told him I saw the Space station! and he stated how? He set up his telescope that night and I again said he would not need the telescope because I saw clearly with my eyes. He set it up anyway and when he located the Space Station via the telescope I…

description: No picture, went by so fast, but it is imoporinted in my brain. I know what I saw.

2 adults and 4 children seen a fireball centered 2 telephone poles high above highway 7. Drove under it turned around and parked almist under it where we could still view through windshield. 
A firebal was just parked there in the air for several moments. At first it decended slowly than it raced out if aight. We are baffled

summary: There were 3-5 low flying slow moving spherical objects moving horizontally across the sky on Halloween night, 8:40-9:00 PM 2013
description:
I was driving my friend home from my apartment when I looked at the sky and saw 3 balloon-like objects floating extremely low over the sky. I knew they weren't balloons though because 1) they glided sideways with ease, not erratically and 2) they never floated upwards, just sideways and 3) there were no strings attached, as there would be had a child lost their balloon. 
They moved slowly, and I only got a short glimpse of them as I was driving, but they were light grey and entirely unmarked. 
Another interesting aspect was at first I only saw 2 of them, but then one of the spheres seemed to split in half, and a third craft became visible, and then a fourth which also appeared from the same area as the other craft. It looked like a fifth was emerging when I lost sight of them. I don't know if I was just at a strange angle and saw them simply moving out from behind another craft or if they actually merged out from one another. I couldn't get an image, unfortunately, of anything as traffic was somewhat chaotic and my eyes had to be on the road.
I'm not entirely sure what I saw at all,
The party who submitted the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact…

summary: orange orbs that seperate into three moving extremly fast
description: After bringing my wife to work I witnesses something fall from the sky then come to a complete stop. it was a orange orb. orb hovers for a few min then seperared into three flashing colers of red yellow blue and then they would come back together and turn back orange. me and two other neighbors Worcestershire for about 35min. it was in the sky south of ocala.we yardage telescope to observe but it looked like a soccorball that changed colors

summary: Massive red glow in the eastern sky occurring twice within two or three minutes, each lasting 3 seconds.
description:
While driving east on Yamato Road very early, the eastern sky lit up with a red glow which lasted for three seconds. 
It was followed two minutes later by a second red glow which lasted again for about three seconds. 
Could find no evidence of wreckage or explosion or fire to explain the massive size and color of the light.

summary: Green/White light flying towards the ground in San Diego.
description:
This morning at roughly 05:10 a.m. while driving to work I saw a green/white light fly across the sky in a downward direction. At first I thought it was an airplane about to crash, but it was moving too fast and of course there was no explosion. 
I was driving past the Miramar Air base, but I know that no jets would be flying that fast towards the ground to land.

summary: 3 white lights flying over the East Coast just above the cloud ceiling moving like birds in formation
description: I was sitting on my balcony with a friend close to the ocean looking up. There was mild cloud cover. Cold and clear for the most part. I noticed what I thought at first was a shooting star. It was a small round white light slightly larger and a little more dull than the other stars visible. After a few seconds, the other two lights came in to view. From North to South, over the coastline. They flew low just above the cloud ceiling, at a pace faster than a jet in the distance, and much slower than shooting stars. They flew in an interesting almost chaotic pattern. They were in a kind of formation that resembled birds, randomly moving about each other occasionally. This lasted approximately 15 seconds before they flew south and out of sight. They did not make any noise. I pointed them out to my friend when as soon as I saw the first light, thinking it was a shooting star. I followed them with my finger until they were out of view, but unfortunately she did not see them. I was pretty speechless.

summary: Green Red, White and occasionally Blue spinning lights that appear stationary
description: Tonight we see the light located at a place Turtleback Mountain. The Lights are red, green,white and occasional blue. It appears stationary. I have seen this through astronomy binoculars and also very high up in the sky with a telescope. Through the telescope view it appears to be spinning. I have seen these lights in the north, west, east and southern sky I and several other family members have experienced this sighting no less then 10-15 times during the last month

summary: 6 bright orange lights in the sky moving south to north on 10/30/13 at 10 PM in New Kensington, PA
description:
As I was walking my dog at 10 pm on 10/30/13, six bright orange lights high in the sky moved across the sky in a line from south to north. When I noticed the first one I believed it was a helicopter but there was absolutely no noise and as it came closer I could see it was something I couldn't identify. It just looked like a bright, orangish light high up in the dark sky. 
The next 5 lights followed the same path and I could see four of them at a time until they faded out of view after passing overhead. Again, there was no noise at all. The bright orange objects seemed almost to be floating and flickering, and they were moving fairly rapidly, at about the pace of a helicopter but slower than an airplane. 
The entire event I witnessed took approximately 10-15 minutes. I couldn't see the shape or size of the objects but each one of the 6 appeared to be identical. 
As they passed from my view overhead I couldn't see them for very long as they headed north. I wished someone else had been around to witness this event with me, but I was alone and didn't feel comfortable knocking on a neighbor's door at that time of night although I did call a friend on my cell as it was exciting to see…

summary: Stationary blinking white light
description:
Approximate date of sighting 10/29 or 10/30, approximate time 9-10 pm.
I was outside in my backyard briefly letting the dog out, and looked up at the night sky, as I frequently do on a clear night. Within my peripheral vision, I caught a rather bright flash (approximate astronomical magnitude -5) of white light of less than 1 second duration. I would estimate the size of the light to be slightly larger than the planet Venus, and was noted at the straight overhead position, 90 degrees above the horizon. This white blinking light reoccured several times, at an interval of ~10-15 seconds, and for a total duration of less than 1 minute. It then abruptly stopped. The blinking light remained in the exact same position throughout that time. My impression is that it had an altitude of at least 20,000 feet, but possibly greater. No associated object/fuselage could be observed. I would say that it had a very similar appearance to a bright, blinking white beacon light that one would observe atop a radio transmitter tower. It was definitely not an aircraft navigational light.
I am an experienced observer of the night sky. I am familiar with the commercial aircraft on their approach pattern to…

summary: Disk-shaped object with red/blue/green lights flowing left to right that appeared to stop and become a horizontal bar of light.
description: I saw a flat, roundish object at about 400 feet above the trees on the east side of the 280 freeway. Color flowed across it from left to right - red, green, blue. I watched for about 30 seconds when it turned west and appeared to stop - the bands of color then became static and looked like a horizontal bar of color floating in the air. I drove past and couldn't see it in my rear view mirror. A drone? Some sort of weird advertising float? It was moving fairly quickly, so not sure. Very strange.

summary: Spotted 3 red lights triangular in Clermont, Florida.
description:
I was driving on the way home on 27 highway with my daughter. I spotted 3 red lights triangular that was in the sky and told my daughter to look at it. Then one light disappeared and two lights moved closer that made us baffled! 
My daughter thought it was probably a chopper but the 3 lights didn't move like airplane and helicopter do. So, we got out of my car. 
To be honest, I am deaf and I can't hear so my daughter heard the sound like boom boom that almost like a firework.

summary: UFO seen in Taylorsville, NC 28681
description:
It was a triangle shape with three white lights on three sides and one red light in the middle it was flying fast and low it made no sound and was flying east. 
Me and my brother seen it flying over our house the area where the UFO was sighted is kind of a wooded area.

summary: Bright White light
description:
I was standing out on my patio I noticed what I thought was a satellite coming through, only it stopped next to a comet/star the other one took off at full speed in the opposite direction. 
The main one stayed for about 3 more minutes then it took off as well then all the sudden you see a red light like a comet falling to earth. 
Now with that being said On Oct 29th at this same time, I seen this same type of thing happen this object was flying lower no noise no identifiable marks no flashing lights just really bright lights like a plane it passed over the tree's in the backyard I followed to the other side of the tree's to watch it I seen a red light shoot out of it and the object then disappeared only to reappear once again and vanish altogether 
Clear nights no air traffic in sight.
The party who submitted the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information, so we are unable to contact the witness. PD

summary: Very loud craft with two vertical neon green circles
description: I was getting out of my car and heard what I thought was a plane landing, which is not unusual since I live so close to the Richmond Airport. Then, the sound got louder and louder, like the “plane” was about to crash in my front yard. The noise was very similar to the engine of a plane, but not the whistling sound planes make when they are in air. I walked outside to see where the craft was and saw what definitely was not an airplane. All I could see of the craft were two neon green circles on each side of whatever the body was. I could not see the body because the green nights were too bright. It appeared that the lights were spinning like propellers, but the lights made hollow rings, not full circles. They were also spinning vertically, like wheels on a wheel chair. What was also interesting is that even though it looked like the craft was moved by the propellers, they did not make the pulsing noise that helicopter propellers make, it was a very consistent, loud engine sound. The craft also had a small blinking white and red light on the body, but it was flying way too low to have been anything legitimate. The craft flew out of my sight probably in about 15 seconds, by the time…

summary: 4 white lights spinning fast in a big circle.
description:
I walked out to the back yard and seen 4 lights in the sky above my neighbors house. The 4 lights were spinning fast in a big circle and were silent. Then they would move to the center of the circle and back out. When a cloud would pass by, you could tell the lights were above the clouds. This continued for several minutes. 
Finally, the 4 lights moved back to the center of the circle and stopped. Then 1 light disappeared at a time until they were all gone. I seen the same thing 2 years ago but it was in the front yard and around Jan/Feb. I tried using my camera to record it but the camera couldn't pick up the lights. 
Surely there is an explanation but I know there were no spotlights coming from the ground.

summary: Consistent, bright lights in sky.
description:
Three times in the past week.
@1900 hrs, a bright light appears in the distance, 220 - 240 degrees, WSW (azimuth) at 10 - 15 degrees (altitude).
No planets or other stellar phenomena are expected in that quadrant.
After about an hour (apprx 2000hrs), the light will begin to dip into the horizon, sometimes disappearing over Sparta, NJ.
Other times, it begins to track northerly. Disappears and re-appears north.
On one clear day, last week, it could be seen in the north for quite some time.
Powerful binoculars and USArmy field glasses fail to help resolve image.
Investing in a powerful telescope.

summary: Extremely bright ball of light over West Scranton.
description:
Object that is much brighter than a star appeared in the sky over west Scranton for two nights in a row immediately after sun down. Object appeared in the same location both nights and moved very slowly in a northerly direction until it's out of sight. 
Without binoculars, the object appears to be a ball of light but with binoculars, it appears gray/metallic in color judging by the reflection of its own light. 
I may be incorrect but it also looked like it had a row of windows or sections that were narrowly separated, with something moving behind them. Reminded me of the Barney Hill UFO but it was too far to be conclusive. It's either a UFO or a low flying satellite but it is definitely not a star. 
Note: object appeared in same location as a 2008 up close and personal UFO (giant orange ball light resembling the sun but wasn't since the sun was also out but in a different location) but this time the object was much further out. I observed the object on both da! ys. Two members of my family witnessed the object on day 2.
Possible sighting of Venus, we believe? PD

summary: Greenish-white fireball tracking east-west, spotted early a.m. 10-30-13, at high rate of speed; SW Ada County, ID.
description: My wife and I were walking our dogs along the New York Canal, near Kuna, ID, shortly before 7:00 a.m., when suddenly, she said, "look at that!". It was still dark, and looking northward, towards the town of Meridian, was a bright greenish-white obect or objects moving at a high rate of speed in a roughly east to west direction. The light seemed to be split in-two, as if it had a double flare-like appearance. The object(s) appeared to be only several thousand feet above ground at this point as it would have been beneath the light cloud cover existing at the time. We soon lost sight of object as it dissapeared behind a grove of trees, but seemed headed some where to the south of Ontario, OR. There were no aircraft landing, amber or strobe lights associated with this, and I assumed this was probably a meteor which may have broken in two. I did hear a slight roaring sound at the time; not sure if associated with this or other aircraft in the area. If the FAA has radar data pertaining to this from the Boise airport or Mountain Home AFB, it may be possible to track a possible landing site of meteorite in western Idaho or eastern OR.

summary: 3 red/orange lights over Sacramento
description:
At 7:15 PM on the 29th of October, 2013 I witnessed 3 bright red/orange lights of the same brightness, to the East of Sacramento, California. 
Viewing from Fulton Ave. near Cottage Way, they were approximately 30-40 degrees high traveling from NE to SW (225° heading), slow and steady. They were all moving along the same path, on the same line, the 2 in front were approximately 5 degrees apart with the 3rd partially obscured by clouds, another 15 degrees behind, no navigation lights could be seen. 
I looked down at my iPhone to text a friend, when I looked back up with the intent of trying for a video, they were gone. It could have been a meteor breaking up but they were moving very, very slowly. The speed was about the same as an airliner at altitude but the lights were much brighter, and they disappeared in a clear area of the sky. 
Total duration of sighting was 20-30 seconds.

I have been seeing this ball of light off and on for about 2 or 3 months. It has been seen in the same area each time except for 28 and 29 Oct 13. It has moved more southerly (about 255 degrees).
It starts out each night just above the trees and then arcs westerly until it disappears below the horizon. It takes about an hour or so for it to arc and go below the horizon. The movement is much faster than any of the stars in the sky.

summary: I feel this is probably a new satellite of some sort, but would like to have it on record as a sighting.
description:
I called in a report of an unidentified flying object and left a brief message. We first saw the object around 6:30PM on October 29, 2013. Location was on the northern tip of the Monterey Bay near Santa Cruz, CA.
The sky was clear and this was the only object showing in the sky. It was very bright and looked like it was slightly moving, but it never went anywhere. It wasn’t an airplane of any sort. The object was round. I have a video I made of it with my Sony Camera 20X lens and it appears to be dancing slightly around, occasionally dipping. I don’t understand this, because with the naked eye it doesn’t appear to be doing anything.
Here’s the curious thing. It’s now 8:00PM and the object is still in the same place, except it’s moved lower, and I have to assume it’s because the earth is moving, and not because the object has moved lower.
Because of this, I feel this is probably a satellite, but I’ve lived here in the same place for the past 14 years and have never noticed it before.
I have no background in this type of thing as do none of the other observers.

summary: Unexplained Bright Stationary Flash of Light Kingston WA
description:
Date: 10/28/2013 TIME: 20:17 PDT Country: United States State: Washington City: Kingston Sighting: Unexplained Bright Stationary Flash of Light I had just put the dogs into the house after our evening walk. I live in a rural area (it’s very dark) and often gaze up at the sky and practice picking out constellations or stars. I have done this almost all my life and I have never seen anything that I could not explain outright. 
On Monday October 28th at approximately 08:17 PM PDT I was facing SW and at around 70 degrees above the horizon just above some tall fir trees I saw a bright light turn ON like a flashlight in the sky then turn off approximately 1 or 2 seconds later. It was not moving. It was approximately 7 to 10 times brighter than the stars around it and most certainly not an aircraft light. It may have been 3 times the size of the closest star. I waited and it occurred again approximately 2 minutes later.
Although a dull sighting, it was odd enough to me that I figured if someone else saw it and was hesitant to report it they might see my report and add a corroborating report. I noticed a similar report in Kennewick on 10/20/2013.
Sighting of Venus, we suspect. PD

summary: Bright white light with less intense light suspended below, not moving rapidly, observed over 40 minutes.
description:
Driving home from Ottawa to Dunrobin I saw a bright white light ahead and to the right (north). I thought it was the landing lights of an approaching aircraft. There was a second less intense light below it that moved with it as if suspended. It did not appear to be approaching as fast as a jet would. I made a right (northerly) turn and observed the light now to my left. It seemed suspended in the sky at an altitude of perhaps 800-1000 meters. A left turn kept the object on my left where it stayed for 15 minutes in much the same position, but moving slowly west away from me.
Upon arriving home my wife and I went outside with binoculars and observed the object for 15 minutes. It was definitely two lights vertically positioned. It did not appear to be moving in the sky although it was now some distance further west. It moved much too slowly for a plane and the intensity of the lights did not change. A planet or star would not have changed position relative to my travel. Perhaps it was a weather balloon drifting slowly. At the closest point it seemed to less than a mile away and was very bright. It may have receded to a distance of 10- 15 miles when stopped observing.

summary: 3 Fire Orange Glowing Spheres Move Through the Skies Over Stillwater Oklahoma

It was moving at twice the speed, if not more, than the typical aircraft seen in that area. The size of the glowing sphere, to the naked eye, was about if you were looking at a dime you were holding up in your hand with your arm fully extended. The first sphere was visible for roughly 20-30 seconds, before it moved far enough to be out of sight.
Almost at exactly the moment when the first sphere was out of sight, a second sphere appeared from the exact location as the first. It looked exactly like the first sphere, moving at the same speed, and following the same flight path. I watched as it moved through the sky, and when it got nearly out of sight, I looked at the point in where it came from to see if there would be any others. To my amazement, a third fire colored glowing sphere appeared from the exact location as the two before it. Yet again, it was exactly identical in looks, traveling speed, and…

summary: Saw "Fireballs" in the sky last night.  Same as many other UFO video and sightings. Have pictures.
description:
At approx. 9:15 P.M., I was on the phone with my mother and from behind the tall oak trees, I saw 3 very large fire ball looking objects in the sky. They were flying relatively low, juxtaposed to the typical air traffic I see here.
The balls were in a V formation, but were floating and flying at the same time... kind of swerving back and forth, but staying in somewhat of a V formation. I could barely tell my mother I'd call her back. Tried to hang up and get my phone camera set up.
By the time I focused and clicked, all but one was gone. Unfortunately, my camera picked up a dot. They just "went out." They didn't fly away. The sky was very clear and they definitely did not fly away. They just disappeared.
Called mom back in a freaked out state and was on the phone with her... Maybe 3-5 minutes and saw another one coming from the same direction. This time I didn't take time to say goodbye. Got the phone working and when I aimed to take the picture, there were 4 lights on my screen and only 1 in the sky. I kept snapping pictures, despite my disbelief. There were 4 on the screen and 1 in the sky.
It too, just disappeared. All of them would sort of "blink out." Again, unfortunately my…

summary: Six orange-red glowing balls in night sky over West Palm Beach
description: Six orange-reddish color lights in sky. 5 together and one off by itself. Clearly in a group and going in one direction- distanced were different as they disappeared at different times. Slow moving; lasted about 7 minutes. No sound and then vanished. Called my husband outside to see them- took video. Not helicopters, nor planes. Could not be explained. Never seen anything like it before.

summary: 6 balls of orange-red lights hovering over Mt. Wilson near San Gabriel Valley.
description:
Leaving driveway in car, stopped completely and got out of car when I noticed what appeared to be 6 slowly moving objects..orange-red balls of lights out in front/over the San Gabriel mountain range near Mt. Wilson (directly Northeast). 
I've watched the sky like any normal person would over my lifetime and this stopped me dead in my tracks. Absolutely not helicoptors, planes, etc. 
They flickered, hovered, pulsated and were slowly rising upwards together...changing positions slightly as they rose, then one by one appeared to just disinitegrate...or fizzle out of sight. 
As huge as these lights were, I am hard-pressed to believe NOBODY ELSE IN ALL OF LOS ANGELES SAW THEM. I can't find any other report. 
Please reply if you saw this or have an explanation~

summary: Amber-colored lights in triangle formation.
description:
Three large amber-colored, round, glowing lights seen flying in perfect formation for total of 30-60 seconds before going out of sight range. No sound noted, stayed in perfect triangle formation of either three individual craft, or one single craft. Traveled behind building, three witnesses attempted to follow, but craft left range.
These amber-colored lights have been seen three x's within this current year to date, only other sightings were single craft. All sightings were witnessed by at least three individuals each time.

summary: Bright light, ship cloaked out on me right in front of my eyes.
description:
As always I was out on my deck checking out the clear dark sky's. I do this several times during the evening every night weather it's clear out or not. I have these Binoculars that can see star's that the naked eye can't see with out them.
I had just got done scanning the Western sky's when an airliner coming out of the South heading East caught my eye. I followed the plane for a few seconds (now I'm facing east) and I bent my head back while turning to the West and this huge bright light caught me, really by surprise. It just wasn't there a few seconds ago.
I live next to an airport and have flown myself a few times, so when I say that it was about 15,000 ft. that's a pretty good guess. So any way I latch on to this light with these binoculars and I'm watching it fly over my head for about a minute and all of a sudden the light goes out but I can still see the damn thing. I'm watching this for a good 30 seconds when it just cloaked out on me. That's right, it just disappeared on me. I saw what looked like heat waves first and it slowly just disappeared. And it didn't make a sound.
I got a really good look at this ship, it was teardrop shape with2 the small end going forward. It…

summary: Stationary bright white light
description: Saw a bright white object that was stationary in the SW sky. Shaped like a circle but with long outer bands which reminds me of the Christmas star depicted in the Bible. Stayed completely stationary the entire duration. I went inside my home and came out a few minutes later and it was gone. Have noticed on this forum that the same object was sighted in a nearby county.

summary: Blue flash over mount sequoyah with hum
description:
My sister brought the occurance to the attention of my parents. Over Mount Sequoyah, there was a blue flash accompanied by an audible humming sound. It lit the sky up like lightning, but my camera was unable to capture the flash, only the humming sound. The flash eventually rescinded after at least 20 minutes. There was nothing in the local news about this incident.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Orange white orbs moving silent
description:
I walked outside to take the trash out and I saw to large orbs moving south east and one was bright orange and one was white. I do not believe it was an aircraft because of the size of the lights and the speed they were moving they were moving around each other and were larger than the moon. 
There was no noise and they were moving extremely fast. I have seen rockets and all kinds of aircraft in this area but this did not resemble anything of the sort. 
My kids came outside to look at the orbs and they also were very intrigued by the site. 
I thought maybe they were landing lights of an aircraft but they were moving away from me for a very good distance and the appearance of the lights never changed it appeared that they were high in the sky and moving over the ocean. 
I was a police officer for several years and I have seen my share of strange things but this was unexplainable to me.

summary: Four objects fly in seeming formation and make unusual turns. Almost hugging each other for a moment.
description:
4 well defined spots traveling west to east, south of 2 adults and a child, near university ave and rice street in St. Paul, mn 55103.
Could have been a meteor or other object breaking up, but the four or five objects seem to be monuvering on their own. We watched as they faded from view, towards the city of Woodbury, Washington county.

summary: I definatley could not idetify this flying object.
description:
The craft that was seen is very large with multiple shining lights. It was a square shape and it seemed that we were looking at the bottom of it. 
The lights that shinned down looked tentacle like. It seemed to be traveling in small circles around the summit of the mountain when it was not hovering. We took a seven minute video of the lights changing. 
As we watched the craft, it appeared to descend toward the ground. As we were watching it, it appeared to have other flashing lights in the distance. I would have to describe them as small explosions.

summary: 8 crafts or whatever, proceeding west to east along Lake Erie shore line, red, silent, with varying speeds, but generally in formation.
description: I alone observed 8 deep-red light-colored objects in the sky, proceeding from west to east, a ways out from the shore, of Lake Erie. The best analogy I can think of is moving Christmas ornaments! A red top, perhaps round, not sure, with a long glowing downward tail, again, all red. The first objects were four in number, not in rigid formation, but somewhat close together, followed by two more objects 10 seconds or so later, followed again by two more objects, about 20 seconds later. Since I don't know how high up they really were, I cannot estimate their speed, BUT, sometimes one or two would slow down just a bit, and then so would the others. It is a quiet night up here, little to no wind, clear sky with stars, not much traffic in my neighborhood 2 blocks from Lake Erie.

summary: I saw a large, round light,  moving extremely slowly towards the top of the mountain across from me at treetop level.
description:
UFO SIGHTING 7 PM OCTOBER 27, 2013 VANCOUVER ISLAND 
At approximately 7pm Sunday night Oct 27 I walked out on my west-facing deck to check out the evening just before it got dark. Had been working at my computer until then.
As I looked over the Alberni Inlet, I noticed a large, slow moving light in the Western sky, somewhat to the South. Approximately opposite the APD mill. It was too big and not bright enough to be a planet or star, too slow moving to be a normal aircraft. It slowly moved towards the tree line, looked like it was just above the trees. I realized it was exceptionally unusual and I should get my camera. I ran in and grabbed my camera and came out and shot about half a dozen pictures. None are that clear, but by zooming in on the computer I could see a perfectly round object with raised markings on the bottom: ridges and indentations going in a circle………….almost like a “copyright” seal.
I phoned a friend who lived at the lake, somewhere on the other side of that mountain. While I was telling her to look in the Eastern sky, back towards town, she said: “ I see it through the trees, a light in the sky”. 
I told her to try and get a photo but haven’t managed to connect…

summary: Multiple circular rotating lights.
description:
Multiple rows of multiple circular lights that rotated around a center point. Lighting was faint behind clouds in the sky. The lights would appear about every 5 seconds and last for about 3 seconds. 
Someone said that they were just the northern lights, but I have never seen the northern lights appear as rotating circles that appear every 5 seconds. He said that he has seen these lights before so this isn't the first sighting.

summary: I saw something in Lake Erie while I was out on the beach.  It looked like someone fishing with a net from a small boat but too far out for me to be sure.

I continued taking photographs of the sunrise then when I checked "my fishing boat again" I saw that it was heading away from me and it appeared to be above the water, 
I thought surely this is just my imaginations but when I put the pictures on my computer I can see that the object is above water heading west. I took a few more pictures but even with a 200 mm lens the subject is too far away and pixilated.
It looks like two vertical cylinders. I am curious to know if you have an explanation of what I saw or received any other reports. No lights and no noise that I could hear.

summary: At 7:05 my 28 yr old son and I were walking our dog.  We have been keeping our eyes to the sky ever since our last sighting this past summer.  In the western sky we saw what appeared to be a very…
description:
We watched it for a few minutes and noticed it starting to dim from a bright white to an orange color.
The object was moving slowly but clearly moving. It was not stationary.
I ran into the house to get binoculars and when seen up closer you could see that it was a cluster of 4-6 lights. The object started to descend lower and the dogs in our neighborhood including our dog, started to bark and howl. It was crazy!! We decided to see if it reacted to our flashlight. We flashed the object 3 quick flashes and to our amazement the street light repeated our exact flash pattern. We repeated the flashes several times and it repeated the pattern with the street light closest to where we were standing.
Out of fear, we stopped and just watched the light get brighter and then blink out completely.
It continued to go out and come back brighter each time. The light dropped below our line of site and we decided to go inside. We heard 2 jets traveling across the sky in the area of our sighting for several minutes.
After 20 minutes of activity it ended and we came in and decided to report what we saw. The skies over Cape Cod, MA are clearly full of activity. That is what we saw.
