I then got it in view with my binoculars and again saw two of the whitish-gold craft, side by side, right on the horizon at the water’s surface. I think that they could have possibly come out of the water based on what I previously seen, except that these objects were fully formed – I did not see the little ‘blob” of light get bigger and turn into the craft like I’d previously seen. I watched these objects for a short while as they pretty much stayed in place before disappearing.
 At 10:13 p.m. I saw to the NNW of me, in the same area that the previous nights UFO’s appeared, a brilliant, “crystalline,” green-blue, flashing light, about the size of a pea at arms length. It was no more than 4 or 5 miles away from me, well inside of the horizon. It would come on for a short second, go off for a short second, etc. 5 to 7 times each time it came on. It would stay off for perhaps a minute or two before coming back on. After the first 4 or 5 times that it came on, it started slowly getting dimmer, and then I realized…

summary: Saw a large mass moving sporadically with white and red (inconsistent) blinking lights and a humming sounds in waves.
description:
I was outside around 9:30 p.m. last night and I started to hear something that sounded like a plane, which I thought was strange since I never hear planes out at my house. Then I realized the humming noise wasn't at a consistent level. It was almost in waves.
So I am looking above me for this weird plane, and right when I give up I just happen to look out on the horizon and there it was! At first, yes it looked like a plane, but then I noticed there were red and white lights (too many for a plane or satellite) in somewhat of a row, blinking in (once again) inconsistent patterns.
So I watch the large figure in the sky as it was going in all directions, at different speeds, hovering around the same area. Then it made a weird zig-zag descent behind the tree line. All of this happened within about two minutes.

summary: Large, black, slow moving silent stingray shaped aircraft with 2 bright front headlights- red and green taillight
description:
Flying from the Atlantic Ocean toward 46th Street in Avalon, NJ, at 9:30pm moonless night. 2 large white lights in front of aircraft moving very slowly. No sound, black in color triangular in shape like an enormous stingray, silent, approx 800 ft in altitude. Tail had red green flashing light, moved south slowly and quietly.
upon sighting the duration of exposure was 10 minutes. Checked youtube online later and saw 2 videos that captured the same object in Arizona/Colorado.

summary: Red, orange, yellow silent object hovering and flying in the sky then disappearing.
description:
It was strange. They changed color. 
All of a sudden they just hovered in the sky coming out as a bright red the farther away they went their color faded to yellow. 
We followed them till they disappeared right over our head. Too fast to be something small. 
Seemed very large, no sound. 
It was pure silence out in the woods. 
They appeared from the woods. Not an animal made a sound no crickets. Just silence.

summary: Saw very bright neon blue light moving at impossible speeds and doing impossible maneuvers near power plant while with one other witnes
description:
As me and my friend were driving on the highway I-294 Southbound, I noticed an extremely bright and very low altitude almost neon blue sphere(light source). 
As I noticed the light I slowed down and we then observed the light make very strange and impossible maneuvers where it stayed still for around 30seconds then shot off into many different directions in a very short period of time. 
There is nothing to my knowledge that can move that fast and in that type of maneuvers. 
This sphere/light source was flying at such a low altitude that we should have been able to identify what kind of craft this was but the light almost had no shape to it, just a very bright almost neon blue color and light source. 
As well, as the light/sphere made no sound whatsoever when moving. 
The incident occurred over a field near some power transformers. 
After the incident I even went and checked to see if maybe this was just some type of new toy plane/flying thing for children or some kind of explanation, yet to my surprise when I tried to gain access to the field I was told by the power company that the field was off limits to the public. 
This is not a hoax and I was of sound mind and not under any…

summary: Approximately between 20:45 an 21:00 on the night of Aug. 15th, 2013, in the town of Milford, NH.  I was walking out walking my dog down my street heading south.  I noticed two commercial aircraft…
description:
At that exact time that I looked up I noticed an object that at the time I looked at it, it was stationary, and in a split second the object went from a stand still, to moving faster than any aircraft I've ever seen, and I served in the U.S. NAVY, and was subject to many different types of air craft and never saw anything move that fast. 
The object was moving south, it went as far as my eyes could see until it faded out of my sight. From what I could see with my own two eyes, it appeared to be spherical. There was no tail following this object so it did not appear to be a shooting star or meteor and was much to low in elevation to support that.

summary: Very bright large flying object moving very fast without any jet contrails in a clear sky
description:
We saw a very bright large object flying southwards (south-east) at high speed in clear sky. Interesting part was that the object did not leave any trail like usual jets and seemed to move faster that usual jets.
At first we thought it was the space state but it seem much lower in altitude than the space station after checking the NASA website the timings of ISS do not match.
The object was glowing strong white in bright sunlight.
May be a satellite but would be too close orbit and much larger for a satellite too.

summary: I figure they may have got caught in the hurricane and were fleeing west to get out of the storm.
description:
When the hurricane was off shore last summer heading toward New England I was out side watching the storm clouds blowing over and I noticed lights passing behind these large trees. 
I thought at first it was just one of the frequent blimps flying over. After a few minutes the lights came out from behind the trees headed from east to west. 
I watched these lights and noticed that the lights would be lite for a few secons then go Out. Not all at the same time. I watched for a while and more lights came out from behind the trees headed west. 
These lights were strung out about 10-15 (from ground view) inches long and five accross and they were escorting a mother ship. I called my grandson and his friend out (5th graders) to see the UFO's fleeing the hurricane. They became afraid and ran into the house. 
Neither will even speak about what they saw that night.
Witness indicates that the date of the event is approximate. PD

summary: Three bright orange low object under the monsoon clouds witnessed by two people
description:
My friend and I observed 2 bright orange objects flying towards us very low in the sky as it was monsoon season and we had been having rain. The two orange objects flew silently at a diagonal toward us under the clouds, so they were pretty low, like low flying aircraft would be. No sound. 
I got my binoculars and we both saw the same things: Cylinder shape objects with bright orange fire burning inside, then another bright orange light of same color up to the right in the cylinder, but round shape.
The 2 objects flew to a point over us. They hesitated for a few moments, than one flew straight behind us out of sight while the second one flew away at approximately a 45 degree angle to our right. Again, they were completely silent.
We both looked at each other in amazement wondering aloud and comparing our sighting with each other. While comparing out sighting I looked up at the direction the two objects had come from and there was a third identical object. This one was much lower and couldn’t have been more than 500 feet over us. It flew directly towards us and then hovered directly overhead. A few moments later it also flew off silently at a 45 angle to our right. We were both to…

summary: 3 white orbs over Lake Erie.
description:
3 white, strobing orbs seen flying over Lake Erie from Cleveland Browns Stadium. The orbs did not appear to be very large, but were a fair distance from the stadium, several miles. The first orb was flying solo, from NE to SW below cloud level , followed by two identical orbs about one minute later. 
They were flying faster and lower than the incoming jet. Flying in a straight trajectory but slightly rising and falling. 
As they approached the shoreline, they took a direct path west and moved exceptionally fast out of sight; gone in the blink of an eye. Too fast to be a known man made craft. They were close enough to see they were not a helicopter, plane or familiar shape.

summary: Saw metallic spherical object, disappeared in the sky
description:
On August 15th, 2013, at 7:45 pm my husband and I were driving home from a lake up north. We were on our way home. It was still light out. We were in Bauxite, Arkansas, near the post office there right at the Bauxite cutoff road. My husband was driving and I was in the passenger seat.
I was looking up at the sky and I noticed what I thought was an airplane or some kind of aircraft. It was silver, shiny, and metallic. I joked to my husband that I thought it was a UFO because it was rather oddly shaped, spherical but not like an airplane.
As I was watching this object in the southern sky, it made a turn and went west. Then, all of a sudden, the object disappeared right in front of my eyes! I immediately checked my phone app to see if there was a satellite in the vicinity. There was not.
I am still trying to figure out how this object disappeared. It was very high up, like an upper altitude airplane.

location: Roseau (West Indies; Dominica), AL, Dominica, West Indies
summary: Strange blinking light over the Caribbean sea.
description:
My wife and I live on the outskirts of the capital city of Roseau Dominica in the West Indies. On Thursday August 15, 2013, around 7:45pm my wife called me outside to view a white fireball moving from the south of our location to the north rather slowly. 
Now my wife and I have seen a number of these objects over the past 2 years so this was not new to us. We observed this object for about 13 minutes and then it disappeared. I went back into the house but my wife stayed outside for a bit. 
About 5 minutes later she called me again to observe another fireball which appeared much closer to our location and this one was moving from the north of our location to the east. 
I got excited because we have never seen two in the same night. 
Right after this one disappeared we saw yet again another one which appeared almost overhead and it was moving towards the east. We were very very excited at this point and we continued looking for more but saw none.
The following night we saw two but on the third night August 17th we observed something that we have never seen before. We were sitting on porch of our home facing west just having a conversation while we scanned the sky when I noticed a…

summary: Two white cylinder shaped objects with black bands in middle fly over Bude, Ms.
description:
I was on my porch a few minutes ago looking at the moon and saw a bright white cylinder shaped craft with a black band fly over the direction of the moon which is south right now. It seemed to be flying as if pulled on a string. 
As I was thinking about getting my camera another identical object passed over as though it was on the same line as the first. Both objects seemed to appear suddenly, had no contrail, no wings, no sound and were headed East. In fact I've seen several jet contrails today and these two objects had none. This is the third time I've seen these type of objects in our area. Last year in Meadville, Ms, and several yrs ago in a rural area in a National Forest area.

summary: "Plasma balls" traveling in a straight line spotted over Sturgeon Bay, WI.
description:
It was late afternoon and I was walking my niece’s dog on a path behind my mom’s house in south Sturgeon Bay, not far from the canal. I was walking toward the bay where I could see almost the entire horizon to the SouthWest. As I looked up, I noticed something traveling in a straight line in my direction. As it got closer, I noticed it was pink in color and looked just like what you would see in a plasma globe, just without the glass exterior. It was sparkly and sometimes would disappear out of view for a millisecond or two. As it got closer to my position, I noticed it was moving rather slowly, probably around 10-15 mph and wasn’t very high, maybe 2,000 feet in the air. It didn’t make a sound at all as it passed right over my head.
At that point, I looked over the bay and another object, exactly the same as the first, following in its path but about a mile or two behind. It was at the exact same height and moved at the same speed and trajectory as the first. I felt like it was close enough that I could have hit it with a rock as it flew right over my head.
I looked at the horizon again and there was a third, exactly as far from the second as the second was from the first. It was…

summary: 2 different objects on the same day at 2 different times
description:
This is not the exact time or the date. It was around this time and date though.
 My friend and I were hanging out on our street. There were 6 other people there too who did not witness the event. My friend and I decided to leave the group of people and hide behind a flower bed to see what the groups would do. It was a fairly clear day, no wind and about 60 degrees outside.
The group came looking for us and I was looking south while they were coming up the street facing north. I watching them looking for us and over the tree line I noticed a metallic/gray rounded/cigar shapped object. It was moving up and down as it was flying from the east to the west. It would drop about a 250 feet then a few seconds later go straight up to its intial attitude. It did this multiple times until it vanished about 10 seconds later.
Later that same night about 19:00 my friend(the same one from earlier) and I were playing basketball as my friend was shooting he witnessed a blue light go across the sky. It was moving about a moderate speed and was only one blue light there were no blinking lights which made me know its not a plane and no tell so it was not a comet, shooting star, etc... He pointed it…

summary: grey  oval diamond shaped craft with v like indention in center
description: a friend and myself were in the mountains in north carolina,I was visiting from Tennessee he took me to a friends cabin and we were taking picture s of the beautiful scenic terrain and my friend billy said hey look he was pointing streight in front of him ....my right I saw what he was pointing at and it was oval to diamond shaped craft it had a v like place cut on the back or front of it it was moving erratic in a small area and hovering almost like a zigzag but staying in one spot it was about the size of a aproximately 1/4 of an inch with naked eye, if I were to try to scale it to measure infront of my view it looked like maybe 1500 feet up in the sky it was silent it made no noise and when it moved you could tell the shape of it top view and a side view when it moved,position in the sky was level to top half of mountain ridge top and slightly above it was grey to dull color almost black and it moved up stopping for a few seconds and then went straight u! p until it disappear out of sight it was very fast, but when it first started moving about as it was maybe 90degree shift from left to right very weird ive seen nothing move like this that's conventional aircraft flying this…

summary: Silvery, shiny orb hovered above for 20 minutes.
description:
In Aug. 2013, six of my family were swimming and observed an object above us for approximately 20 min. 
The object was 500+ ft above and hovered then drifted easterly until out of sight.

summary: Witnessed a weird glowing cloud approximately 25 stories in the air.  What drew my attention, was that two glowing white orbs of light flying slowly alongside each other, emerged from this cloud.…
description:
I don't recollect what happened to the second glowing orb, but the second I followed from the ground, darting around in the sky. I then took out my smart phone to take pictures.
 This one light first hovered in front of a 24th story window. It then shot around to the side of the building and hovered above the building motionless as if it recognized that I was taking a picture of it. Also at this time the "glowing cloud" took on a sphere shape with the sun directly behind it. It stood out because the sky was clear save for this one "cloud." As it became spherical, it hovered very close to the roof of this 26 story building; with parts of this cloud obfuscated part of the railing alongside the roof. I can provide pictures.

summary: Triangular craft seen flying fast and high, then disappeared.
description:
This incident happened to occur while there was a blue sky with no clouds on a hot summer day and I was staring at the sky infront of our caravan. 
One jet-sized triangular craft seen flying faster and higher than usual planes or jets without any noise. The inner side of the triangle was transparent and blurred. On the outside there were several symmetric lights. The craft flew a straight line and then just disappeared after a few seconds.
Witness indicates that the date of the event is approximate. PD

summary: there was a haze or disruption around object
description: was with a friend and saw this craft no noise at all shot out fast then disappear after a brief time hovering and dancing in the air

summary: Solid black, bat shaped, flat, silent and slow flying large object over I 70 East of Blue Springs, Missouri
description:
I Was driving to Columbia Missouri from Kansas City. Just east or so of Blue Springs, there was what I first thought was a large black kite slowly and silently heading from North to South crossing the Hwy I was driving (Interstate 70 east). 
After it was overhead, I was continuing to drive and pay attention to the road so didn't have the chance to see where it eventually went or headed to. It was headed south. There were other cars on the highway and I thought surely someone else would have seen it and reported it but I haven't read or seen anything about it in the media. 
I thought it was possibly a new type of Drone that perhaps the military was testing because it was solid black, silent and "bat" shaped. I looked up Drones on google to see more of them, but didn't see any such thing. The Drones on the internet looked completely different than what I saw and I realized I saw something that is probably unexplained.

summary: Orb dancing across the sky while ufo was near!
description: Noticed star like object that was sitting still but changing colors. After about 5 min it left then came back a few min later. There was a small orb that seemed to skip around the sky when the UFO was present. It looked as if it was skipping on water in all directions and turns!!

summary: Big bright light that didn't move then dimmed into two littles lights and moved away and disappeared.
description:
I was standing at the end of my driveway when I looked down the street and into the sky where I saw a bright light which I thought was a star. I went up my driveway and the light got brighter, I knew it was a plane when it didn't move or make any noise and how big it was.. 
I called my boyfriend over to help me indentify what I was looking at. We both started at it until it messed with out eyes. The longer we stated at it, the blurry it got. 
My boyfriend went into the grass to try and get a better view of what it was. The light dimmed way down into two small lights then moved at a normal speed to the right. I tried to follow the lights to where I could see behind the trees, but it disappeared.

summary: Disturbing sightings in Maine.
description:
3 friends and I sat on the porch. We witnessed a white thin cigar shaped craft in the north eastern sky, heading west north west. It had no contrail it disappeared behind a cloud for several minutes, after 2 of us made hand signals. Pointing, first at our eyes and then it. It appeared to have little to no visible wing, flying at a high altitude and was silent. it looked to me, what I would expect a drone to look like. it came out of the cloud heading the opposite direction. after a 1-2 minute trip to another cloud it exited the same cloud about 10-15 seconds later it exited that cloud accelerating hard with a solid contrail, I didn't know our boys had jets or thrusters of any kind on our white drones, and had heard that they were invisible to the naked eye. so what I saw did disturb me enough to report this tonight. 
also in the same area of the sky 2 bright objects flashing from red, blue and white. similar but not the same distance from my town in the same direction but a bit further away and lower to the ground always at night. It seems to move faster than other stars, the closest one. it also appears to be doing zigzags, up down and at times quick up down or slanted movements.…

summary: Broad daylight no clouds unobstructed view of shiny object.
description:
On north plains industrial rd sitting in a parking lot facing north east I looked up and there was what looked like a long cylindrical object that was shining from the sun.
It was flying at a very very low rate of speed. I looked down to open my side window and when I looked up it was gone. 
There was not a cloud in the sky and nothing to obscure my field of view. 
I looked all around in every quadrant of the sky and there was nothing. 
No plane would be able to move as fast as this object had to be moving to get out of my view in that short amount of time. 
I'm convinced.

summary: They remained stationary as the flashed.
description:
As I was on my back deck drinking coffee and smoking a cigarette, I looked into the night sky for a chance of seeing any left over meteors from the perisids. I did not see any streaking across the sky. 
But, suddenly, a bright stationary object appeared and flashed once then disappeared. About 5 seconds later it reappeared and flashed again remaining in the same spot. A split second after the second flash another, bright flash appeared to the left of the original object. It flashed again and disappeared. 
I stood watching for severl minutes and the objects did not reappear. I also looked for any flying aircraft from strobes but none were to be seen. 
The lights I saw were not aircraft strobe lights plus they remained stationary, while flashing.

summary: Spotted a UFO on two separate nights, and it may have reacted when I tried to communicate with it.
description:
This is an anecdotally written description of my experience, originally posted on an internet forum. I just clipped it in here, with dramatic flair and everything.
I will try to stay as precise and clear as I possibly can. This happened roughly two years ago. This will be long...
I have always wanted to believe, but I'm a natural sceptic to anything and everything. I believe nothing until you can scientifically prove it, at the same time as I believe everything is possible (because logically everything *is* possible).
It was fall 2013, and the Norwegian darkness comes fast when summer is gone. When I stayed home for a few months it kind of naturally fell upon me to be the one who walked the dog. My mom got a german shepard a few years back, and I quite like taking him for walks in the forest. I especially prefer walking in the forest at night, when it's pitch black. The woods are right next to our neighborhood, so I have easy access and know these woods like the back of my hand. That's why I'm able to walk it in utter darkness.
The time was somewhere around midnight, maybe later, as ((dog's name deleted)) and I went for our nightly walk. Being night I also let him run free, as…

summary: bright orange objects floating near NORAD
description: At around 0:50, traveling South bound Powers Blvd, my roommate and I noticed at least eight; very bright, orange-warm-colored and much bigger than any other lights or planes in the sky. The objects were further south, between NORAD (Cheyenne Mountain) and Fort Carson. They seemed to be stationary, one would fade out, then another would fade out and another would re-appear; in particular pattern. They were in small lines together, kind of lined up parallel of each other; again in no particular pattern- just random clusters of lines. We tried to continue South on Powers to see them, and eventually they all began fading out of vision.

summary: Three bright spheres in triangle formation hovering above horizon.  Slowly moved apart while one remained stationary.
description:
At roughly 0:12 on August 15th 2013 I was driving west down Counce Rd. toward Mississippi Hwy. 3, when I slowed down to see if I could pinpoint an odd sound coming from my truck. I rolled the window down to listen for the sound then sped up to see if acceleration had any effect on the noise. 
About thirty to forty-five seconds of driving at about 20mph a coyote ran out in front of the truck crossing Counce Rd. headed north causing me to stop. I watched the coyote run down the embankment and into a field. He stopped directly next to a telephone pole. 
As I was still stopped looking at the coyote I noticed a light that at first I believed was connected to the pole. About 35 to 40 degrees above the horizon I saw three bright semi-pulsating lights in a triangular formation.
My first thought was they were helicopters in a tight formation. Then I considered airplanes taking off from the Memphis airport. I've lived in Memphis most of my life and am very familiar with the take off/landing patterns of planes as FedEx has their main hub there. This time of night was about right for the first inbound flights of the night. I leaned over to the passenger side window and looked back east and…

summary: Multi-colored translucent parachute-shaped UFO flashes briefly in the sky falling to ground, indiscernible size.  Jellyfish-looking obje
description:
Out jogging late at night on a country road near a power plant, seen a UFO...opalescent jellyfish in the sky lit up for a moment before disappearing, could have been an organism or an aircraft, seeming to fall down toward the ground and I could only make out a a clear, colorful parachute outline. It had a life-like appearance such as a jellyfish with colorful skin, an exoskelton, etc. 
 Could only compare it to a jellyfish or a parachute, but I definately saw something different. Lots of radiation in the area due to the power plant if that makes any difference.

summary: Me and my family were driving through a parallel road to highway ( NH24) heading from ghazipur border to Delhi, the site of event was behind Hilton double tree hotel on a road next to Hindon canal…
description:
The UFO was shining like a twinkling star, the distance was about 25 to 30 meters from ground, when I stopped my car it also stopped ,it was moving random. I spent about 5minutes to look at it carefully. 
This was my second sight of UFO. The first sight was in UAE and the shape was disk and that was Hughes. I wonder if this lighting object also come under category of UFO.

summary: Extremely bright light at a high rate of speed.
description:
Very bright light coming from the north paused for 15 sec and then moved south at an incredible speed dimmed the light and disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Me and my dad were night fishing it was a star filled night and clear skys i remember because as i was fishing i kept admiring the stars in the sky .  in the distance i noticed 1 star that was really…
2 stationary fireballs
description:
I walked outside my house and instantly looked toward the southwestern sky. Close to the horizon were 2 stationary lights. They were red-orange in color. They didn't move at all. The sky was overcast completely. I couldn't even see the moon or any stars. We had a severe thunderstorm about 2 hours prior. The air was still and everything was quiet. The lights were at a distance, but they were quite noticeable and bright. After viewing them for about 30 seconds, I turned around to open the front door to yell for my husband. When I turned back to the southwest, I saw that one of the lights were dimmed and then disappeared. My husband came outside about 20 seconds later, and I showed him the remaining light. We stared at it for about 2 minutes, then it dimmed and eventually disappeared.
 My opinions-The way they seemed to "burn out" made me think they were fireballs. They were not in the normal flight paths for aircraft in this area. The way they were absolutely still was quite strange. I wonder if there were more of the fireballs prior to me going outside in the first place. Tomorrow I will take a photo of how the area looks during the day, and where I remember the fireballs were.

summary: Small white lights over BAKERSFIELD, CA
description:
I was looking up at the sky at around 10:30 last night, because we’ve been having a meteor shower and I hadn’t had the time to see one yet, as we live in a pretty bright area. As I was looking up (facing south) I noticed there were four stars in a trapezoid shape. I thought it was strange because I’d never noticed that star constellation before, when all of a sudden the two “stars” on the right side of the trapezoid started to move upwards and westward, together. I called my fiancé out to look.
They had a very fluid movement to them, they moved together but sort of drifted a little more together and a little more apart at times. They moved fairly quickly for what tiny lights we could see. They looked just like dim stars but the lights pulsated instead of twinkled the way stars do.
The lights ended up stopping to the west aligned with a bright star. A few seconds after the lights stopped, the biggest meteor I have ever seen streaked across the sky, and right as it happened, the craft or crafts adjusted themselves to face where the meteor had just been.
We continued to stare at the lights for about 10 minutes, but they just hung there, very still in the sky. We decided to go inside.…

summary: The Object was Triangle Shaped, Had blinking colors of Red, White, Green, and Shaked as it tried to move as confirmed by 4 people.
description:
I was outside looking for any remaining meteors possibly falling from the meteor shower that we are supposed to have and saw a Triangle shaped formation that was blinking a red/white/green color rapidly and then the shape started to shake. 
I observed that for about 15 minutes until I called a friend to come up to my house which lives down the street and look at the object to make sure that what I saw was truly there. 
He saw the same thing and when my neighbors came home from the religious services I asked them to look at the object in the sky as well and since one is color blind he didn't see the colors but saw the object and it shaking. 
The other person saw what i saw and the other observer saw as well. We have 3 confirmed people that saw the colors and 4 confirmed people that saw the shape as well as the shape that was shaking. 
We then proceeded to check the rest of the sky and saw two other shapes that exhibited the same characteristics as the first possible craft that we saw. 
We have watched this for about an hour now and it ended about 23:15.

summary: SECOND SIGHTINGS OF GLOWING ELONGATED/FOOTBALL SHAPED UFOS WITH A DIRECT CORRELATION TO OUR NINTH SIGHTING
description:
SIGHTING # 25 – August 14, - SECOND SIGHTINGS OF GLOWING ELONGATED/FOOTBALL SHAPPED UFOS WITH A DIRECT CORRELATION TO OUR NINTH SIGHTING OF “FIREBALL” UFOs AND “FLASHERS” I arrived at my regular skywatch location at 9:30 p.m. on the south end of Captiva Island, FL, USA, just north of the rock jetty at Blind Pass. The weather was clear and calm, with some clouds well past the horizon of the Gulf of Mexico. The moon was almost half full and high in the sky when I first arrived.
 Based on my previous nights sightings and knowing that I could only see the glowing, white/gold UFOs through my binoculars, I had them trained toward the NNW, just off shore of uninhabited Cayo Costa Island, when at approximately 9:50 I got really lucky and saw two of the glowing UFOs appear to “pop” out of the Gulf of Mexico, perhaps 5 or 6 miles away from me. I estimate the miles based on the horizon being at 7 miles over water, and these objects were just inside the horizon. I say “lucky” because I only saw them briefly, maybe 15 seconds or so, before they “turned off,” slower than a light switch, but not as long as if on a dimmer switch. I don’t think I would have seen them from where I was without…

summary: 12 Bright Orange Orbs In Single File Formation.

12 Bright Orange Orbs Fell Out Of The Sky Into A Triangle. Then Went Into Single File Formation With The First One A Little Above The Second One. Then The Rest Fell In A Perfect Line. 
I Was In My Car At The Time On My Way To Work. I Looked Out My Window While Driving I Had My Head Out The Window Looking Up At The Last One In Line. No Sound Coming From Them. They Were About 100Ft. Above My Car. They Were About Basketball Size And They Seemed To Pulsate.

summary: 12 bright orange flashing objects, coming east to west, in staggered formation, slowly disappearing in the sky in Upper Macungie Twsp.
description:
Out walking the dog and in the sky saw about 12 bright orange flashing objects - looked triangular - rising from just above houses - coming from an easterly direction and going west - rising diagonally into the sky and disappearing. 
They were in a staggered formation and moving slowly. The last one was not in formation, was coming from the east, heading straight west, it looked like it hung in the air for about a minute and then slowly went straight up and disappeared. 
The sky was dark and clear of clouds.

summary: Orange/Yellow/Red Sphere or Orb seen in Romeoville, IL in night sky followed by low flying helicopters  TWO Seperate sightings on differ
description:

I ran into my home to grab my cell phone and call my two teenage children out to see this object. This orb was traveling North slightly Northwest while rising up in elevation. This object did not make any sound. However within minutes of seeing this we could hear helicopters and airplanes in the air. Many of the helicopters were flying at a low elevation.
The same object seen on August 29th @ 20:34 outside of my home. Object was directly West flying/moving Northwest.again no sound. The object was moving slower than the sighting on 08/14/13. Again helicopters and airplanes were heard then seen flying around my home. The helicopters did not fly as low this day as they did during my first sighting.
I work at a suburban hospital. I am the director for one of the non clinical areas. I have two teenage children 15 & 16 that were witnesses to both events. I have a 6 year old nephew that witnessed the first event.

summary: Large amber/orange sphere glowing above beach no sound, no blinking lights, sitting still for 1-2 min., disappeared into thin air.
description:
At our resort in N. Myrtle Beach Ocean Creek, while on balcony with ocean front view, very close to 21:00 we (my husband and I and our 2 sons) saw a bright amber/orange sphere glowing above the beach, it did not make a sound, no blinking lights just sat there still for 1-2 minutes, ran to get camera, but it then disappeared into thin air before it could take a picture or video, like someone turned off a light. 
We have never seen anything like this before, it was just sitting in one spot not moving. It was not a flare, meteor, plane, helicopter, or military. 
We have never seen anything like it. It was a clear night with stars out. We did not see any aircraft except glowing sphere in sky above beach.

summary: lights over Buckeye near mountains
description:
On August 14, 2013, I was driving home down Citrus and Van Buren heading south, I spotted about eight or more amber lights in the sky. I thought they might be helicopters but I found it odd that there were so many and so close together. 
It was after 9pm and my daughter was tired, otherwise, I would have tried to get closer to the lights. She thought it might be some kind of business on the mountains. I have never seen the lights there before.

summary: Saw a triangular, slow moving, and silent craft hovering above highway.
description:
My dad and younger sister were on our way home from church Wednesday night when we saw a very bright light in the sky above hwy 49. 
At first it seemed to be a radio tower but I reined it was a steady light, not blinking. We got closer we realized the light was a giant spotlight shining into the sky. At that same moment we all realized it was stationary! This thing was hovering! We pulled over and I jumped out to record it, but when I jumped out it flew off at an absurdly slow speed without making any noise! I saw the bottom of the craft as it passed overhead, due to its lighrs on te bottom, and it was indeed in the shape of a triangle. It then continued to fly away until it disappeared from view.

summary: Fireballs over Massillon, Ohio that formed a triangle and took off
description:
My wife and I and a neighbor witnessed what looked like 7-10 balls/orbs of light headed towards us as we were driving in a residential area. We pulled over to take a look. The lights were just above tree height and approx 1 mile away in a non organized staggered arrangement. They were flying in a southerly direction when all of a sudden one by one they cut to the east and disappeared. Speed was slow and steady. No marker lights like an airplane would have.
After we thought they were gone, we stood around talking and then headed back to our car and the neighbor headed towards her front door, they were coming back from the same direction. When they reached the tree line, they dissipated and then suddenly an upside down triangle begin to form with the same lights in no particular order. Once formed, they broke off and headed east one-by-one again.
Within 3-5 seconds of the lights disappearing, a Southwest jet went right through the airspace on approach to Akron Canton Airport. They had to have seen it.
Color was reddish yellow, no sound, no tails

summary: 2 Fireballs trailing an aircraft . making erratic movements one which was vertical .
description:
I went outside to take a walk and as I was walking down the driveway I just happened to look up at an airplane that was flying overhead. As I was observing all of a sudden I saw a red-orange fireball that appeared to be trailing the airplane but from a distance. 
I yelled out to my 25 year old son and said look, "What is That ?"
The object then had made an erratic move to the right and all of a sudden was in the distance in front and below the airplane and then we saw a second fireball coming from the same direction as the first one, which was moving from the east moving northeast also seeming to trail the aircraft. 
 It made a sudden vertical move as it got closer to the aircraft and then it just vanished. 
I have been a Flight attendant for 17 years and have never seen anything like this before .

Looking directly west from where Cassiopeia is located at this time in our section of the hemisphere, and directly above my home - we saw a sudden and brilliant light. It was not a meteor. It didn't move from one point to another, there was no tailing off or t! rail. It was almost like a camera flash. At the time I measured the distance between the two objects as one finger width, from a fully outstretched arm. The two appeared to be exactly matched in both trajectory and speed. 
I told this to my daughter the next morning and we both turned toward each other (moments ago) as we listened to you describe your recent ISS flyover observation, which appeared to include a second object close behind. 
Now that I am familiar with this form I will begin more thorough observations & reports as we have been witness to numerous sky-based anomalies, as we are avid sky watchers. Regards.

summary: Fiery red lights appear and disappear above the Atlantic, just off the coast of Tybee Island.
description:
On the night of Tuesday, August 13, 2013, two other adults and I visited the beach on Tybee Island, just off the coast of Savannah, Georgia. We were standing near the pier when we witnessed several orange/red lights in the sky. 
First one light appeared. Seconds later two more appeared at about a distance of 3 or 4 times the width of the original light and to its right. They remained absolutely still for several seconds. 
Then the first light went out, followed shortly by the twin lights also going out. Several seconds later, the twin lights reappeared as before, followed by the first light again coming on. For a minute or so, the turning on and then off of these three lights continued. 
There was no discernible pattern. Sometimes the first light would come on; sometimes it would be the twin lights. Whichever appeared first would be the first to disappear. At no time was there any movement of these lights. They remained steadfast in their positions,! appearing and then disappearing like fire in the sky.

To my right, away from the jet traffic, I saw an unusually bright saucer shaped object at appx 1,500 to 2,000 feet. It was farther away from the airline traffic and was still 4 to 5 times larger than the jets. It was immense.

summary: Falling light then vanished
description:
My wife in I were drawn to the sky by thousands of birds flying above our apartment in some migratory pattern. I ran to get my binoculars for a better look at the birds but when I got back outside, I immediately noticed a strange hovering light in the distance.
To the naked eye it was an indistinguishable cylindrical light that appeared to be slowly falling from the sky. Through the binoculars it had a more defined rigid shape that resembled a crescent moon with peak in its middle. It fell for a minute or so then was gone from sight. Almost immediately after it vanished a helicopter flew overhead in the direction of the sighting.
My wife and both witnessed it and agreed that it was one of the most bizarre unexplainable objects we had ever seen.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

When I got home, my dad, my sister, and me went to our porch. When we looked at it, we noticed there was an odd shape witb lights moving. 
The craft was moving in a figure 8 type movement, occasionally drifting off a little bit. 
When video taping it, it was clear it was an object, but didn't know what. My camera also noticed movement under it and beside it, we we couldn't see it. Some flashes of light occured in the general area. 
We were told that recent spottings had ufo's being chased by jets, so I'm wondering if that's what my camera caught. 
The sighting seemed to be by Tonasket/Okanogan area. 
I am very intrigued to found out what it is.

 I heard no sound. It seemed very, very far up...but I'll leave the speculation up to you.

Thanks for your time!

summary: 8/13/13 Three UFOs were spotted over Las Vegas, each object changed shape.
description:
The following incident occurred on August 13, 2013, at 2:00 AM, Pacific Coast Time. The location was along the road going to Mount Charleston, in the vicinity of Las Vegas, Nevada.
Two witnesses were parked along the road. They were observing a recent meteor shower. They were looking north, away from the city lights of Las Vegas. Only a few meteors were spotted. They came from the northeast direction. Each meteor sighting lasted for about a second.
However, a bright white light approached from the southeast. It was in the shape of an orb. Another object red orb shaped object appeared nearby. Both objects moved towards the west over the Las Vegas skyline. Both objects emitted an aura, or a haze, which was changing shape. At various times, each object stopped and hovered still. These events occurred until 2:30 AM.
At 2:30 AM, the red orb shaped object disappeared. It immediately reappeared about 25 miles to the southeast, about one second later. It remained stationary for another half hour. During this time period, the larger White shaped orb moved to the east. It changed into a diamond shape. Immediately thereafter, it changed into a triangular shape, with three bright lights in…

summary: Formation of 3 objects over Garbage Beach in San Diego
description:
We parked at Garbage Beach, and immediately spotted a triangular shape with a large blue light in the center, and changing colored lights moving around the main blue light. It slowly moved from the center of our view, to the right. 
Another appeared as a large glowing orange ball. 
 The second one moved in towards the first after the light patterns changed, like it was communicating. 
We could hear a low humming. 
A third object arrived in the center of our view. It appeared to be cloaked, but also communicating with the other two. 
All three then aligned into one row, before the first two passed by each other and flew in opposite directions. 
The center object stayed in the same spot until we got out of the car to get a closer look. It retreated, but then returned to its original position when we moved back.

summary: Round black object low over the 15 North by Escondido.
description:
going North on I-15 around Deer Springs Road I saw a black ball or circle object at about the height of a streetlight off the ground. 
I drove directly under it. It wavered ahead back and ahead again for a couple seconds as we passed each other, reminding me of how a bird might move. 
It was maybe a few feet across about the size of a gym ball. 
I was at work on patrol at that time.

summary: Triangular shape (3 non-flashing lights), no sound, moving in a straight line. few seconds.
description:
I was standing in my back garden, watching the meteor shower that had been mentioned on the TV, when, in between, the shooting stars, I noticed a triangle of lights. The triangle had two equal long sides and one shorter (at the rear). There were three lights one at each point. The lights weren’t bright, they were dull like a satellite passing over and they didn’t flash. 
The object moved in a straight line at a speed that would be faster than a plane or a satellite but slower than a shooting star. The direction it moved at was roughly north-west to south east. The ‘triangle’ moved with the point leading. I initially thought the triangular object was solid but I noticed that the back left point seemed to move a little which made me wonder if the lights were separate entities moving in formation, or not. The night was very still and clear. 
It was the strangest thing I’ve witnessed and I did exclaim out loud ‘what ((deleted)) was that?’ and I rarely swear.

summary: Two triangle shaped crafts one with red & green lights the other white/violet lights
description:
We seen two UFOs like 12 times at least and they was circling and one was slow and stopped allot and the other was fast more erratic and both Low to the ground. Triangle shaped one had green and red lights the other flashing white/violet lights a lot of light both all around sides and bottoms of craft. 
We drive around trying to follow them they would disappear and then all the sudden there they were again. Was as if they saw us seeing them the green and red lit one would stop frequently then bolt when noticed only to come to a sudden slow down. 
The white lit one was always moving and sometimes moderate speed to very fast speeds with both aircrafts having jarring movements.

summary: Not a clear object, but a very clear light, 3 blinks and movement.
description:
I was walking down Major Ave (In the Belmont-Cragin neighborhood of Chicago), I was almost at Major & Belden.. when...
A clear white light caught my attention. I look up to the sky and I see a white light. It shuts off and appears again farther off but still very clear and looked to be the exact same size. It blinks again, this time it doesn't reappear, it's gone. The light was oval shaped.. not a perfect oval but oval is the closest shape to it.
Everything was calm/felt calm.. not even a breeze or a sound. I felt very calm (this is unusual for me, especially when walking alone a dark neighborhood at night). I was in awe, don't know why.
I stood there walking slowly looking at the sky for any other clue of what that was.. but nothing happened, no clue. I start walking home in about 5 minutes I see a helicopter (I'm pretty sure it was a helicopter because of the noise it made.. anyway helicopter or some other plane). I see it coming from the west side. I just go home. This is pretty much it.

summary: Small, bluish light moving through the sky, changed direction, then sped off out of sight
description:
It was a bluish light that looked like a star or satellite that was moving rather fast but constant through the sky, then it changed direction - did a kind of loop. 
It then slowly started moving in another direction at about the same speed as before, then it sped off and out of sight.

summary: Please click!  UFO orbs observed over MULTIPLE YEARS WITH HARD EVIDENCE!  Please help!!!!
description:
I am a 17 year old high school student in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, who is astonished by the universe, and nightly, I go outside to gaze upon the stars, and has been frequent since over 4 years. 
During this duration, I have observed over three unidentifiable objects flying over me on three separate occasions, over three separate years, and all objects resembled two to three spheres appearing to float in formation at a great speed. 
On July 22nd, 2011 I was sitting outside at around 10:45 p.m., watching the North Eastern sky. I recall seeing a white glow come over the horizon, and which I had believed it was a satellite, only until I saw a second orb following, going in a circular type motion, and then a din third appeared behind it. The craft did NOT make a single noise. This occurred over a 105 second period and then disappeared in the south eastern sky. I was dumbfounded at what i had seen. 
Over the next year I researched what I had saw and found nothing,! and began to watch the skys even more. A year later, October 2012, the EXACT same, in every detail, phenomena occurred, three orbs flying in a circular type motion. At this point I was with two other people who also saw…

summary: Please click multiple sightings over years in waukesha county with hard evidence!
description:
I am a 17 year old high school student who is fascinated by the universe and I spend hours on end outside looking at the stars and I have done so for years. Over a three year radius, I have encountered unidentifiable crafts that make no sound which I have ad witnesses and I have a photo of the craft which is clearly visible.

summary: Low, slow, silent craft lights in diamond shape 3 bright white 1 bright red no flashing seen at night.
description:
Went out with my granddaughter to see if we would be able to see anything of the meteor shower. It was a perfectly clear night and the sky was finally dark enough to see the stars easily. We were standing close to the house looking up to the south and had been there for possibly three minutes when a craft, and I say craft although I didn't actually see any shape, it blended in with the night sky.
What we actually saw were the large round lights, three pure white lights in a triangle shape, one in the flight direction (S) one on either side (E and W) and then one red one at the"back"(N) opposite the leading white light, making a diamond shape. These lights were steady, not flashing. They were not shining down, very odd, they were just very bright white and red.
There was no sound whatsoever which is why I was completely taken off guard, it visually broke over the roof line in silence from the north and continued south till we couldn't see it any longer for the trees (approx 2 minutes).
It appeared to be around 200 feet off the ground, it was very low and traveled very slowly, like you were out for a Sunday drive and just cruising...went right over the town. I can't imagine anyone…

summary: Went outside to look for the meteor shower and saw a bright green light straight above me with no sounds or motion.
description: Stayed in same spot for about two minutes then slowly started moving to the west.

summary: Fiery orbs moving into formations while dropping smaller orbs.
description:
Sitting outside with a neighbor I noticed large bright orange/yellow lights in the sky off in the horizon. We watched as the two objects seemed to come together into one, as yet more objects began to appear, starting as a small orange light and growing to the size of the others, none of which were larger than the others. 
They made formations, when there were three they briefly made a triangle formation before some of the objects would either join together or slowly vanish over about a five second timespan. 
When there were four they briefly made a square, and when there were five they seemed to form a straight line. 
During our sighting these objects randomly dropped smaller objects of the same shape and color, these slowly dropped below the tree line towards the ground. 
After watching for a few minutes I realized I could take video/pictures, by this time the objects had come together, almost looking like a single object, and dropped a final smaller light, 
I was able to get video of this, and a dozen pictures or so, before the lights faded and were gone.

summary: Multiple green orbs of light moved randomly on a hillside.
description:
A friend and I were driving away from Devil's Tower NP approaching Devil's Tower Junction. It was very dark with no other sources of light or other cars nearby. 
At the same time, we both saw multiple orbs of green light frantically moving around in a seemingly random fashion on an embankment on the opposite side of the road, just a few feet from us. 
 My friend who was not driving saw them for about ten seconds, while I only got a few 1 or 2 second glances. 
We turned around and searched the area and did not find anything at all unusual.

summary: Triangular red, green and blue glowing & flashing object in Lincoln, CA, night sky.
description:
My Husband and I were cruising around town on August 12, 2013 around 9:30PM when we noticed a flashing red, blue and green object in the sky over a small section of town called Sun City. It would fly up, hover for a bit and then fall. When I witnessed the first “fall” of the object, I thought for sure it was a plane crashing.
However, after its’ rapid descent, the object returned back into the sky. My Husband and I followed the object, where it passed over into the Twelve Bridges section of Lincoln, CA. 
We stopped the car and got out… the object slowly came towards our car, then hovered right above us. I am unsure how high in the sky it was, all I know is it had very vibrant red, blue and green glow to it. When I say it was flashing colors, there were not just a few lights, the entire object was glowing the colors.
I stood there staring at the object for about 10 minutes as it just hovered above me, a car approached over the hill and I looked away from the object for a minute. When I turned back I noticed it rapidly moving away from us back towards the original sighting area where it ultimately disappeared .
I attempted to chase the object again in my car, however, my attempts to…

summary: Triangular aircraft with blue and white lights seen by 3 in upstate NY.
description:
We witnessed a UFO coming home from the casino on Monday August 12th around 9:30 pm. 
This aircraft flew right above the front windshield of our car probably no more then 200 feet in the sky. It was triangular in shape but gave off no noise or vibration leading us to believe it could possibly be a plane or man made craft. 
We do not know what this aircraft was or were it came from but it scared all of us who were in the car. 
The craft had a bright white light in each corner and a dimmer blue light in the middle. 
The aircraft was heading towards the St. Lawrence sea way were there is a large power dam.

summary: Orange, spherical light moving erratically.
description:
I live in a rural area. Frequently I go for long walks at night. Tonight I was almost back to my driveway when I noticed 2 lights in the Southwestern sky underneath about 80% cloud cover. The one to the left was a blinking navigation light traveling in a linear fashion - obviously a plane. The one to the right was larger, spherical, and glowing orange. It was slightly larger than a plane's navigation light would appear.
I watched the light and noticed it moving quickly and erratically, like an insect around a lamp. The light continued this kind of frenetic motion predominately upwards before disappearing into the clouds.
About a month prior I had a similar, initial sighting. That time it was much higher up and directly overhead. I could pick out jets and stars as a reference, but this orange light moved erratically in a way that I had never seen before. I watched it for what felt like a solid 10 minutes - just buzzing around up there nonsensically. I realized just how high up it was when the light traveled behind a whispy cloud (one of those upper level cirrus clouds). At that point I went back to the house.
A friend of mine observed something similar in late July, but I can't…

summary: Viewed on different evenings, overhead, and on the western horizon,originally thought it was a star or airplane headlight.
description:
On the nights between 8/8 to 8/15 at approximately 9:15 pm., I witnessed a white illuminated craft accompanied by a smaller orange colored spherical craft. 
In the evenings following, I saw the same white lighted craft hovering in the western horizon. This time I used my camera to sight in and took several pictures on the zoom setting which didn't allow for clarity, but still allowed detail. It revealed a spherical dome shaped craft,apparently self illuminating. It had a rounded center making it appear to be like a wheel of a car,hubcap in the center. 
These objects displayed no usual marker lights, or engine sounds. In the week of these sightings I witnessed approximately 6 sightings, and all appeared to be the same vehicle. 
I would like for you to see these pictures,so I left my # on your message phone.

location: Salinas (~1 hour past; on Hwy 101), CA, USA
summary: Huge pulsing object shoots across sky toward ocean.
description:
We were on hwy 101 south bound maybe an hour past salinas.
I was looking at the stars in front of us when what at first appeared to be a shooting caught my attention passing over the car.
I assumed this for split second because of how fast the object was moving.
This is what got my attention...
The path of the object wasn't arching or sloping like shooting star.
It went in a straight line overhead at a very high altitude.
It was shaped like a AA battery with a pulsing orange/red/yellow light in the middle.
When it light up from the pulsing light we could see this thing was huge!!! I live 10-15 from a airport and have 737's fly overhead all day and night.
Even with the planes at low altitude, this object was still at least twice as big at high altitude.
And moving as fast as a shooting star.
region: Salinas (~1 hour past; on Hwy 101), CA

It went up from the ground at about 50-60d angle at 2-3 times the speed of a meteor. If it were coming down, I would have said it was a meteor, but to go up on an angle!!?? Now there was a storm heading our way, but I know the difference between lighting and a streak heading into the upper atmosphere. I would say it looked similar to the way fireworks would go up, but many, many times faster. It went as far as I could see in a flash.
If it weren’t for a darker grey sky in the background with the storm coming, it probably would have never been noticed.

description:
This occurs often, appearing many Monday and Thursday nights at 9 pm, if not more often. 
What looks like a floating cylinder of fire appears over the field behind the Fields restaurant when I get done my shift at work. 
Upon watching this fire-like object for a time it will hover, dim and brighten, and finally the object will dim completely to reveal three blinking lights in a triangular formation.

summary: A big orange/grey circle type object appearing before and after storm.
description: It was monday night and i was sitting outside smoking my cigarette with my cousin, i happened to look to the left into the sky when i saw this huge bright orange circle with grey around it, it appeared as the thunderstorm was coming then disappeared after a few seconds, this was no dairy light, tower or aircraft. i saw the same thing again the same night only this time a bright light blue/white orb looking thing was emitted from it. this appeared after the thunderstorm.

summary: There were blinking red and blue lights, and they were hovering in circles.
description:
There were three of us at work on the overnight shift. Went outside for a break, and were looking up at the stars and noticed one certain "star" at first, it was hovering and we noticed that there were flashing lights within it. Red and really light blue lights were rotating around the craft. 
It started to come closer towards us, then went around in a circular motion, and went back up to its original height. We then noticed two others that were doing the same thing. They didn't move like an airplane or helicopter, they just stayed and hovered in one small area. 
They didn't come close enough to tell the exact shape. 
We didn't hear any unusual noises. 
We went back outside about an hour later and they were still there, just in different spots.

summary: Star like object moving eraticaly.
description:
While watching the meteor shower on 8/12/13 I noticed what at first looked like a satilight flying by. The object stopped and reversed and then rotated in a circular motion also moving back and forth. 
The sighting lasted about 30 min. other flashing lights were noticed around the main light, not real close but close enough for me to notice. 
The secondary lights seemed to appear out of nowere only for a second or so.

summary: We saw 3 circular, white, fast moving lights moving high up in the sky.
description:
The lights stopped multiple times and even converged near each other before going different directions. We watched one light for 30 minutes moving around. It would stop in one spot then change course. 
We even saw it move in a zig zag pattern multiple times. It also appeared that there were flashes of light coming from the object itself.

summary: Very large bright orange light that disapeared.
description:
While driving home from work my son and I were 1/2 mile from our home when we spotted a very bright orange light in the sky to the west of our location. 
At first we thought the light was moving so we stopped in the road and watched for several min and determined it was stationary. 
As we proceeded to our home we kept the light in our line of sight. I could see the light as I was backing in my driveway. 
In the very short period of time it took to exit the vehicle the light was no longer in our line of sight, my son and I ran to the clearing to the north of our home and the light was no where to be seen, we ran back to the house and returned in my vehicle to the location where we had first spotted the light and couldn't find any sign light. 
We left this location and proceeded to another road which took us to the area where the light appeared to be when we first saw it and found nothing. When we returned home we spent the next 30 min in the clearing looking for signs of the light. 
With being in the country we have very clear views of sky which don't have city lights filtering into the sky.

summary: More than 10 lights moving at supersonic speeds, blinking, erratic changes of direction, almost fluid like motion with bursts of speed.
description: Many (more than 10) lights moving at supersonic speeds, blinking, erratic changes of direction, and rendezvousing with one another sometimes. You can almost make out "light wings" on them too, and this is still on going so I'm going to go watch some more. summary: On Monday Aug, 12th at 12:45am, my wife, son, daughter and I witnessed two objects flying in a formation heading North East.  We went out in the field about 12am, behind our home to watch the meteor…
description:
We were out there for about 40 minutes when we seen two objects appear to our north one became brighter and brighter and brighter as if it was shining a light towards us. At that time my daughter and I seen one of the objects shoot a green orb of light out in a southwest direction it kept traveling and then disappeared. 
We observed the objects with binoculars (7 X 35) power not the best but gave a good look at the objects. As they moved North East the object that became bright started to dim to same as the other object. The objects keep moving North East than stopped on a dime and stood there for a couple of minutes before disappearing. 
We know what we witnessed were not meteors but objects under controlled flight. Having prior military service and train! ing to identify different types of air craft, I can say the objects we no air plane or helicopter.

summary: Red-orange orbs slow and low-flying over town
description:
My two friends and I were standing outside on Landen St (close to Wal-Mart and Myra road) and one of us looked up and noticed a strange orange-red ball of light moving across the sky. It seemed to move in a wide arc above and behind the trees in the distance. It looked fairly close to the ground, maybe tree-height, and not too far away from where we were standing, either. I estimate the balls to be roughly a couple feet wide. 
The first ball traveled a bit and then started to fade, and as it did so, another one showed up where the first one had started (none of us saw it appear, we just noticed it out of the corner of our eyes while observing the first one), and followed the first orb's pathway and died out just the same. They were silent and almost pulsating/fluctuating tones of color/rippling in shape. We attempted to take video but we could not autofocus because it was too dark and the orbs disappeared when we tried to manual focus, but we do have a bit of blurry footage of one of the orbs.

summary: It was a reddish orange flickering light that appeared to be from a hovering aircraft along the edge of a storm cloud.
description:
The scene was a warm humid Florida night overlooking a wetland and a starry sky above. We were out during the perseids meteor shower and in the near distance was a huge storm head with amazing heat lightning erupting in and around it.
While fixing our eyes on the both the shooting stars and the storm we noticed a reddish orange flickering light at the edge of the clouds. 
At first it was believed to be a star or an airplane and then after many flashes of lightning we saw that it was definitely in the sky alongside the storm but appeared to be hovering in place. It continued to move back and forth and kind of in a small circle.
We aren’t sure if the flashing of the storm was playing tricks on us.
The reddish orange light attached to what appeared to be an air-craft of some kind hovered in place for a half hr after midnight and then was gone.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: "l think I just saw a UFO"
description:
A bright orange red pulsing for about 8-10 seconds in the sky, and it went east in a matter of two
"l think I just saw a UFO" A bright orange red pulsing for about 8-10 seconds in the sky and it went east in a matter of two seconds, and then it disappeared. This was in in North West Everett Washington in the historical area. Minutes from the Navy Base. 
Don't know much about military time so guessing it happened a little before 11:30, and my wife saw it out the bathroom window again after I saw it vanish. 
So we went out to film it and uploaded it to youtube. We could see it with the naked eye but the video its real vague. What I don't understand is being so close to the Navy base why nobody was alarmed as far as the police or military. Better technology would be better to see it I'm sure.

summary: Diamond shaped craft, charcoal gray, with four lights at  the corners, moving silently at very high speed.
description:
This sighting occurred on 8/11/13, at approximately 2330 Hrs, while viewing the Perseids meteor shower. My son and I were watching the night sky, and suddenly a diamond shaped object appeared, traveling from a south to north trajectory. As it passed by the Milky Way Galaxy, it blocked out the stars as it flew by. The diamond shaped object had a charcoal gray color to it and on all four corners, it had dim white solid lights. Its speed was very fast, as we were able to observe it for about only 7 seconds. 
The object was silent, and the size, at best guess, was if you held out your thumb out at arms length, it would cover it. So it was very large in size. 
About two minutes later, a commercial jet liner came into view, traveling west to east, but the speed was nowhere even close to what we witnessed. The sky was clear, no moon, no wind. The speed it was moving, it would be very difficult to photograph. 
Thank you for your interest in this subject. Hopefully ! soon this mystery can be known.

summary: Bright white light, faster than a satellite and much slower than a meteor, which faded and disappeared.
description:
My husband and I were enjoying the perseids meteor shower. We saw several aircraft, all going east-west, which were easily identified by their flashing red lights and subsequent sound. 
At 23:24 we both spotted a fast-moving white light which had no red lights and was traveling north to south. We agreed it was not a plane. It was moving faster than satellites but much slower than the meteors. 
As we watched the light continue along its trajectory, it began to fade, blinked bright, then disappeared. It was definitely not a meteor. It left no tail nor was it moving as fast as the meteors we viewed. 
We waited to see if it would reappear along its trajectory but it never showed up. It was not the satellite Integral (which hardly moves at all), although it was in the same general vicinity. 
Nor was it Genesis I which passed one hour later and low on the horizon. We were at lat 38.92 and long-107.91. 
The object was about 60 degrees above the horizon to the NNE near the star Alderamin.

summary: I was taking my dogs for a walk around the block as i do often around the same time of the night.  I heard a plane in the distance that was coming in to land at the dayton international airport.
description:
I was standing in a school field so my view was not blocked by anything. I scanned to the west and was watching the plane with its landing lights come in and flew right over head. 
Then i started walking again and i looked back to the west where the plane just came from and there was a bright orange fireball hanging in the sky. I would guess it was about maybe 1000 feet up and just looked like it was sitting there or moving very slowly. 
To be honest the first thing i thought and said out loud ah someone let a chinese lantern go. I watched it for about 1 minute cause it looked really cool and then it started getting bigger and brighter. At that point, i said hmm what the heck is that and then it took off to the west and gained altitude until was gone.

I don't know if anything close to this has been reported before but it kinda freaked me out. 
I wonder if the plane reported it to the tower cause where it was in the sky they would of seen it.

At first I thought that they might be hot air balloons but they were moving way to fast for a balloon. 
I also saw a fixed wing plane go directly beneath them and they were much larger than the plane. The objects seemed to temporarily dissapear when fixed wing plane came close to both of them and then both reappeared when the airplane got past their position. 
All of sudden they both just vanished. 
This is not the first time I have seen this type of object in the sky. I get up early for work (4:30am) and have to take my dog out to relieve himself, so a lot of times the skies are clear and I have seen these same glowing objects before over the past year.

Japanese HTV-4 craft flying close to the ISS. PD

summary: 2 lights, passing by each other, then 1 changed direction

One object was heading approximately 140-150 degrees (SE), the other at about 210-225 degrees (SW). The 225 degree object passed behind the path of the first, seemingly within a small distance away from the first. A short time after passing the other object, about 10 seconds or less, the 225 degree object changed direction and headed in approximately a 180-195 degree direction. The first object continued on its trajectory and they both continued in the direction they were until I could no longer see them due to either cloud cover or their distance from me.
About a minute after those 2 objects disappeared from my sight I saw a falling object at about 90 degrees from my location, likely part of the meteor shower expected tonight. It was dim then very bright, then gone. This object fell like a ‘falling star’, burning up on impact with the atmosphere.

description:
We were coming out our son’s house in Linfield, PA, when in the sky we noticed 9 bright orange fireballs hovering near the Limerick Power Plant. 
It was about 9:30 p.m. and called to our son and his wife to come out of their house so they could see them. We watch them for several minutes and then they faded away, one at a time. 
As we talked about what we just saw and turned to leave, another one came in from the left, stopped and hovered in the same area and as we watched for several minutes again, it, too, faded away. 
We were still amazed and trying to figure out what we were seeing when another one flew in from the left, hovered, and then faded away. We do not know what we saw but wonder if these are UFO’s. We tried to take pictures with our phones, but couldn't get it to work.

summary: Red/orange fireballs in Houston sky
description:
While sitting outside around our pool at about 9:30 pm, we witnessed 8-12 red/orange balls in the southern sky on the horizon. they were traveling in a north west direction at a fairly high rate of speed. 
As each reached about the same spot in the sky, they disappeared into a cloud. 
They were in a line, but not a perfect line and they were random distances between them.

summary: We arrived at the lake in our city, specifically Sioux Look Out Park in Burlington, Ontario.  Approximately 20-25 orange oval lights were seen flying east from the Toronto direction to south west in…
description:
As the light objects ascended upward, eventually they disappeared. This lasted for about 10 minutes. 
We were very taken aback and initially thought they had to be planes, but too many were clustered together, which would be impossible for planes to take off in a similar formation especially at 21:30 at night.

summary: Dim orange/yellow rectangular object moving fairly quickly across night sky
description:
At 9:23 p.m. CST while looking at the stars from my patio, I noticed a dimly lit object moving roughly NW to SE at what I would consider to be a fairly high rate of speed. 
The object was evenly lit (i.e. all parts of the object appeared to be emitting the same amount of light across it), orange/yellow in color and less bright than the star field in the background. The intensity of the light was constant and there was no flashing or pulsating to it. 
It was either silent or high enough in the sky that there was no sound. It did not look like a point of light (like a star or plane at high altitude), but a very slightly curved, rectangular shape with the leading edge being the longer side of the object. I was nearly directly overhead.

summary: Red glowing hovering object observed for three minutes by three people in Cudahy, Wisconsin
description:
We three were sitting on our neighbor's patio when the red glowing object was spotted in the northern sky. Since we had just returned from a car show, I still had my camera with me and caught it hovering silently.
It was early evening, just getting dark, when the object appeared. It glowed red and hovered, moving slightly, then stopping again. After a minute or so, it veered off to our left, westward, then stopped and hovered some more.
At the end of the sighting, the object moved upward, hovered again, then the light went out, as if someone blew out a candle. It did not leave our view by going east, west, up or down, it simply disappeared.
About 15 minutes later, the red glowing object reappeared, and I filmed it again, this time with a darker sky, making it harder to see.
Here is the youtube video I posted of the event: http://youtu.be/xR9dZ8t_XcY

summary: Chevron formation with orange lights moving east to west in night sky

Approx altitude 2500 ft. but diffiult to determine in the dark sky. 
A group of 6 of us were sitting on our patio enjoying the evening when we all spotted this in the night sky. 
Our neighbors across the lake were also seeing it, as well as our next door neighbors.

summary: Dark disc appeared for less than 1 second above Cape Cod Bay.
description:
At 7:34 AM on Saturday, August 10, 2013 my Audubon Bird Camera recorded 10 still digital photos. I have included three (3) of the photos which were automatically taken less than 1 second apart. The photos are WBSC0241, WBSC0242 and WBSC0243.
Please note the image that appears in WBSC0242 and flip back and forth between 241, 242 and 243.
The view is from a bluff looking to the east from Manomet Point across Cape Cod Bay at approximately 110°. The location of the camera was N41° 55’ 24.24” W070° 32’ 26/18”.
I did not personally observe the image. I noticed the image when I downloaded the photos. I also noticed that the image does not appear in either the previous or subsequent frame. You can see by the small movement of the clouds and bird how little time elapsed. The distance in frame is approximately fifty (50) miles from Provincetown, Massachusetts to Bourne, Massachusetts.
I am 59 years old, a private pilot and have flown over a million miles commercially. I have lived on this bluff over 28 years and have never seen anything like this before.
I enlarged the photos at much as Paint would allow and could not see any wings, tail, blades or source of thrust or lift. I am sure you…
