Then we saw other fireworks in a different location farther away with the same lights in the formation of the big dipper. We saw a third sighting again at another location of three red/orange lights in a triangle type shape, then they just hovered, moved upward then faded and disappeared.

summary: Red lights in sky that moved closer and disappeared, along with a black balloon like object that floated down
description: My 13 year old son, significant other, and myself were shooting fireworks. Around 10:20 pm or so, we saw a red light move from the south towards the north, towards us. It was high in the sky, but as it approached (got closer), the light became a bit larger. It appeared to zig and zag lazily and then stop at some points. The red light was steady, but alternated with a white light. There were no sounds and no other moving objects in the sky. It slowly moved northeast a bit and just disappeared. A few minutes later, the exact same thing happened again, starting at the exact same starting spot as before. At around 10:40 pm or so, I looked to the northeast and saw a black object that was like the shape of a balloon with a bubble on top floating down from the sky. It was about 50 feet in the air and I thought it was a parachute at first. I screamed "What is that?" The other two witnesses turned and saw it as well. My son screamed and ran toward! s the house. My boyfriend ran towards the fenceline where the object appeared to fall. He said he saw a disc like object go immediately straight back up into the sky. Around 10:45 pm, we decided to shoot off one last round of fireworks. When we…

summary: Preface: there are plenty of commercial planes, private planes, military planes and helicopters with Sac Int Airport, military, and small craft airports around, and I have seen enough to recognize…
description: After a few seconds I could see that it wasn't one light, but two. When I could see the clear separation between the lights, I watched as the vehicle slowly turned 90 degrees to the east (as the two lights merged into one with the turn), proceeded a short distance east, stopped for a few seconds (as to watch some fireworks below?), slowly backed up and turned onto the original flight path (as one light again became two), then continued almost directly over me at a fairly low altitude (lower than any passing commercial jet and somewhere close to single engine private plane low to medium altitude). It was silent and flying faster than any plane, jet or prop, but not super fast. It continued to the northwest and disappeared toward the big dipper at a constant rate of speed. I estimate the total time I saw it from horizon to horizon was about a minute. No plane that we have would clear that distance in that time at that low altitude and not make a sound.

summary: Round craft with orange lights seen in Buffalo, New York
description:
I was compelled to go to my window and look up into the sky, when I saw a round object with orange lights around its rim sought of flashing but not always. It was moving in a southwest to northeast direction. no sound. Then a second object with same description maybe 1000 meters behind the first object.
There was I think 6 orange lights, no sound and moving in a determined direction. not floating. The height was same as a small plane flying.
The size of object was about 100 feet round.
The center of the object was dark.

summary: Silent glowing fireball moved slowly (at first) in straight line.
description: A ball of fire in the sky caught my attention and at first glance I thought it was a flaming ember from a firework but quickly realized it was not falling and definitely not an ember. We watched it move slowly (at first) in a straight line from east to west, debating the whole time what it could be. Being cloudy/overcast that night, we thought it must be a helicopter but it got closer and was completely silent. At its closest it looked more saucer shaped (flat on the bottom with the glow/fire/light emminating upwards). It moved so slowly and seemed so close overhead (but it was hazy). I went inside to tell others & get a camera but quickly returned to see it had moved away considerably faster than it had approached and it was barely visible to those who hadn't seen it for the duration. It appeared to be gaining altitude and moving quickly to the west/northwest and disappeared from my view. The light/fire was strange because the color varied/moved as a! fire would but appeared to be contained in a ball (or dome shape when it was closest) yet the ball was not clearly defined. The edges looked "hazy".

summary: Bright Red object in the Hawaiian sky
description:
Aloha!
On July 4 around 10:30 pm I went out to walk the dogs and noticed a bright red object in the southern sky. It was about 7 times larger than any star or planet I have ever seen. It seemed to be about 25 deg in elevation. I use a lot of FTA satellites and in location comparison the object seemed to be around 135W with the height of 97w. It was very bright like looking at a red laser pointer but 10 times the size. 
We live in Eden Roc Hawaii just past 24th street. The object moved very slow in the sky at first then started to drop to the east very slow moving about 10 deg to the east and dropping 5-7 deg in elevation. It kept the same brightness and just disappeared above the trees. 
We live about 1800 feet in elevation and in the direction of the object there is a forest reserve and open ocean. There are no other islands in this direction and we never have air traffic after dark in this area. 
I am a vet and I was in the navy never seen anything like this. My best guess is light! reflecting off a satellite but it just don't seem right based on size, brightness, and direction.
Thanks ((name deleted))

summary: A small red/orange sphere appeared in the sky, moved in closer and got bigger over the city of Green Bay, and vanished leaving a trail.
description:
While enjoying the fireworks on a hill showing the entire city of Green Bay, I noticed a small red/orange sphere in the sky that I initially assumed was another firework. However, it didn't explode; it only got closer and bigger. 
In an instant it was over the city of Green Bay, moving very slowly for a few seconds, before trailing off and out of sight. 
My entire group of friends sitting with me was silent for a few seconds before one asked "Did anyone else see that?” He was immediately met with agreement from the whole group. 
The whole event couldn't have lasted over 20 seconds

summary: I am sure I was not the only person to notice these objects out of the thousand or so people watching the fireworks display.
description:
I live in central Nebraska, slightly east of North Platte. Last night on the 4th of July 2013 my small town had their fireworks celebration. As I was watching the fireworks, I noticed several red lights that at first I thought were embers, but they were too high and traveling at a high rate of speed way up in the air.
I noticed these strange lights about 4 separate times over the course of the fireworks show. Several groups of 3 or 4 of various sizes together and two single objects. They were a bright red color and looked like an air plane would look up in the air except for they seemed to be traveling much faster than an aircraft usually does and they only had a red color to them. Airplanes usually have several colored lights on them that blink. These craft were red in color only and the light did not blink, it stayed the same intensity.
I was thinking that they must be meteorites or something and then later on that night I listened to the C2C show on YouTube and heard the report that people are seeing these strange red lights in the sky all over the country. I wish I had taken my camera because they were very plain to see and it was a clear, cloudless night here in Nebraska.

summary: 5 Orange/Red balls of light moved north to south over Snohomish WA then disappeared.
description:
On July 4th 2013 at approximately 22:30 my wife two friends and I witnessed a total of 5 orange/red balls of light move across the sky.
These lights appear to be similar to other reports on NUFORC, (6/15/2013, 6/29/2013).
All of the lights seemed to originate from the north, the last, a little more to the northeast approximately 30deg overhead. They moved in a southerly direction at a constant speed, one seemed to hover for a few seconds directly overhead then continued on. The lights appeared to be traveling at different altitudes, the third one much lower than the others. At first we thought they were helicopters but there was no sound. They all disappeared in the same general area approximately 50deg overhead.
Duration ~10.

summary: Retired public employee witnesses four (?) large, orange objects float overhead, headed west (?).
description:
Telephoned Report: A retired public employee telephoned the UFO Hotline to report having had four quite large, orange, self-luminous objects fly directly overhead his location. He said that they were very close to him, and that the objects appeared to give off "radians," or cruciform "spikes" of light.
He reported being shocked by the event.
The witness stated that he would no submit a written report.
We have become a bit uncertain about the date of this sighting. It has become unclear to us whether the sighting occurred on July 4th, or July 17. PD

summary: 2 orange v shaped objects with orange lights
description:
On July 4th about 10:30 pm, I was watching the neighborhood backyard fireworks, and noticed two UFOs in the sky. They were boomerang shaped, and had orange lights along the bottom, with a bigger orange light at the “v” . 
The lights rotated up and down the bottom of the craft. They moved around slowly and with no sound at all. They would blink on and travel, then blink off for a few seconds and then blink back on in a different spot. 
They were AWESOME!

summary: 7 red/orange lights in a straight line formation before 4th of July fireworks, then faded and disappeared one at a time.
description: Before the fireworks began we saw 7 red orange flickering balls of light lined up in formation across the sky. They seemed to be hovering the each fading off in the distance the entirely disappearing. Later while driving home were looking at fireworks in another location and saw the same red lights near the fireworks there were about five of them in the formation of the big dipper again each fading individually, eventually all disappearing. As we got closer to home we viewed different fireworks and again we saw the red lights near the fireworks in a formation on a triangle again each time fading away leaving two then one visible eventually all disappearing.

summary: Red fly objects over OOB Maine
description:
My wife and I were just pulling into our driveway when we looked up and saw 3 red object flying in formation. And behind them were anothe 7-10 red objects heading in the same direction. All the fireworks were over at this point and time and they were flying over the ocean.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Circular orb in the sky covers great distance in short 30 seconds without breaking sound barrier on 7/4/13.
description: All six of us had noticed a yellow, circular orb in the sky. Luckily we noticed it right away and we were able to see it travel the entire sky in 30 seconds. In our estimate the object must have been 5 - 10 miles up at a minimum. For the object to travel across the entire sky with out any sound barrier being broken befuddled all of us. We were able to determine that it was not space junk or an asteroid due to the direction it was taking. It went clear across the sky in a straight path, and not in a parabola direction. First time any of us had seen anything like that. Some people were scared, while others were just confused. I thought it was really cool.

summary: Orange Light in field above treetops. Moved across State Highway 63 Witnessed by 2 and an Arkansa State Trooper.
description:
While we were coming to Walnut Ridge around 10:15 to 10:30PM, we topped the hill about 1/4 of a mile north of the Black Rock Rest Area, as we were approaching the crest of the hill my wife thought she saw fireworks on the left side of the highway in a field. When I looked I saw a bright orange light about 5-10 feet above a tree which was around 40-yards off the left side of the road. Expecting to see the burst of fireworks exploding I was surprised when it didn't. As we moved past it and descended down the hill I was watching the light in the side mirror of my vehicle.
I decided to turn around at the rest stop and drive back to the top of the hill to get a closer look and before I turned in to the rest stop I noticed an Arkansas State Trooper on the left side of the highway facing up the hill. As we pulled around the rest area to the north side exit I stopped my vehicle and looked to see the object moving left across the highway at the top of the hill. As I looked back towards the parked State Trooper he turned on his spotlight and directed it at the orange light we were watching as it moved across the highway and disappeared behind the tree tops.
We went on to town and when we…

summary: Bright moving light
description:
Was letting my dogs outside for a pee before bed, I stood on the deck and my eyes were immediately drawn toward the sky; when I witnessed a very bright large light gliding across the sky. 
Thought at first it could of been a low flying plane; so I was waiting for the roar of the plane. Nothing. It was too bright and round to be a plane. 
Silently it slowly moved across the sky, then it was like the lights went off and it looked like a star slowly moving, then it moved upwards and disappeared.
We suspect that the date is incorrect, and should be July 4th. We will attempt to confirm the date, and may correct it in the future. PD

summary: At around 10:15- to 10::30 Pm on the Fourth of July, A RED Light was seen over the Highland Park area of Seattle ((( Drone? )))
description:
Last Night, I went outside to have a smoke and watch the Festivities around West Seattle. Looking toward the West, I saw a Dark RED light descending. Even though it was The Fourth of July and Lights what , Flashes, where all over the place. 
The light disappeared for about 5 Minutes, It began ascending slowly in the same part of the Sky, The light either would go out from time to time because it appeared to disappear and reappear. I would have chocked it up to Fireworks except that it flew right over me. 
The only thing I could see was the Red Light and no sound. The first thought I had was this could be Surveillance Drone as I am trying to pay attention to events around me. 
I just thought that maybe someone else saw this light over the Highland Park Area of Seattle at around p10:20-25 PM 4rth Of July 2013.

summary: I noticed 2 shaped orange lights fly from the south headed north. It didn't have any aircraft markers on them ,then they disappeared after about 5 minutes.I told my friend to look up and he seen the…
description:
Walking further down the street a neighbor video taping said he seen the same exact thing.After a discussion we all left but remain outside. 
A few minutes later we all seen 8 more fly across the sky ( same orange-ish circular shaped light)then dissappear. One of the flying objects came back south bound stopped in its tracks, sat there ,blinked, then dissappered into thin air. 
Whatever it was it was not a aircraft.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: I was looking out sliding glass door to the north when I saw one red light at about a 45 to 60 degree angle to the horizon in the sky.  It was not moving.  It was not fireworks.
description:
It was stationary looking about the size of a large star. 
I called to my husband who also saw it. He ran to get binoculars and went outside, but he could not see it from the front of the house. 
A small plane flew toward it from south to north seemingly in a direct path to the light. 
As the plane got closer to the light it appeared that the plane was actually higher than the light. As the plane appeared to move closer to it the light faded and disappeared. 
Just a few minutes later a helicopter flew north to south lower than where the light and plane had been.

summary: Hovering Craft with Orange/Red Lights Flickering All Over It
description:
Hi Mr. Davenport, My husband and I heard your report on Coast to Coast the other night about the sighting in Penetanguishene, Ontario on July 01, 2013 (Canada Day) by three men on a fishing boat. We live off Georgian Bay, but a few miles further to the west. It is really the same water way but we live on a point of land that juts out into Georgian Bay. Our mailing address was formerly Penetanguishene but has now been changed to Tiny, Ontario.
On July 01, just after 10 pm a red flickering stationary light was observed in the night sky, in an area where there were no official fireworks. The light was followed for a while. It didn’t appear to be making any sound. The beach area is quiet with little light pollution, and with not much activity as the water level is low. The light flashed off in a direct line, quickly and was gone.
Tonight, July 04, at approximately 10:20 pm as we walked along our quiet street that has a lot of mature trees, and is close to the beach. Just above the tree line we observed a hovering object with bright lights flickering all over it. It is a very quiet night, with a lot of cloud cover and yet it was very bright (orange/red colour) and did not appear to be…

summary: Four solid orange UFO's flying over the night sky.
description:
My friends and I were out in the courtyard, finishing the night celebrating Independence Day. (The day before we had only seen one on what I'll describe next), 
I pointed up to my roommate and said, look! My fellow neighbors and I all looked up, there was one orange solid light. 
Behind it came another orange solid light, then two more. We watched as the UFO's came from behind each other to move into formation. 
They then proceeded to move forward. Out of no where they all of a sudden shot up and winked out.

summary: 6 reddish orange lights moving slowly over Mount Angel Oregon
description:
After the town fireworks display, my fiancé and I made our way home. I had just walked inside when she called in and said there is something unusual outside that I should see. I quickly made my way out and we both beheld two small, fiery looking, reddish orange lights in the sky, progressing slowly from the north to the south. As they traveled in the sky at about a 2 o’clock position toward the east from our position, their speed did not noticeably vary, nor did their distance from one another. From our vantage point they appeared about 4-6 times the size of a large star. There was no noise associated with their movement, and their lights did not flicker, blink, or change color. As they progressed south, both lights rather swiftly and almost simultaneously faded out. They did not visibly travel beyond the horizon or behind some object.
Almost immediately after the first two disappeared, two more arose or appeared from the same spot toward the northern horizon, and began drifting at the same speed and route as the first two. They looked nearly identical to the first two and traveled at about the same speed, and were otherwise indistinguishable from the first pair. Once these…

summary: Saw a bright orange object that turned purple and flew away on the 4th of July
description:
I am a thirteen year old from Jacksonville, Florida. 
I saw my sighting at about 10:15pm Eastern Standard Time. It was the Fourth of July, and I was looking out of my window at some people down the street, who were shooting some firecrackers. They had stopped to refresh their supply, so I looked up into the sky and caught a glimpse of something that glowed super bright. 
At first I thought it was a star, because of how bright it was and because it was a circular object. The object was bright orange mixed w/ a little red. I stared at it for maybe two minutes and looked at the other stars around it and realized that it was a great deal bigger than the other objects around it. I looked back at the object and saw it had changed colors. I swear to God Almighty the thing was purple when I looked at it again. I stood there in amazement just looking at it, wondering what on God’s green Earth it could be. 
I looked away for a second or two to find my binoculars, w! hich I usually keep in my room to watch birds and such. I didn’t see them, so I looked back at the object (it had turned back to orange by this point), and it began to move east-northeast towards the beach. It was moving at a…

summary: 5 orange'ish/amber light sources apparently unconnected to normal air traffic in our area were observed over a period of 40 minutes
description:
My wife and I were watching the fireworks last night. Where our house sits relative to the fields and lakes around here where folks launch their fireworks we can only catch the highest bursts, and those only through gaps in the trees. We do have a relatively unobstructed view of the southern approaches/departures to SEATAC. I’m a private pilot (single engine land, ground school for IFR; ‘haven’t flown in years, though), and do enjoy watching the SEATAC traffic when I get the chance.
During the fireworks, at between approximately 10:15 and 10:45, we saw 5 orange’ish/amber lights not apparently connected to the usual approaches and departures (departures were to the south at SEATAC last night), not associated with any other lighting typical of the aircraft we see around here, and not apparently connected to the fireworks, moving from low on the horizon west (True bearing; magnetic variance is ~17 degrees east) of us to various headings and elevations. Each light was a discrete, constant point source. I am not familiar with any aircraft lighting systems that have a single orange’ish/amber constant light. No sound was associated with the lights. There were no apparent trails…

summary: 2 orange lights type UFOs seen in Houston area on July 4, 2013
description:
As we were driving back from the fireworks show at Northshore park at 10pm, heading west bound on Sterling Ridge Dr, we noticed 2 orange triangular shaped lights in the sky heading northwest in a straight line. The lights were solid orange and not flashing like an airplane lights. 
We approached the intersection of Carlton Woods Dr and then made a u-turn in the round about to face back towards east bound direction of Sterling Ridge Dr. 
The 2 lights continued in the northwest direction and then went behind some trees momentarily. I noticed one of the lights flicker and then both lights disappeared. We drove around to see if the lights had continued on the straight line path, and they were not there anymore.

summary: 7 red orbs appearing one at a time out of nowhere just above the horizon
description: 7 red orbs appearing one at a time out of nowhere in the sky just above the horizon. As one would appear, it would float up high into the atmosphere and then disappear. 7 in a row did this. This happened just after the completion of a fireworks show.

summary: My daughter and I were outside on the back deck. I was bbqing. My daughter was watching the fireworks from the deck.
description:
As I looked up at the sky to watch the fireworks, a flaming ball appeared out of the sky just above the neighborhood across the highway. It literally looked like it was coming right towards us. I knew it wasn't an aircraft. 
I know of what those look like at night. As it looked like it was coming straight at us, it took a sharp right and started to move fast in an eastward direction. 
I was able to I pull out my phone and record the last few seconds of it being in site at 1080p 60 frames per second. As the object moved east it literally darted off in the distance. 
We looked up at a 30 to 40 degree angle. 
Trees slightly blocked our view. And it looked like it was about a mile away. Very creepy and surprising to see.

summary: immediately after fireworks a orangish red shere floated by us moving at a slow rate of speed approximately 100 feet altitude moving parallel to the shore then turned and went out over the lake until…

My family and I were standing in our backyard when a strange reddish orange light appeared over the horizon.  It traveled much faster then a plane or satellite without a tail or any blinking light or…
07-04-13  Luminous object  seen at close range for 10 minutes in hills of Marin County
description: I was walking up a steep hill near one of the foothills of Mt. Tamalpais when a mysterious black object came from behind one of the hills and came to a dead stop and continued to hover to the right of me approximately 100 yards away. This object made absolutely no sound and from where I was at on this hill was eye level with me and below treetop level. I stood there and watched it for a solid 10 minutes as it changed colors from green to red to a yellowish orange. It was mostly dimmed down and black for a few minutes but then started glowing like a lit up Christmas tree as I continued to observe it. It was oblong, taller than it was wide and took on the shape of a bell or lampshade with a brim on the bottom much like a hat. Finally after 10 minutes it turned a solid white color like a lit up lightbulb and lifted up and took off to the east at a fairly high rate of speed. There was a couple of people walking their dog down the hill from me that I tried to get! their attention to witness this but I did not want to yell and wake up the neighbors and I don't think they even noticed this object even though they were almost right under it. It was dimmed down so low that I really could…

summary: watching fireworks when saw 3 round red lights in a different sector of sky.
description:
No they were Not fireworks! The direction changed from straight up then headed towards us and changed direction to straight up again. No trailing light from a firework display or diminishing of size or brightness. The spacing was uniform and constant for each direction change. These lights did not fade out but disappeared into the clouds. A few minutes later 2 more identical lights appeared went straight up, went left, went right, then straight up and went into the same spot in the clouds. A short time later another group of 3 went straight up at an angle and into the exact spot as the first 2 groups.
I have been around professional fireworks people and grew up military so I know the difference.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: redish orange ovals with wings flying over the area for 15-20 minutes
description:
On the 4th of July this year we saw some redish orange crafts in the sky. There were 3 of us watching. I took a few pictures on my phone, but it was far away. I texted and called my family to tell them to look into the sky for these crafts. 
 I saw a few of them slowly moving around, they would leave and come back, and then I went in trying to contact the local news media, but could not figure out. When I come back out the people I was with said they went into formation (I assumed a line, but I am not sure that is what they said). 
At one time I went into the garage because they were freaking me out as they came a little lower. These things were flying around. I thought they were drones checking out to see who had the illegal fireworks out. 
They were small, but appeared to have wings. They flew like small aircraft could. They were in the area for about 20 minutes. 
About 10 days ago I heard you talking about similar sightings but did not hear of any near Mukilteo, WA, where we saw them.

summary: Bright orange fireballs seen on 4th of July in Buffalo N.Y.
description:
We were watching the fireworks, and at about 9:30 p.m., I heard the neighbor across the street say to his daughter, "What the hell is that?" 
He was very excited; so I looked up and seen an orange fireball object traveling South to North at a steady pace and then it would just fade away. 
Altogether within about an hour, I seen 3 of them, all above us, but not next to each other. 
The pictures I took did not come out good, it just looks like a light in the sky, it didn't even pick up the orange color. 
This is the very first time that I seen something, and I was very excited...I already was a believer.

summary: Light in sky north of Louisville
description: I walked outside to have a cigarette and was watching fireworks while doing so. A plane flew by in what is a common landing path for the Louisville airport, which I noticed. I looked up again and saw a light with a large halo around it behind and beneath the plane. At first I thought it was just another firework and didn’t pay it much notice, but it didn’t explode and moved horizontally in a similar path as the plane. I next thought that it was odd and noticed that the halo was shrinking but it was still bright. I started recording the light as it moved across the sky with my phone, buy by the time I started the halo that was around the center mass had shrunk considerably about 3 times from the original size. I continued recording until the light was no longer visible because of trees obscuring the view. From where I was standing and started recording to where I could no longer see the light covered a conservative 30 degree span of the sky.

summary: At roughly 22:00 in boise idaho on july 4th, 2013, a red ball floating across the sky at a steady speed.
description:
Me and two others saw a red circle floating across the sky in boise idaho on july 4th 2013 at roughly 22:00 (10:00 pm) At first I thought it could be a firework so I continued to watch, but it did not blow up like it should. It just kept on floating till it was to far to see. After a few minutes I looked back into the sky and saw it again, this time going in the opposite direction. It looked just like a red orb or ball just flying by at a steady speed.
Discription of witnesses: 1: 74 year old female. Perfectly sane, no mental illness 20 year old male. 21 year old female. 
No alcohol or drugs of any form were consumed by any of the observers

summary: Dull reddish glow seen NE of Fort Wayne, IN.
description: The UFO seen was in the distance, but a UFO for sure. It was first spotted by my mom when we were lighting fireworks. At first I thought it was just a spark from a firework in the sky, but it hung in the night, with a dull red glow, far in the distance, unmoving. It lasted for about 5 minutes, and then, while our eyes were off it, it disappeared. I'm sorry I can't give you more details, but it was NE of Fort Wayne, IN. That's the best I can give you. I hope that this helps you some what!

summary: Orange fast orbs
description:
Over a 10 min time frame we saw 5 orange flying projects with a hot orange glow moving threw the sky faster than any plane near by. Then they would just disappear after a few miles. No sound came from them.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Red lower w/pink band upper, burning/glowing cube shaped object, made a sharp right angle change of direction.
description:
Hi Peter,
I have finally decided to post this sighting my wife and I experienced. It was the 4th of July, 2013 or 14, and as you can imagine, there were lots of pyrotechnics going off around the neighborhood. We weren't shooting any but were sitting in our back yard watching and listening to everyone else play. It sounds like a war zone in our neighborhood every 4th and this night was no exception. We don't see most of the rockets because of the trees surrounding our property but get an occasional glimpse of the bigger ones.
I was sitting, facing SW with my wife on my right facing S. I glanced up and noticed a large glowing/shimmering/burning object coming over the trees drifting due west (L to R) around 20 mph (?). It was probably a half inch square-ish at arms length and was almost directly overhead, somewhat south of the zenith. I immediately assumed it was fireworks debris from a large rocket drifting overhead. Within 5 seconds it was clear it was not. I shouted to my wife, "Check it out!" I haven't read many reports with this description, it was virtually square, the lower 80% glowing/shimmering cherry red identical to a campfire coal, the top 20% a horizontal band of pink,…

summary: Red ball spotted by 4 people on 295s Prince George, Va.
description:
1 red ball about 100 feet above our truck on 295 south in Prince George County, Va. Caught it out of the corner of my eye above the truck while my husband was driven. 
I told my daughter and her friend to look out the back window as it was passing over us and they also seen it, and then all of a sudden gone.
It was making a noise of a engine running.

summary: Fireball traveled from NJ over PA
description:
Fireball drifted across the sky south to north east. I initially thought it was a firework but realized it wasn't burning out as it traveled across the sky with a consistent fireball throughout the duration of the sighting. 
Used cell phone to take video footage when I realized it was not a firework.

summary: Orange Orbs in Sky at Night over Indian Lake, Ohio July 4th
description:
Our entire group (8 people) saw at least 6 different orange globes over Indian Lake, Ohio. This occurred every night on our visit. 
We were at the lake from July 3rd to July 6th. 
The orange orbs would appear and disappear. We saw them move up and down and side to side. 
At one point there were 5 orange orbs stacked up on each other and they would disappear and reappear either at the same time or separately. 
During the day we never saw airplanes or helicopters flying over the lake. When we saw the orange orbs we never heard any noise.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Seen during Fireworks show.
description:
In the last minutes of video (1:10) it jets off real quick and disappears.
http://youtu.be/jjKI8hDz7m8
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Glowing pinkish red object. Heading north and silent running.
description: Second sighting within an hour. This time I got video and a couple of photos. This was the same type that we saw an hour ago however this time I was not able to make out the craft. summary: Bright red and orange light
description:
Shortly after the local fireworks display, myself and two other witnesses saw a brightly glowing light. It was red in color and about every five seconds changing to a burnt orange for almost a second and then back to red.
I first saw it moving south as it made a fast sharp left turn heading east and then moving at a slower speed. As it moved east it looked to have a burst of speed every time it changed color, then slowing down again. The light traveled about a third of the sky then just simply stopped and hovered for about 40 seconds. While it was just sitting there it was still changing color from red to burnt orange then back again, and every time it changed color it got dimmed in brightness, the it simply just disappeared.
There was some cloud cover because it lightly rained just before the fireworks display. At the time of the sighting there was no rain but the clouds remained. The light was below the cloud cover the entire time that we saw it and there was no wind movement and we heard no sound other then a few people setting off firecrackers. It was the weirdest thing I have ever seen!

summary: My husband was out watching fireworks in neighborhood, while looking up at about a 30 to 45 degree angle from the horizon he saw three orange globes in a line in equal distance from each other slowly…
description:
No sound and definitely not fireworks, a plane or helicopter. 
Not foreign matter floating, but directed and sustained movement. Length of sighting was about a minute before they faded away. 
This was very similar to a sighting we saw together on August 31, 2012.

summary: Unknown red ball object in the sky near fireworks display.
description:
On July 4th 2013 around 8.00 pm my son and myself were at the front of my house watching Fireworks from a church about a mile(looking south east)when after a large red air burst we seen a red ball seem to rise out of the treeline near the fireworks,we both looked at each other at the same time and my son said "Dad Whats that red thing"! We watched the object fly slowly at about 200 Ft off the ground and I would guess its speed was around 100 MPH moving North as it passed it made no sound. It was 15ft around and had a red glow to it.
My son ran into the house to grab the camcorder and recorded 10 seconds of video before we lost sight of it in the trees away from my house.we did not see anything on the video due to my son moving the camera around trying to record it.
I've never seen anything like this and have no clue on what that was, I know this was not a Jet or a plane.

summary: 9 yellow / red disks silently sailed across the sky at low level, first three in a line, the next we're 6 red disks in zig zag pattern
description:
Single file, three in a row about 5 minutes apart, the first two disks were yellow & the third was red slowly, silently passed over at a low level, In a separate flight path six red disks in a zig zag pattern 10 - 15 min later crossed the sky at he same pace as the first three.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Two redish orange lights make 45 degree turn and speed into the clouds in Pinellas Park,Fl.
description:
My wife was outside watching the neighbor's fireworks,she turned to watch two redish orange lights moving slowly in the sky she yelled for me to look and at 21:20 we both watched the lights make a slow 45 degree turn and quickly disappear into the clouds.
The size of the two lights were the size of a bright star at night.The sky was cloudy and there was rain in the area.
We do get air traffic over our home,but,we have never seen anything like this.
((names deleted)) Pinellas Park,Fl.

summary: Circle orange light traveling at an high altitude from south to north
description:
Orange circle light about the size of a dime traveling from south to north just west of our position at 9:20 pm. 
Appeared at about a 45 degree angle and also disappeared at a 45 degree angle in the horizon which tells me it was extremely high up, similar to a satellite. 
We saw another orange circle light about 35 min. later traveling in the same direction, just east of our position. 
Saw 1 more orange circle light about an hour later traveling from SW to NE. This one went directly over us. When directly over us it looked like a white dot about the size of a pin point for about 2 seconds then turned orange again. 
Each occurrence lasted 45 sec. to a minute. We also saw another on July 5th at 9:23 pm traveling south to north and another on July 6th at roughly 10:00 pm traveling from south to north and turned east just south of our position. 
It was clear each night we saw these orange circle lights. No sound was heard either.

summary: Mufti sided grey craft with pinkish red smaller illumination off center. Looked like a flare. Heading due north. Silent
description: At first it looked like a flare or a firework. Since to the 4th of July I expected it to be a falling firework but it didn't burn out and kept on moving forward. It was pinkish red like a flare. It traveled across the sky and I lost sight of it only when it went behind the trees. When I caught the next glimpse of it I was able to see the actual craft. It was silent in the night sky. I grabbed my camera but by the time I realized it wasn't a firework it was too late as it was already heading behind the trees and I couldn't get a shot of it. I wasn't sure what it was until I was able to see the craft itself. A grayish 5 or 6 sided craft heading due north.

summary: As I was driving home I noticed four objects traveling north over Winston-Salem.  At first glance, I thought they were hot air balloons though I thought it odd they would be flying at night,…
description:
When I got home a few minutes later I watched the first set go off into the distance until I could no longer see them, then the first glow in the second set faded away, the second glow did the same. 
Then I observed another set of two follow the same path and fade away as well.

summary: orange glows following path
description: Saw three different orange glowing balls fly across the sky in the same pattern, following a semi circular pattern then disappearing. The object started out over the trees, came across west to east and then back towards its original point before disappearing and another following the same path. No sound emitted, and not very high off the ground, maybe 500 feet approximately.

summary: 2 orange spheres moving from south to north and seen by 3 people
description:
My sister and I were looking out my back windows for fireworks displays. Suddenly a very bright orange sphere slowly crossed the sky in the east. It was traveling from the south to the north. 
We live about 15 miles NW of O’Hare, and after watching planes take off and land for over 10 years, I can say this was not an aircraft. It was approximately the size of a green pea held out at arm’s length. 
I called my husband who was upstairs looking for fireworks from the bedroom window to tell him about it, and he said he saw it too. I should point out that he is an engineer and a huge skeptic, especially about UFOs. 
He came downstairs to discuss it, and as I glanced out the window there was another one, same size, same orange color, following the same path. 
All three of us also observed this one as well.

summary: Flying objects with red-orange glow seen in Sebastian, Florida.
description:
I was out on my lanai watching July 4th fireworks with my husband, when we noticed a red-orange object flying. It was in the opposite direction of the fireworks.
At first I thought it was a space station, but I've seen them before and they were never that big or that color. The way it flew resembled the flight path of one. No sound.
The glowing object flew over us and continued across the sky till we could no longer see it. We commented that it was going to fast for a plane, ha ha, must be a UFO. We were mesmerized by it.
About five minutes later, we saw the exact same thing. It flew horizon to horizon, SE-NW. We're not laughing about it any more.

summary: Red Orb 4th of July Purcellville, VA with video link
description:
Red orb appeared just before the local fireworks, came out from behind one tree line, over the highway, and behind another tree line in a straight silent line. 
Color changed from red to white to red. 
Video is from bridge over highway, and it moved SE to NW direction (opposite of wind) and TOWARD the mountains. Kids who saw movie, "Tangled," thought it was a paper lantern, thus the comment in the video (also being e-mailed). 
http://s25.photobucket.com/user/ladyangel944/library/Contact

summary: Ufo above Williams twp and Bethlehem fireworks!
description:
Driving behind giant shopping center. Saw a truck pulled over and 2 people looking up. I assumed they were watching the finale of the fireworks that I believe we're coming from Bethlehem. I then realized the 2 people were looking above and to the left of the fireworks so I stopped and got out. 
I saw a fireball moving along the mountain range that is Williams township toward Bethlehem. It was well above the fireworks (over 1500 ft above) and I observed the object stop above Williams township for about 1 minute and then speed toward the fireworks which would be at least 10 miles away in less then 1 minute. 
It then began to move toward the mountain range and disappear behind it. 
The entire time would have been 3 minutes that I watched this thing with my own eyes. 
The 2 people standing there stated they were observing it for 10 minutes and believed it to be "a ufo."

summary: 25 to 30 Large Bright Orange Round  moving objects with no sound, going north.
description:
Our Second Sighting: Large Bright Orange Glowing Balls Traveling In Twos On 07/04/2013 North Platte, Nebraska Our second sighting: Again out of North Platte Nebraska, on July 4, 2013 around 9:20 pm I was out back on the deck behind our house in our yard watching fire works when I observed two large round bright orange glowing objects coming from the west & two from the south at the same time. The ones coming from the west turned north as they reached the edge of North Platte & the ones coming from the south were going north & they all continued north until they were no longer visible. This continued for about 2 hours. I watched a minimum of 25 to 30 of them within that time period. After 11 pm they stopped coming.
My husband witnessed two of them going from the south to the north as he was leaving for work around 10:30 pm & again there was no sound coming from them.

summary: Reddish orange orbs moving east to west, caught on video
description: Slow moving, orange/red orbs following in the same flight path. No flashing lights like planes have. I have video on my iPhone of the event. There were fireworks being set off all around but these lights were far to high and stayed illuminated for the entire time. No sound when they moved over our home. They were moving east to west.

summary: Triple green-red sphere flying over LA
description:
We were in a parking lot in LA waiting for some fireworks. 
A green sphere started to incessantly move in the sky. Zooming in on it, we saw that the lights were actually three, two green and one red. 
It stopped for some minutes before moving again, wheeling and flying around. 
Then it vanished. 
They were not fireworks.

summary: Fireball moving across the sky
description: My daughter and I went outside to see neighbors setting off fireworks. I looked to the north and saw a very bright "fireball" heading west. We frequently see night launches of rockets from Kennedy Space Center, and while this was similar, it seemed closer and it was heading the wrong way. (The rockets always arch up and to the east.) This seemed to be moving about the same speed and had that same look as a rocket, but larger and brighter. It got progressively smaller and and more dim. I assume it was going higher and/or moving further away. Could have been some sort of military aircraft, but there was only one, we could hear no noise and there isn't a military base near here.

summary: Succession of red lights in the sky
description:
We went to the beach to view local fireworks. Me and 1 friend. Just as fireworks were beginning, before it was completely dark, I noticed a strange orange/red light moving through the sky rather slowly, from south to north, just behind the beach line. I am just guessing at the height, but it seemed to be about 60-100 feet in the air. I alerted my friend to this odd, slow moving "firework". It had a red light in the front, and it was light enough out that we were able to see the outline of a rectangular shape "craft" silhouette with the light at the front.
We looked at each other and said "Whoa, that was weird". There were many other people present at the beach, not a single person besides us seemed to notice the odd light in the sky (Perhaps because they were focused on the fireworks being shot out over the water, whereas this was behind the beach) As the skies darkened, we saw another light moving in exactly the same manner. Due to the fact the sun had set, we were unable to see a silhouette behind the light, but as the light passed, it was not visible from behind.
Another and yet another of these lights passed, at about 3-5 minute intervals. 2 of the lights dropped rapidly to…

summary: Triangular light formation over Denver on the 4th.
description:
My girlfriend and I were watching fireworks from our balcony on the 8th floor. Looking directly North we have an open view of the city. I'm not sure the exact time as the fireworks started about 21:00 hours and continued for most of the night but my best estimate would be somewhere around 22:00-23:00 hours.
As we watched the fireworks over the city we both noticed three lights moving around about 15-20 degrees above the horizon. Their distance from us was hard to judge but my impression was that it was a good distance away >4 miles. The lights seemed to fade in and out of sight in order from three to one then three again. 
The three lights maintained what seemed an equal distance from each other at all times. A perfect formation in a triangular shape. If the lights were on the corners of a flat triangular shape then the flat plane of that object looked to be twisting and rolling slowly but the lights remained visible.
 The size of the lights were much larger than any of the surrounding fireworks which made them stand out more and the color was the light yellow of a typical street light as I recall.

summary: Hi,
description:
My name is ((name deleted)), I live in Irmo, SC...just outside of Columbia, SC...to the NW.
Last night just before dusk I saw a single orange/red ball? moving in a straight line, moving from the south to the north...it never varied speed or appeared to vary in altitude, made no noise and wasn't moving as fast as a plane or helio. 
We had a cloud cover last night, that should limit the altitude...we had very little wind last night as well....I'd have to rule out a balloon with a light attached as it was moving faster than the wind was blowing. It had no trail behind it, no flames or smoke that I could see.
The reason for this e-mail is that I have just done a search of the site, I see that on many occastions, thoughout the state, there have many many reports of the same type.....any conclusions or explaination? 
Thanks ((name deleted))
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and he sounded to us to be quite sober-minded. We suspect that he is a highly reliable, and highly skilled observer. PD

summary: Circular Red/Gold Lights flying overhead
description:
On July 4, 2013, between 2100 and 2200, we were in our backyard shooting fireworks. One of our daughters was looking up in anticipation and noted 3 moving lights in formation. When first observed, the lights were located to our southeast. I at first thought they may be the headlights of a small plane since there are many that fly in this area. However, it became clear these were different and unique. Approximately 10 minutes later a fourth light passed and a fifth passed approximately 10 minutes after the fourth. All lights were similar. There was a fairly strong westward wind and it was partly cloudy with the clouds travelling northwest. The following is a summary of the observation.
 Formation, speed and flight path: When the 3 light formation first appeared, the lights were noted at about 45 degrees from vertical while facing south east and appeared to be travelling directly towards our location. For the fourth and fifth lights, the same pattern was observed.
The 3 light formation may have been a vee, but with only three, this is likely an assumption although the middle one seemed to slightly lead the others. They remained close together approximately in the same position…

summary: Multiple sets of two objects appear on the horizon over land (Hampton, NH) and precede to move off into the sky off the coast of Rye NH
description:
My girlfriend and I are from Massachusetts, and were headed up to the New Hampshire sea coast for the Fourth of July festivities. We were planning on spending the day at Wallis Sands state beach in Rye, NH, but due to the incredibly hot weather, traffic, and my overheating engine we decided to stop short of our destination and spend the day at the North Hampton beach. For those of you not familiar with this area, it is on the border of Rye, and is far from the main Hampton strip which helps cut down on the crowds for a much friendlier environment.
We arrived at approximately 2pm and spend the day in the water, and at the beach. As darkness and the July Fourth fireworks displays were approaching, we decided to walk North up Route 1A to find a vantage point which would allow us to watch both the Hampton Beach display, and the Rye display at Jenniss Beach. The point we found is after a bend in the road which is 3/4ths of the way up a rock face overlooking a large majority of the New Hampshire Sea coast. From this point the Salisbury water tower and Seabrook Nuclear facility is clearly visible. According to Google Earth the nuclear plant is 5.72 miles at a 222.40 degree heading from…

summary: Orb with orange glow
description:
I dont know how long it stayed there because I was driving down the road but I was able to slow enough to get a short video. I am very skeptical but I honestly have not idea what was in the sky last night. 
It had a orange glow from it and it was not quite as high as the clouds. I was moving slowly so i could not tell for sure if it was stationary or moving.

summary: Red glowing light flew overhead prior to fireworks show
description: Last night (July 4, 2013) I had a series of several UFO sightings around 9pm, while outside watching the Fourth of July fireworks at Regency Park in Cary, NC. I was sitting near Symphony Lake, under some pine trees. I had a clear view of the lake, and of the sky above the lake where the fireworks would be (there was a gap in the group of pine trees, with a direct view of the spot across the lake where the fireworks are set off). We were all looking up at the sky, waiting for the fireworks to begin. Before the fireworks started, I suddenly saw a bright red glowing light fly over the lake. For a moment I thought it was the fireworks starting, but quickly realized it wasn't. The reddish light appeared quite large and low in the sky. It appeared about the size of a dime held at arm's length. It appeared to be flying lower than an airplane would fly. The strangest thing was that the light pulsed, or glowed, in a slow and steady rhythm, completely different from t! he lights on an airplane or helicopter. It glowed bright, and then waned, and when it had just about disappeared, it would resume glowing up to a bright red, and then wane again. It flew in a straight path above the lake. It…

summary: A very bright orange light passed overhead from south to north at a high rate of speed silently traversing the sky completely.  It covered the distance of the sky from south to north in approximately…
description: Approximately 5 minutes later another brighter orange light passed overhead again same as the last. 8 people witnessed this at a backyard dinner.

summary: Unknown amber light in sky without any associated noise
description: While outside watching back yard fireworks this evening I first saw 2 amber light in sky flying from south,southeast to north ,north west. There was no noise associated with their flying They seem to travel for a mile or so then completely disappear. Within 3to 5 minutes another amber light appeared in the north,northwest sky for another short period this time heading south,southeast.Within another 10 minutes 2 more flyig amber light appeared in the sky @ the approximate same altitue, maybe 1 to2 thousand feet they also disappeared within 5 to 7 minutes. There was never any sound associated with movement.

summary: fire ball in the portland oregon sky
description:
Prior to the beginning of the fire works getting started there was a big reddish type of ball floating in the upper sky. It kinda just hung there in the sky floating around - it wasn't a balloon,
i pointed it out to others there must have been a few hundred people there some seen it as we were pointing it out. 
It was rather bizarre watching this fire ball just floating and hovering in the upper sky. must have lasted for about 30 minutes then the fire works started and my attention went to the fire works.

summary: Orange glowing triangle crafts unmoving above a corn field.
description:
July 4th, between 2011 and 2014. Two orange, glowing triangles stationary in the sky. I was in the back seat of the car with my mother. I looked out the window and saw the objects. They weren't the typical three-light triangle craft, but the entirety of the crafts glowed orange. I watched them for as long as they were in view. They did not move the entire time. No buildings were in the area, and the objects were floating above a corn field. No lanterns or fireworks bear resemblance to the crafts.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: Orange glowing sphere moving at constant speed and altitude.
description:
Orange glowing sphere moving in a straight line from North to South at a constant altitude. Witnesses located on the ground East of object. 
Three of the witnesses are ATP rated pilots. 
Could not be aircraft lights unless the navigation lights were of the wrong color and in the incorrect orientation (red on the left wing, green in the right wing). 
Speed was difficult to gauge as the range to the object was unknown although it was obvious that the object was moving much too fast to be a balloon of any kind. 
The altitude was estimated at 2500 to 3000 feet assuming it was as close as it appeared.
Report from three airline pilots. PD

summary: Two lit "Crafts" fly over , witnessed by husband and wife July 4th 2013
description:
On the evening of July 4, 2013 my husband and I were sitting outside in chairs observing fireworks. It was close to 9:00 PM. Suddenly my husband said "look at that", and pointed to the left of where we were sitting. That would been East. We witnessed 2 identical crafts one in front of the other flying fairly low going West. Both had a thin band of reddish orange windows going around their circumference that appeared to be lit up. They might have been lights but I could see divisions between each "window" or light whichever it was. There was no sound whatsoever. We followed them with our eyes until they were completely out of sight. One flew through a cloud and I saw it when it came back out and and watched it until it faded in the distance.
Since, I have been persistent in trying to figure out what I saw. It wasn't a firey ball, as many have described. I will never give up trying to understand and figure out what we saw. It was awesome...but in my 67 years the most amazing sight I have ever seen.

summary: Yellowish-Orange sphere west of Mutiney Bay with several hundred folks celebrating the 4th of July.
description:
UFO Sighting on Whidbey Island On the 4th of July, shortly after the sun settled over the horizon, 6 to 8 glowing orange orbs or fire balls flew slowly overhead and then exited south east at what appeared to be supersonic speeds. 
They first appeared west of Mutiny Bay on Whidbey Island, Washington and then travelled parallel to the western portion of Mutiny Bay beach. Unlike jet aircraft, the orbs did not make a sound. The first one took off and accelerated to over 30 to 40 thousand feet or more in a matter of a few seconds until it was no longer visible. 
A few minutes later five or six more followed in the same path, at semi-equal distance from one another, and again (one after the other) ascended to 30 to 40 thousand feet in the same direction - until no longer visible. The last one appeared a few minutes later, separate from the cluster of 5 or 6, and again was traveling in a south east direction. But about Parallel to our observation point the orb shot straight up at an accent that made it disa! ppear from view in a matter of seconds, perhaps close to a minute.
My best guess is that the orbs were 20 to 30 feet in diameter and that they first appeared at about 1,000 feet in…

summary: 2 objects in the nighttime skydiving up and down and up and down during fireworks show
description:
2 objects with white and red lights one bright one going up and down while the other one went left and right and up and down quickly for no logical reaso during the fireworks show. 
About 5 minutes later 3, what appeared to be glowing flickering Chinese camdles were floating across the sky on the north section of Fillmore. It appeared that the section objects were unrelated to the first. Also possibly unrelated the power went out in the section of Fillmore that we were in. Most of the city was still on. Only 1/4 of Fillmore power went down.

summary: Low flying, slow clump of green lights
description:
At a public fireworks display, a few minutes after they stopped the fireworks, and cars were driving away .... there were two groups of 6 to 8 green glowing circular lights...changing position as they slowly floated by ... like a flock of birds, then they seemed to coalesce ... at first you would think fireworks, but it wasnt that ... they were floating very low in the sky, not falling or raising, just floating level.
I got in the car to follow them ... then they seemed to be too distant or fade away.

summary: Singular, bright white light mid sky seen at twilight, w/ no stars visible
description:
At approximately 2055h on Thursday 7/4/13, my 8 year old child & I were driving on Rapheal rd towards Bradshaw rd. 
I happened to look to my left, and in the sky there was what appeared to be one large, bright, stationary, circular light. It was so bright, white light almost--brighter than the sun. I pointed it out to my son after I realized that it was definitely stationary in the sky, & not just a plane moving towards us. It was higher in elevation than a plane would be, & the light shown steady, with no pulsing or flickering apparent. 
As we turned left onto the next street, the object continued to remain in the same position. There was no sound from this object. The sky was free of clouds at the time and blue, with no stars visible yet. There was a slight southeast wind blowing. 
 It was the only bright light in the sky, and I have no explanation for it. 
I am a trauma nurse, & I am extremely observant, with critical thinking skills that I utilize everyday. This was a UFO. 
I tried to take a picture w/ my phone, but it wouldnt show up on my screen.

summary: 9 orange/red spheres a few hundred feet above silently travel across our neighbors properties July 4, Chalfont, PA
description:
First saw three consecutive red/orange roundish bright lights, silent move across horizon not very far from house. 
While watching third one disappear into distance, I turned around to see six more of the same - orange/red roundish objects flying over field behind us in a zig-zag pattern, silently.

summary: Dark gray flat-ended saucer shaped object flying west to east.
description:
On the Fourth of July, I was on my second floor deck, watching the fireworks begin, looking W/NW. The sun had set, but there was still an orange glow to the western clouds. Far to the west, I saw a dark gray object hovering just under the cloud line. 
I stepped inside to retrieve a pair of binoculars that I keep hanging inside the door. I sighted the object through the binoculars, and it was moving east at a slow pace, coming right towards me. It was very far away, so it is difficult to estimate its size, but I would say it was just a little smaller than a mid-sized plane. 
It was silent, had no running lights, and no exhaust. As it came closer, perhaps a mile or two away, it started to bank to it's left, or North. 
As it banked, I could clearly see that it was saucer shaped in front, but the back end was flat; what a dime would look like if one clipped off about an eighth of it. 
I followed it with the binoculars until it disappeared past the tree line. 
This is the third UFO I have viewed from my deck in the past two years, and my second report filed with NUFORC.

summary: Light in the sky dissappears after slowly flying towards the area where i live.
description:
My son and I were out at night, around 8:45pm. We went to the elementary school down the street from my house to view the fireworks that were going to be lit from the high school a few blocks down. 
We were sitting, facing south when I caught in my eye, from the southeast, a light coming towards us high up in the sky. I didn’t think anything as our neighborhood is in the flight path of our local airport. 
There had obviously been lights all evening however, this light didn’t have any blinking lights coming from it so I knew it wasn’t an airplane or helicopter. 
I then looked away for a few seconds and when I looked back it appeared brighter and bigger than before. 
I then took my eyes off it again and I looked towards the west where I saw another light that looked just like this one, this other light had a blinking light though. 
So I looked back at the unusual light and right as I tried to tell my son to look, the light started to dim fast until it fully faded a! way and left a small ball of fog behind. 
I kept my eye on that area to see if I could possibly spot anything else and was unsuccessful.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Glowing Orb/ Fireball
description:
This past 4th of July, 2013, my family and I had gone to go watch the community fireworks show at the local middle school. We arrived at the field around 8:30pm. It was still light out and there were already hundreds of people gathered in the field. We were there for maybe about 15-20 minutes watching the kids run around catching fireflies and I was setting up my camera getting ready for the show. I have a Cannon Rebel T3i with a 55mm-250mm telephoto lens and was playing with the settings to get the best fireworks shots I could.
My youngest son who is 5 years old saw something in the sky and told us all to turn and look at it. He thought it was a balloon. When I turned to look at it I knew right away that it was no balloon. It appeared to be some sort of glowing orb. It was so bright at the center that it appeared bright white and had an orange glow around that. As an avid photographer I had taken many photographs of balloons and knew right away this was different. It was traveling horizontally across the sky about the speed of a commercial passenger plane. It moved very smoothly and silently. It was probably flying around 15000 to 20000 feet based off where most planes fly. It…

summary: Three orange lights, soundlessly  moving north in a vee formation above the town of Somers, WI
description: Right around dusk, sitting in my neighbors yard, my friend and I were looking south and saw 3 orange lights in a perfect v formation slowly moving north at a slow rate of speed. I live in an airplane flight zone and close to a small airport, so lights in the sky is something I am used to. The reason this object or objects caught my eye was that it was July 4th and people were starting to light off fireworks so I was looking around to which neighbors were lighting them off. The 3 lights were exactly the same distance apart the whole time I was watching them. They were about the same distance up in the sky as the smaller airplanes are right before they land at the Kenosha Airport, just south of my house(about 5 miles away). They were not making a sound and then the left light(on the east side) slowly went out. It was not like a light switch being turned off, though. It almost seemed to fade out. The other 2 lights kept moving at the same rate of speed, the ! same distance apart for another 30 seconds and then the back right light(on the west side) went out the same way as the first. The front orange light was still on and moving at the same speed, same height for another 20 seconds…

summary: orange glowing orb floats across sky
description:
My family and I were waiting in the field behind the middle school waiting for the 4th of July fireworks when my 5 yr old son noticed something in the sky. He thought it was a hot air balloon. 
When we turned to look at it there was no balloon or basket. What we saw was a glowing orb. It was bright white at the center, yellow around the center and orange on the outside. 
It was traveling from southwest to northeast. It wasn't falling thru the sky, it appeared to be gaining in altitude. It made no noise. 
There were at least a couple hundred people there waiting for the fireworks to begin. You could hear other people saying "look at that" So I know we weren't the only ones who seen it. 
As an avid photographer I had my camera ready to photograph the fireworks and was able to get 2 pictures of the object. I have a Canon T3i rebel camera with a 55mm-250mm zoom lens and was able to get a fairly clear photo of the object. 
My girlfriend had been frightened by what we saw when we were observing it. It traveled in a fairly straight path across the sky appearing to slighty gain altitude as it crossed overhead. It traveled about three quarters across the sky above before it just…

summary: White and red blinking light moving across horizon, slowing down to a stop, then vanishing.
description:
I was at the Portland, Maine fireworks show with my aunt and her friend and I looked out towards the ocean. I saw what I thought to be a jet coming to land at the nearby airport moving across the horizon where the ocean and the sky meet. It was a blinking red and white light, like an airplanes rotating beacon light. It was moving at normal airplane speed but then it started slowing down, and then it came to an almost complete stop. I pointed it out to my aunt, and she couldn't see it really well, then I looked back and it had vanished.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Distant unmoving object with no lights during the day on July 4th.
description:
While waiting for the sun to go down sitting in a kayak on the Charles River, my fiance' and I happened to look above us before the sky darkened for the fireworks and saw an unidentifiable object. Mind you, I was completely sober and there were no waves to rock us back and forth. 
The object caught our eyes especially because it didn't move, grow or decrease in size, or blink with light. It just stayed in place. 
For those on the river or downtown waiting for dusk to deepen, they may all tell you that the sky itself was odd that night, with a streak of light peach colored "atmosphere" across its entirety. It's described this way because it was unclear whether it was clouds or some trick the sun was playing on us. 
Anyway, we remember the craft being greyish to light blue, in a somewhat triangular shape with ridges on its side. 
Just as we observed more of its features it seemed to quickly evaporate away into nothingness.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: Two, orangish-red ufo's over downtown Tulsa, on the night of the 4th of July.
description:
I saw two of the orangish-red ufo's fly from the south to the north over downtown Tulsa between 8:30 PM, central standard time and 9:45 PM, central standard time while waiting to watch a fireworks display in downtown Tulsa, Oklahoma. 
The two ufo's produced no sound and had no strobe lights like conventional aircraft.

summary: Red sphere at a Fireworks display in Rhode Island 2013.
description:
On 08/04/2013 ((sic. July 4th??)) around 20:00hrs pm my son and myself were watching fireworks on the stairs at my house(Fireworks about 1 mile away south) when a red sphere like object seem to come out of the treeline under the fireworks.
At first we were waiting for it to explode but it didn't, the object climbed to what I could tell was 100 feet off the ground then took a hard left turn west.
My son and myself both realized it was not part of the firework display and I sent my son into the house for the camcorder.
My son ran out of the house to the stairs with the camera running and pointed it at the object then recorded about 3 to 4 seconds before we lost it the treeline west when we first seen it.
Note: the object made no sound, had no tail or markings and did a upward left turn.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Numerous bright red, yellow,and green glowing objects that moved at a steady speed with no sound. Observed an explosion of one.
description:
I am a retired police officer and myself, my wife, and two friends were watching forth of July fireworks. We live in Tinley Park Il. and was watching in the direction of Frankfort Il which is South of us. 
We had an un-obstructed view of the fireworks over a small lake when all of a sudden I observes three bright red glowing circular shaped objects on the South horizon. The objects rose up and proceeded in a steady speed in a North East direction. The objects continued to glow from red to yellow and sometimes green. 
Over the next three hours we saw numerous objects, sometime in formations of three or four and one time in a "V" formation of three and one following. 
All of the objects originated from the South and continued in a N/E direction. At one point, as one of the objects were about to travel directly over us, the object lost its glow and I was able to see the object in a stelth type mode as it went over us. The object appeared to by fairly l! arge and looked triangular with rounded edges. I saw three large circulat shapes in the center of the object. 
There was absolutely no sound and the object continued overhead Northbound. We saw at least 20 to 30 of the same objects…

summary: Dark red light over Rock River in Rockford, Il before fireworks...
description:
Was downtown waiting for fireworks when I noticed a dark red light in the sky moving really slow... 
I thought maybe it was a helicopter but there was no flashing light or any other light source... 
It then faded out and you could see the object just sitting there for 15 minutes until it just disappeared... 
Note there where other helicopters in the area with flashing lights and landing lights on...

summary: I Saw 4 orange lights moving/flying objects in the sky after few minutes they disappeared.
5-6 Reddish Orange Orbs spotted around the greater Tulsa area 4th July night.
description:
I am a student and the wife is an Administrator at a local company. On the evening of July 4th at sunset the wife and I went into the back yard to watch the fireworks and immediately spotted a reddish orange sphere in the sky moving very slowly. The wife said it was a touring helo giving rides for the fireworks which is common but it was glowing and had no strobes.
 After dismissing it, 10 to 15 minutes later,another one appeared taking roughly the same flight path, then another. They traveled together and seemed to be circling the greater Tulsa city limits on the east side at about the same altitude as a traffic helo or the small Cessna that fly over head most days.
At any given time until we retired for the evening at least one of these orbs could be seen. In total I spotted the first one northeast of my location at sunset, then the two in about the same local a bit later, then after dark one to the south, then ten or twenty minutes later one northwest that appeared to be over midtown and lastly before we retired at 2300 hours one or two over the greater Bixby area to the west/southwest.
None of them made any sound. With a small air strip nearby and living near the landing path…

summary: 2 red/pink lights, circular shape.
description:
Bright reddish/pinkish light moving silently, one following the other. Either very large object at high altitude or smaller object at low altitude. Steady light. No blinking. Coming from the southwest moving northeast.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Paper lanterns in UFO-like formation.
description:
This is a non-UFO sighting, but I suspect you will get a number of UFO reports regarding it so I decided to inform you of it.
My wife and I and some relatives were attending the Bartlett, Il Independence Day Festivities known as Bartlett Fest. At approximately 17:00:00 we observed what appeared to be a triangular formation of orange lights appearing from the south (S) and heading north (N). The lights had a orange, flame-like glow and were low in the sky.
Initially, we found this very disconcerting as we watched this formation slowly drift off to the N. As the lights vanished out of sight another appeared from the S, this time lower in the sky, and we were able to observe that it was in fact a paper lantern. I was able to zoom my camera (Nikon Coolpix P510, 42x optical zoom) on the object to confirm it was indeed a paper lantern. However, I was not able to get a clear photograph of the object due to the difficulty of using autofocus on a moving target. Approximately 3 - 4 more lanterns were observed moving from the S to N before the 17:30:00 fireworks display. 
On our way home, at approximatel! y 18:00:00, we observed another paper lantern over Greenbrook Ave. in Hanover Park, Il…

summary: 1 red orange round object observed on 4 July 2013 from Bremerton, Washington, approx. 17:00 hrs..
description:
1 object was observed coming in from the east at approx. 1500 ft. 
It was orange/red and round. The object then stopped, went to the right, stopped, went to the left, idled for approx. 20 seconds then went straight up into the atmosphere in about 5 seconds until it was out of sight. 
The object retained its color of orange/red. It was not a plane,helocoptier, or some form of fireworks. 
I've seen this type of object about 5 times over the years and it's very frustrating in that it doesn't make sense. 
If these objects are from somewhere external to the earth what do they want? 
It's somewhat creepy like they are playing games with us.I am an amature astronomer and know the cosmos quite well. 
I do work on variable stars.

summary: Pulsating light in the northeast skies of Cromwell, CT
description:
Six of us witnessed a pulsating light located in the northeast sky, in the direction of Glastonbury, CT. 
We couldn't make out the exact shape of the UFO but it looked to be diamond shaped. Based on the distance, we estimated the object to be at least 30,000+ feet high. We witnessed the stationary object for over 10 minutes and then a cloud came by which disrupted our view and by the time the cloud cleared our line of sight, the object was gone. 
At first we thought it was a plane moving away from us as this object was located in the direction of a flight pattern. However after the event, we tracked planes flying by and nothing could even come close to what we saw. 
Proof positive of the experience was that the skeptics present could note explain it either!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Bird like oblect travels silently in a too fast perfectly straight line until out of view.
description:
I looked up to scan the sky to see what I may see, always hoping to see something of interest, when I saw what I thought was a large bird at about 500 feet which looked to be the size of a condor or larger silently soaring in a straight line from South to North. 
I watched it expecting it to either flap its wings or change direction slightly but it did not deviate from its course and was traveling too fast to be a bird. It continued on a perfectly straight trajectory until it was out of sight. 
Was it a drone or something else. I am sure it was not a bird.

summary: The 1st sighting was in July 2013 - and this 3rd sighting was 11-25-13
description:
I was sitting on the back porch and relocated to the seat my fiancie was sitting in. That is when I noticed a object that had an appearance of a star, but had flashing lights.
